King panaun a ita i Berodac-baladan a anak nang Baladan, a ari ning Babilonia, pepabal yang sulat at metung a pagkalub kang Hezequias; uling keang dimdam king i Hezequias misalunan ya.

At pekiramdamanan nong Hezequias, at pepakit na karela ing mabilug a bale karing keang mangaulagang bague, ing pilak, at ing guintu, at ding maparas, at ing maulagang laru, at ing bale ra ding keang sandata, at ing anggang meakit karing pibandian na: alang nanuman king karing pibandian na: alang nanuman king keang bale, ni king mabilug a keang sasakupan, a e na pepakit karelang Hezequias.

Kanita dinatang ya i Isaias a manula king aring Hezequias, at sinabi na kea, Nanu ing sinabi ra ding lalaking deti? At nu la menibatan king pamaniatang da keka? At sinabi nang Hezequias, Menibatan la king metung a marayung karinan, ibat pin king Babilonia.
At sinabi na, Nanu ing ikit da king kekang bale? At mekibat ya i Hezequias, Ing sablang atiu king kanakung bale ikit da: alang nanumang bague karing kakung pibandian a e ku pepakit karela.
At sinabi nang Isaias kang Hezequias, Pakiramdaman mu ing amanu ning GUINU.
Oini, ding aldo daratang la, king ing anggang atiu king kekang bale, at ing sininup da ding kekang mangatua angga king aldo ngeni, midala king Babilonia: alang nanumang mitagan, sasabian ning GUINU.
At karing kekang anak a lalaki a manibatan keka, a ipanganak mu, midala la; at maguing kapun la king palacio na ning ari ning Babilonia.
Kanita sinabi nang Hezequias kang Isaias, Mayap ing amanu ning GUINU a kekang sinabi. Sinabi na pa, E wari makanian, nung ing kapayapan at katutuan magbili karing kakung kayaldawan?

Ngeni ing aliwa karing dapat nang Hezequias, at ing mabilug nang sikanan, at nung makananu neng guewa ing talaga, at ing piagusan, at migdala yang danum kilub ning ciudad, e la wari makasulat king libru ra ding cronica ra ding ari ning Juda?
At metudtud ya i Hezequias a kayabe ra ding keang mangatua; at i Manases a keang anak migari yang kalili na.
I Manases labi yang aduang banua tua inyang migmula yang migari; at migari yang limangpulu at limang banua karin Jerusalem: at ing laguiu na ning keang indu Hefziba.
At depatan na ing marawak king panimanman ning GUINU, agpang karing makasumami ra ding bansa a tinabi ning GUINU ibat king arapan da ding anak na ning Israel.

Uling kea lang telakad pasibayu ding mangatas a karinan a lesakan nang Hezequias a keang ibpa; at pepatalakad yang altares dikil kang baal, at guinawa yang Ashera, anti mo ing depatan nang Ahab a ari ning Israel, at simban no ding sablang ejercito banua, at sinuyu ya karela.
At mitalakad yang altares king bale ning GUINU, nung kaisanu na sinabing GUINU, King Jerusalem ibili ku ing kakung laguiu.
At mitalakad yang altares dikil karing anggang ejercito banua karing adua nang patio ning bale ning GUINU.

At pepadalanan ne ing anak nang lalaki king api, at dinapat ya king pamaganting-anting, at guinamit ya karing encanto, at mekisangguni ya karing ating marawak a espiritu, at karing magkukulam: dinapat yang dakal a dewakan king panimanman ning GUINU, baneng pamungkasian king mua.

At binili ne ing larawan nang dinukit ning Ashera, a keang guewa, king bale a nung isanu ing sinabi ning GUINU kang David at kang Solomon a anak na, King bale a iti, at king Jerusalem, a pinili ku karing anggang dai na ning Israel, ibili ku ing laguiu ku king kapilan pa man;

Ni e ku na itulut a gumala la pa ding bitis na ning Israel king lual na ning labuad a binie ku karing karelang mangatua, nung tuntunan dang daptan ing agpang king anggang inutus ku karela, at agpang king anggang kautusan a inutus na karela ning talasuyu kung i Moises.
Dapot e ra pekiramdaman: at tinake nong Manases a dapat king lalung marawak a maiguit king depatan da ding bansa a linipul ning GUINU king arapan da ding anak na ning Israel.
At Ing GUINU miniabi ya king pamamilatan da ding keang talasuyung manula, ngana,

Uling depatan nong Manases a ari ning Juda ding makasumaming deti, at dinapat yang dewakan a maiguit king anggang depatan da ding Amoreos, a minuna kea, at depatan nang mikasala ing Juda king pamamilatan da ding keang idolos;

Inya pin anti keni ing sabi ning GUINU, a Dios ning Israel, Oini, kanakung dalan ing anti kaniting dewakan king Jerusalem at king Juda, bang ninumang makaramdam kaniti, ding adua nang balugbug mangaklingan la.

At yatyat ke king babo ning Jerusalem ing paniukad ning Samaria, at ing pabatu na ning bale nang Ahab; at kuskusan ku ing Jerusalem anti mo ing pamanguskus na ning metung a tau king metung a pinggan, a kukuskusan ne at pibiling-biling ne.
At isambulat ku ing mitagan king kanakung mana, at ibie kula king gamat da ding karelang kasalang; at maguing metung lang dakap at metung a samsam karing sabla rang kasalang;
Uling depatan da ing marawak king kakung panlalawe, at pemungkasian daku king mua, manibat king aldo a ding karelang mangatua linual lang ibat king Egipto, angga pin king aldo ngeni.

Bukud kaniti mibubu yang binang dakal i Manases king dayang alang kasalanan, angga king akatmu na ing Jerusalem manibat king metung a sepu angga king kasumangid; bukud king keang kasalanan a peparapat nang meguing kasalanan na ning Juda, king pamaniapat na king marawak king panimanman ning GUINU.
Ngeni ing aliwa karing dapat nang Manases, at ing sabla nang depatan, at ing kasalanan a pikansalanan na, e la wari makasulat king libru ra ding cronica ra ding ari ning Juda?
At i Manases metudtud yang kayabe ra ding keang mangatua, at mikutkut ya king mula na ning keang sariling bale, king mula ning Uza: at i Amon a anak na migari yang kalili na.
I Amon adua yang pulu at aduang banua tua inyang migmula yang migari; at migari yang aduang banua king Jerusalem: at ing laguiu na ning keang indu Mesulemet a anak nang Haruz ning Jotba.
At depatan na ing marawak king panlalawe ning GUINU, anti mo ing depatan nang Manases a ibpa na.
At linakad ya king anggang lakad nang ibpa na, at sinuyu ya karing idolos a siyuwan nang ibpa na, at simban nala:
At pepaimburisan ne Ing GUINU, ing Dios ding keang mangatua, at e ya linakad king dalan ning GUINU.
At ding talasuyu nang Amon minala lang salang kea, at pete re ing ari king keang sariling bale.
Dapot pete no ning balayan ning labuad ding anggang dinapat bala salang king aring Amon; at guewa neng ari ning balayan ning labuad i Josias a keang anak a kalili na.
Ngeni ing aliwa karing dapat a depatan nang Amon, e la wari makasulat king libru ra ding cronica ra ding ari ning Juda?
At mikutkut ya king keang kutkutan king mula nang Uza: at i Josias a keang anak migari yang kalili na.
I Josias walu yang banua tua inyang migmula yang migari; at migari yang atlungpulu at metung a banua king Jerusalem: at ing laguiu na ning keang indu Jedida a anak nang Adaya ning Boscat.
At depatan na ing matulid king panlalawe ning GUINU, at linakad ya king mabilug a linakad nang David a keang ibpa, at e liniku king wanan o king kaili man.
At milyari king kalabi nang walung banua ning aring Josias, king tinubud ne ning ari i Safan, a anak nang Azalias a anak nang Mesullam, a kalijim, king bale ning GUINU, ngana,
Sampa ka kang Hilcias a matas a sacerdote, banong bilangan ding salapi a milub king bale ning GUINU, a tinipun da ding talaingat king piluluban ning balayan:

At pabustan mung ibie rala king gamat da ding darapat a lilingap king bale ning GUINU; at pabustan mung ibie rala karing darapat a atiu kilub ning bale ning GUINU, barang larinan ing kasiran na ning bale.
Karing aluagui, at karing manalakad, at karing aluaguing batu, at dikil king pamanialing dutung at batung medaras ban panlarin king bale.
Makanian man alang pamanguang sulit a depatan da karing salapi a miabie karing karelang gamat; uling depatan da ing katapatan.
At i Hilcias a matas a sacerdote sinabi na kang Safan a kalijim, Ikit ke ing libru ning kautusan king bale ning GUINU. At binie neng Hilcias ing libru kang Safan, at binasa ne iti.

At i Safan a kalijim dinatang ya king ari, at pigdala neng pasibayung amanu ing ari, at sinabi na, Guisan do ding kekang talasuyu ding salapi a meakit king bale, at miabie la king gamat da ding darapat a lilingap king bale ning GUINU.
At sinabi nang Safan a kilijim king ari, ngana, i Hilcias a sacerdote binie ne kanaku ing metung a libru. At binasa neng Safan king arapan na ning ari.
At milyari, inyang damdaman no ning ari ding amanu na ning libru na ning kautusan, king guinabak na ing keang imalan.
At ing ari inutus ne i Hilcias a sacerdote, at i Ahicam a anak nang Safan, at i Acbor a anak nang Micaya, at i Safan a kalijim, at i Asaya a talasuyu ning ari, ngana,

Ume kayu, mangutang ko king GUINU dikil kaku, at dikil king balayan at dikil king mabilug a Juda, makatungkul karing amanu na ning librung iti a meakit; uling maragul ing mua ning GUINU a milablab salang kekatamu, uling e ro pekiramdaman ding kekatang mangatua ding amanu na ning librung iti, bang daptan da ing agpang king anggang makasulat tungkul kekatamu.

Inya i Hilcias a sacerdote, at i Ahicam, at i Acbor, at i Safan, at i Asaya, mine la kang Hulda a babaing manula, a asawa nang Sallum a anak nang Ticva, a anak nang Harhas, a katiwala king kaban imalan (manuknangan ya ngeni karin Jerusalem king kaduang silid); at mekisangguni la kea.
At sinabi na karela, Anti keni ing sabi ning GUINU, ing Dios ning Israel: Sabian yu king lalaki a mitubud kekayu kanaku,
Makanian ing sabi ning GUINU, Oini, aku pagpa kung dewakan king karinan a iti, at karing manuknangan keti, ing anggang amanu na pin libru a binasa na ning ari ning Juda.

Uling pepaimburisan daku, at dinuluk lang labun patungkul karing aliwang dioses, barakung pamungkasian king mua king anggang dapat da ding karelang gamat, inya pin ing kanakung mua milablab salang king karinan a iti, at e ra apatda.
Dapot king ari ning Juda, a mitubud kekayu bang mangutang king GUINU, makanian ing sabian yu kea, Makanian ing sabi ning GUINU, a Dios ning Israel: Tungkul karing amanu a kekang dimdam,

Uling ing kekang pusu malambut ya, at migpakumbaba ka king arapan ning GUINU, inyang damdaman mu ing kakung sinabi salang king karinan a iti, at salang karing manuknangan keti, bang maguing metung lang ilang at metung lang sumpa, at guinabak mu ing kekang imalan, at kiniak ka king arapa ku; aku man pekiramdaman daka, nganing GUINU.

Inya pin, oini, pakiagum daka karing kekang mangatua, at miagum ka king kekang kutkutan king payapa, ni e ra akit ding kekang mata ing anggang dewakan a pagpa ku king karinan a iti. At pigdala reng pasibayung amanu ing ari.
At ing ari mitubud ya, at tinipun no kea ding anggang makatua ning Juda at ning Jerusalem.

At sinampa ya ing ari king bale ning GUINU, at ding anggang lalaki ning Juda at ding anggang manuknangan king Jerusalem kayabe nala, at ding sacerdotes, at ding manula, at ing mabilug a balayan, malati at mangaragul: at binasa no karing karelang balugbug ding anggang amanu na ning libru ning tipan a meakit king bale ning GUINU.

At ing ari tinalakad ya king siping ning asias, at guinawa yang metung a tipan king arapan ning GUINU, bayang lumakad a makayagpang king GUINU, at banong ingatan ding keang utus, at ding keang pamipatutu, at ding keang tuntunan, king mabilug nang pusu, at king mabilug nang kaladua, bang tuparan do ding amanu na ning tipan a iti a makasulat king librung iti: at ing mabilug a balayan tinalakad king tipan.

At inutusan ne ning ari i Hilcias a matas a sacerdote, at ding sacerdotes king kaduang balitang, at ding talaingat king piluluban, bang ilual la king templo ning GUINU ding anggang kasangkapan a megawa dikil kang baal, at dikil king Ashera, at dikil karing sablang ejercito ning banua; at dilukan nala king lual na ning Jerusalem karing marangle na ning Cedron, at ing abu ra deti dela ra king Bet-el.

At leko nala ding sacerdotes a nayun karing idolos, a inalal da ding ari ning Juda bang duluk labun karing mangatas a karinan karing ciudad ning Juda, at karing karinan king makapatulug ning Jerusalem; deta mang duduluk labun kang baal, king aldo, at king bulan, at karing planetas, at karing sablang ejercito ning banua.

At liwal ne ing Ashera ibat king bale ning GUINU, king lual na ning Jerusalem, angga king batis ning Cedron, at dilukan ne iti king batis na ning Cedron, at dinunut neng anting alikabuk, at inugse ra ing alikabuk na niti karing kutkutan da ding taung malda.
At lesak nala ding bale ra ding sodomitas, a atiu king bale ning GUINU, a pipanabalan da ding babai karing tabing dikil king Ashera.

At liwal no ding anggang sacerdotes manibat karing ciudad ning Juda, at misingan no ding mangatas a karinan a pidudulukan dang labun ding sacerdotes, manibat king Geba angga king Beer-seba; at lesakan nala ding mangatas a karinan da ding pasbulan dalan a atiu king piluluban na ning pasbulan dalan nang Josue a gobernador ning ciudad, a atiu king dane kaili ning metung a lalaki king pasbulan dalan ning ciuadad.
Makanian man ding sacerdotes da ding mangatas a karinan e la sinampa king altar ning GUINU karin Jerusalem, dapot mengan lang tinape a alang levadura king libutad da ding karelang kapatad.
At misingan na ing Tofet, a atiu king libis da ding anak nang Hinom, bang alang lalaki a paralanan ne king api kang molec ing anak nang lalaki o ing anak nang babai.

At leko nala ding kabayu a binie ra ding ari ning Juda king aldo, king piluluban ning bale ning GUINU, king siping na ning silid ning talaingat katudturan a i Natan-melec, a atiu karing siduan; at dilukan no king api ding carro na ning aldo.

At ding altares a atiu king bubungan na ning matas nang silid Ahaz, a guewa ra ding altares a guewa nang Manases karing aduang patio ning bale ning GUINU, ligpak no ning ari, at lesakan nala manibat karin, at inugse na ing alikabuk da king batis ning Cedron.

At ding mangatas a karinan a atiu king arapan na ning Jerusalem, a atiu king dane na wanan ning bunduk na ning kasiran, a telakad na ning aring Solomon dikil king astoret a makasumami ra ding Sidonios, at dikil kang quemos a makasumami ning Moab, at dikil kang milcom a makasumami ra ding anak nang Ammon, misingan no ning ari.
At pemirasu nong mangalati ding asias, at kinutud no ding Asherim, at mikatmuan la ding karelang karinan karing butul ding tau.

Bukud kaniti ing altar a atiu king Bet-el, at ing matas a karinan a guewa nang Jeroboam a anak nang Nebat, a peparapat kasalanan king Israel, ing altar pin at ing matas a karinan ligpak nala; at dilukan ne ing matas a karinan at dinunut neng meguing alikabuk, at dilukan ne ing Ashera.

At kabang babalikid ya i Josias, atiktikan nala ding kutkutan a atiu king bunduk; at mitubud ya, at liwal no ding butul ibat karing kutkutan, at dilukan no king babo ning altar, at misingan ne iti, agpang king amanu ning GUINU a pisiag na ning lalaki ning Dios, a ya ing mipasiag karing bague a deti.

Kanita sinabi na, Nanu yang monumento itang kanakung akakit? At sinabi ra ding lalaki ning ciudad kea, Ya ing kutkutan na ning lalaki ning Dios, a menibatan king Juda, at mipasiag karelating bague a deti a kekang depatan salang king altar ning Bet-el.
At sinabi na, Paburen ye; e yo sa pakimut king ninumang tau ding butul na. Inya pepaburen dong dilidili ding butul na, a kayabe ra ding butul na ning manula a menibatan king Samaria.

At ding anggang bale ra naman ding mangatas a karinan a atiu karing ciudad ning Samaria, a guewa ra ding ari ning Israel bareng pamungkasian king mua Ing GUINU, leko nong Josias, at depatan na kareti ing agpang karing anggang dapat a depatan na king Bet-el.
At pete no ding anggang sacerdotes da ding mangatas a karinan a atiu karin, king babo ra ding altares, at dilukan nala ding butul da ding tau babo ra; at mibalik ya Jerusalem.
At inutus ning ari king mabilug a balayan, sinabi na, Pagmasusian yu ing pascua king GUINU a kekong Dios, anti mo ing makasulat kaniting libru ning tipan.
Tune king alang mipagmasusian a metung a pascuang anti ita manibat king aldo ra ding ukum a minatul king Israel, ni karing sablang kayaldawan da ding ari ning Israel, ni karing ari na man ning Juda;
Dapot king kalabi nang walung banua ning aring Josias mipagmasusian ing pascua iti king GUINU king Jerusalem.

Bukud kaniti ding maki espiritung marawak, at ding magkukulam, at ding terafim, at ding idolos, at ding anggang makasumami a meakit king labuad ning Juda at king Jerusalem, leko nong Josias, banong patunayan ding amanu na ning kautusan a makasulat king libru, a ikit nang Hilcias a sacerdote king bale ning GUINU.

At alang ari a a anti mo kea karing minuna kea, a mibalik king GUINU king mabilug nang pusu, at king mabilug nang kaladua, at king mabilug nang sikanan, agpang king mabilug a kautusan nang Moises; ni ala namang tinalakad a tinuki kea a anti mo kea.

Makanianman, Ing GUINU, e ya mibalik a ibat king kabagsikan ning keang maragul a mua, a kelablab na ning keang pamikapali salang king Juda, king uli ra ding sablang pamamungkasi a pemungkasi nang Manases kea.

At sinabi ning GUINU, Idayu ku naman ing Juda king kakung panlalawe, anti mo ing kakung pamidayu king Israel, at yugse ke ing ciudad a iti a pinili ku, ing Jerusalem pin, at ing bale a nung kaisanu ku sinabi, Ing laguiu ku magbili ya karin.
Ngeni ing aliwa karing dapat nang Josias, at ing anggang depatan na, e la wari makasulat king libru ra ding cronica ra ding ari ning Juda?

Karing keang kayaldawan i Faraon-neco a ari ning Egipto sinampa ya salang king ari ning Asiria king ilug Eufrates: at ing aring Josias mine yang salang kea; at pete neng Faraon-neco king Megido, inyang ikit ne.

At dela reng mete ding keang talasuyu king metung a carro manibat king Megido, at dela re Jerusalem, at kitkut de king keang sariling kutkutan. At kinua ne ning balayan ning labuad i Jeoahaz a anak nang Josias, at linian de, at guewa reng ari a kalili ning keang ibpa.
I Jeoahaz adua yang pulu at atlung banua tua inyang migmula yang migari; at migari yang atlung bulan king Jerusalem: at ing laguiu na ning keang indu Hamutal a anak nang Jeremias ning Libna.
At depatan na ing marawak king panimanman ning GUINU, agpang king anggang depatan da ding keang mangatua.

At binili neng Faraon-neco karing pango king Ribla king labuad na ning Hamat, bayang e makapagari king Jerusalem; at binili na ing labuad king metung a pamamuis a dinalan a talentong pilak, at metung a talengtong guintu.

At guewa neng aring Faraon-neco i Eliaquim a anak nang Josias a kalili nang Josias a keang ibpa, at inalilan na ing keang laguiu king Jeoyakim: dapot leko ne I Jeoahaz; at miras ya Egipto, at mete ya karin.

At binie nang Jeoyakim ing pilak at ing guintu kang Faraon; dapot keang pepabuisan ing labuad bang munie king salapi agpang king utus nang Faraon: inawad na ing pilak at ing guintu na ning balayan ning labuad, king balang metung agpang king keang buis, banang ibie iti kang Faraon-neco.
I Jeoyakim adua yang pulu at limang banua tua inyang migmula yang migari; at migari yang labing-metung a banua king Jerusalem: at ing laguiu nang indu na Zebida a anak nang Pedaya ning Ruma.
At depatan na ing marawak king panimanman ning GUINU, agpang king anggang depatan da ding keang mangatua.
Karing keang kayaldawan sinampa ya i Nabucodonosor a ari ning Babilonia, at i Jeoyakim meguing talasuyu neng atlung banua: kanita mibalik ya at linaban yang salang kea.

At Ing GUINU mitubud yang salang kea karing tapuk da ding Caldeos, at karing tapuk ding tau Siria, at karing tapuk da ding Moabitas, at karing tapuk da ding anak nang Ammon, at tinubud nong salang king Juda bareng lipulan, agpang king amanu ning GUINU, a keang sinabi king pamamilatan da ding keang talasuyu a manula.
Tune king utus ning GUINU dinatang iti king Juda, banong idayu king keang panlalawe, tungkul karing kasalanan nang Manases, agpang king anggang depatan na,
At anti naman dikil king alang kasalanan a daya a keang bibu; uling kitmuan na ing Jerusalem king alang kasalanan daya: at e ya patawad i Guinu.
Ngeni ing aliwa karing dapat nang Jeoyakim, at ing anggang depatan na, e la wari makasulat king libru ra ding cronica ra ding ari ning Juda?
Nanupata metudtud ya i Jeoyakim a kayabe ra ding keang mangatua; at i Jeoyaquin a keang anak migari yang kalili na.

At ing ari ning Egipto e ne dinatang pa a menibatan king keang labuad; uling kinua na ning ari ning Babilonia, manibat king batis na ning Egipto angga king ilug ning Eufrates, ing anggang makatungkul king ari ning Egipto.
I Jeoyaquin labi yang walung banua tua inyang migmula yang migari; at migari ya Jerusalem atlung bulan: at ing laguiu na ning keang indu Nehusta a anak nang Elnatan ning Jerusalem.
At depatan na ing marawak king panimanman ning GUINU, agpang king anggang depatan nang ibpa na.
King panaun a ita ding talasuyu nang Nabucodonosor a ari ning Babilonia sinampa la Jerusalem, at ing ciudad mekubkub ya.
At i Nabucodonosor a ari ning Babilonia miras ya king ciudad, kabang ding talasuyu na kukubkuban de iti;

At i Jeoyaquin a ari ning Juda liwalan ne ing ari Babilonia, ya, at i indu na, at ding talasuyu na, at ding principes na, at ding keang pekapun: at kinua ne ning ari ning Babilonia king kawalu nang banua ning keang pamagari.

At dela nala manibat karin ding anggang pibandian na ning bale ning GUINU, at ding pibandian king bale ning ari, at pemimirasu nong mangalati ding anggang kasangkapan a guintu, a guewa na ning aring Solomon king templo ning GUINU, anti mo ing sinabi ning GUINU.

At dela na ing mabilug a Jerusalem, at ding anggang principes, at ding anggang masikanan a lalaki ning katapangan, apulu la ping libung bijag, at ding sablang talapangawa at ding pande; alang mitagan, subali mu ding kalulung dili ning balayan na ning labuad.

At dela ne i Jeoyaquin king Babilonia; at ing indu na ning ari, at ding asawa na ning ari, at ding keang pekapun, at ding lalaking pekabuntuk ning labuad, dela nala king pangabijag king Babilonia a menibatan Jerusalem.

At ding anggang lalaking masikanan, pitu lang libu pin, at ding talapangawa at ding pande libu la, ila ngan masikan la at mangabiasa king pamipamuk, deti pin dela nong bijag king Babilonia ning ari Babilonia.
At in ari ning Babilonia guewa ne i Matanias, a kapatad na ning ibpa nang Jeoyaquim, ari a kalili na, at inalilan na ing keang laguiu king Zedequias.

I Zedequias adua yang pulu at metung a banua tua inyang migmula yang migari; at migari yang labingmetung a banua king Jerusalem: at ing laguiu na ning keang indu Hamutal a anak nang Jeremias ning Libna.
At depatan na ing marawak king panlalawe ning GUINU, agpang king anggang depatan nang Jeoyakim.
Uling king uli na ning mua ning GUINU milyari king Jerusalem at king Juda, angga king atabi nala ibat king keang arapan. At i Zedequias linaban ya king ari ning Babilonia.

At milyari king kasiam a banua ning keang pamagari, king kapulung bulan, king kapulung aldo ning bulan, king i Nabucodonosor a ari ning Babilonia dinatang ya, ya at ing mabilug nang ejercito, salang king Jerusalem, at menalakad yang salang kaniti; at mitalakad lang kuta salang kaniti king makapatulug.
Inya ing ciudad mekubkub ya angga king kalabi nang metung a banua ning aring Zedequias.
King aldo a kasiam ning kapat a bulan ing danup milalu king ciudad, nanupata alang tinape dikil king balayan ning labuad.

Kanita ing metung a busbus king kuta megawa ya king ciudad, at ding anggang lalaki ning pamipamuk tinakas la king kabengian king dalan ning pasbulan dalan king pilatan da ding aduang kuta, a atiu king siping ning mulajan na ning ari (ngeni ding Caldeos makapatulug lang salang king ciudad); at ing ari mine ya king dalan na ning Araba.
Dapot tegal ne ning ejercito ra ding Caldeos ing ari, at disan de karing kapatagan ning Jerico; at ing mabilug nang ejercito misalbag la kea.
Kanita kinua re ing ari, at simpa re king ari Babilonia king Ribla; at misaldak lang kayatulan kea.
At pete rala ding anak nang lalaking Zedequias king arapan da ding keang mata, at dinukit dala ding mata nang Zedequias, at guepusan de karing talikala, at dela re Babilonia.

Ngeni king kalimang bulan, king kapitung aldo ning bulan, a ya ing kalabing siam a banua ning aring Nabucodonosor, a ari ning Babilonia, dinatang ya i Nabuzaradan a capitan ding bante, metung nang talasuyu ning ari Babilonia, king Jerusalem.
At dilukan ne ing bale ning GUINU, at ing bale ning ari; at ding angga bale ning Jerusalem, ing balang maragul ping bale, dilukan no king api.
At ing mabilug a ejercito ding Caldeos, a kayabe na ning capitan ding bante, ligpak dala ding kuta na ning Jerusalem king makapatulug.

At ing mitagan king balayan a mengalakuan king ciudad, at detang memaglako, ding memaglako king ari ning Babilonia, at ing mitagan ning kekaldan, dela no king pangabijag Nabuzaradan a capitan ding bante.
Dapot likuan nala ning capitan ding bante ding kalulung dili ning labuad balang maguing talapanese uvas at talapanasik.

At ding asias a tangsu a atiu king bale ning GUINU, at ding tutukluan at ing dayatmalat a tangsu a atiu king bale ning GUINU, pemimirasu rong mangalati ding Caldeos, at dela ra ing tangsu ra king Babilonia.
At ding kuran, at ding pala, at ding gunting, at ding sanduk, at ding anggang kasangkapan a tangsu a gagamitan da king karelang pamanibala, dela rala.
At ding kawali, at ding palanggana, a megawa king guintu, king guintu, at ing megawang pilak, king pilak, dela no ning capitan ding bante.
Ding aduang asias, ing metung a dayatmalat, at ding tutukluan, a guewa nang Solomon dikil king bale ning GUINU, ing tangsu ra ding anggang kasangkapan a deti alang timbang.

Ing katas na ning metung a asias labi yang walung siku, at ing metung a pasapnung tangsu atiu king babo na nita; at ing katas na ning pasapnu atlung siku, a atin lang lalalala at granada king babo na ning pasapnu king makapatulug, ding sabla tangsu la: at kakametung da deti ing kaduang asias a ating lalalala.
At kinua ne ning capitan ding bante i Seraya a pun da ding sacerdotes at i Sofanias a kaduang sacerdote, at ding atlung talaingat ning pasbul:

At king ciudad kinanua yang metung a pekapun a binili na karing lalaki ning pakipamuk; at ding lima katau karela a menakit king lupa na ning ari, a meakit king ciudad; at ing kalijim, ing capitan ning ejercito, a tinipun king balayan ning labuad, a meakit king ciudad.
At kinua nong Nabuzaradan a capitan ding bante, at dela no king ari ning Babilonia king Ribla.
At sigatan nala ning ari ning Babilonia, at pete no king Ribla king labuad na ning Hamat. Inya ing Juda medala yang bijag lual ning keang labuad.
At tungkul king balayan a melakuan king labuad na ning Juda, a likuan nang Nabucodonosor a ari ning Babilonia, guewa ne ping gobernador karela i Gedalias a anak nang Ahicam, a anak nang Satan.

Ngeni inyang ding anggang capitan king tapuk, ila at ding karelang lalaki, dimdam da king ing ari Babilonia guewa neng gobernador i Gedalias, dinatang la kang Gedalias king Mizpa, ila pin i Ismael a anak nang Netanias, at i Johanan a anak nang Carea, at i Seraya a anak nang Tanhumet a Netofatita, at i Jaazanias a anak na ning Maacateo, ila at ding karelang lalaki.

At i Gedalias simpa na karela at karing karelang lalaki, at sinabi na karela, E ko tatakut king uli ding talasuyu ra ding Caldeos: manuknangan ko king labuad, at sumuyu kayu king ari ning Babilonia, at maguing makakayap kekayu.

Dapot milyari king kapitung bulan king i Ismael a anak nang Netanias, a anak nang Elisma, ning bining ari, dinatang ya, at apulung lalaki a kayabe na, at sigatan ne i Gedalias, nanupata mete ya, at ding Judios at ding Caldeos a kayabe na king Mizpa.
At ing mabilug a balayan, malati at maragul, at ding capitan da ding tapuk, tinalakad la, at miras la Egipto; uling mitakutan la karing Caldeos.

At milyari king katlung pulu at pitung banua ning pangabijag nang Jeoyaquin a ari ning Juda, king kalabing aduang bulan, king kaduang pulu at pitung aldo ning bulan, king i Evil-merodac a ari ning Babilonia, king banuang migmula yang migari, tinas ne ing buntuk nang Jeoyaquin a ari ning Juda ning sukulan;
At miniabi yang maganaka kea, at binili ne ing keang luklukan king babo ra ding luklukan da ding ari a kayabe na king Babilonia,
At inalilan na ing keang imalan makasukul. At i Jeoyaquin menga yang tinape king arapan na a migparati karing sablang aldo na ning keang bie:
At tungkul king keang pagkabiayan, ating makaparating pagkabiayan a ibabie na kea ning ari, balang aldo metung a dake, karing sablang aldo na ning keang bie.
I Adam, i Set, i Enos,
I Kenan, i Mahalalel, i Jared,
I Enoc, i Matusalem, i Lamec,
I Noe, i Sem, i Ham, i Jafet.
Ding anak nang Jafet: i Gomer, at i Magog, at i Madai, at i Javan, at i Tubal, at i Mesec, at i Tiras.
At ding anak nang Gomer: i Askenaz, at i Difat, at i Togarma.
At ding anak nang Javan: i Elisa, at i Tarsis, i Kitim, at i Rodanim.
Ding anak nang Ham: i Cus, at i Mizraim, i Put, at i Canaan.
At ding anak nang Cus: i Seba, at i Havila, at i Sabta, at i Raama, at i Sabteca. At ding anak nang Raama: i Sheba, at i Dedan.
At i Cus ayanak ne i Nimrod; ya ing migmulang meguing masikanan king labuad.
At i Mizraim ayanak ne i Ludim, at i Anamim, at i Leabim, at i Naftuhim,
At i Patrusim, at i Casluhim (a nung nu la menibat ding Filisteos), at i Caftorim.
At i Canaan ayanak ne i Sidon a keang pangane, at i Het,
At ing Jebuseo, at ing Amoreo, at ing Gergeseo,
At ing Heveo, at ing Arqueo, at ing Sineo,
At ing Arvadeo, at ing Zemareo, at ing Hamateo.
Ding anak nang Sem: i Elam, at i Asur, at i Arfaxad, at i Lud, at i Aram, at i Uz, at i Hul, at i Geter, at i Mesec.
At i Arfaxad ayanak ne i Sela, at i Sela ayanak ne i Heber.
At kang Heber mibait la ding aduang anak a lalaki: ing laguiu na ning metung Peleg; uling king keang kayaldawan mipirake ing labuad; at ing laguiu na ning keang kapatad a lalaki Joctan.
At i Joctan ayanak ne i Almodad, at i Selef, at i Hazarmavet, at i Jera,
At i Hadoram, at i Uzal, at i Dicla,
At i Ebal, at i Abimael, at i Sheba.
At i Ofir, at i Havila, at i Jobab. Deti ngan anak nong Joctan.
I Sem, i Arfaxad, i Sela,
I Eber, i Peleg, i Reu,
I Serug, i Nacor, i Tera,
I Abram, (ya naman i Abraham).
Ding anak nang Abraham: i Isaac, at i Ismael.
Deti ilang karelang dai: ing pangane nang Ismael, i Nebayot; tutuki i Kedar, at i Adbeel, at i Mibsam,
I Misma, at i Duma, i Massa, i Hadad, at i Tema.
I Jetur, i Nafis, at i Kedema. Deti ilang anak nang Ismael.
At ding anak nang Ketura, a babai nang Abraham: penganak ne i Zimran, at i Jocsan, at i Medan, at i Midian, at i Isbac, at i Sua. At ding anak nang Jocsan: i Sheba, at i Dedan.
At ding anak nang Midian: i Efa, at i Efer, at i Hanoc, at i Abida, at i Eldaa. Deti ngan anak nong Ketura.
At i Abraham ayanak ne i Isaac. Ding anak nang Isaac: i Esau, at i Israel.
Ding anak nang Esau: i Elifaz, i Reuel, at i Jeus, at i Jalam, at i Core.
Ding anak nang Elifaz: i Teman, at i Omar, i Zefi, at i Gatam, i Kenaz, at i Timna, at i Amalec.
Ding anak nang Reuel: i Nahat, i Zera, i Sama, at i Miza.
At ding anak nang Seir: i Lotan, at i Sobal, at i Zibeon, at i Ana, at i Dishon, at i Eser, at i Disan.
At ding anak nang Lotan: i Hori, at i Homam; at i Timna kapatad neng babaing Lotan.
Ding anak nang Sobal: i Alian, at i Manahat, at i Ebal, i Sefi, at i Onam. At ding anak nang Zibeon: i Aya, at i Ana.
Ding anak nang Ana: i Dison. At ding anak nang Dison: i Hamran, at i Esban, at i Itran, at i Keran.
Ding anak nang Eser: i Bilhan, at i Zaavan, i Jaacan. Ding anak nang Disan: i Uz, at i Aran.
Ngeni deti ila ding ari a migari king labuad na ning Edom, bayu ya migari ing ninumang ari karing anak na ning Israel: i Bela a anak nang Beor; at ing laguiu na ning keang ciudad Dinhaba.
At mete ya i Bela, at migari yang kalili na i Jobab a anak nang Zera ning Bozra.
At mete ya i Jobab, at i Husam migari yang kalili na king labuad da ding Temaneos.
At mete ya i Husam, at migara yang kalili na i Hadad a anak nang Bedad, a nung ninu ing sinugat kang Midian king marangle na ning Moab; at ing laguiu na ning keang ciudad Avit.
At mete ya i Hadad, at migari yang kalili na i Shaul ning Rehobot
At mete ya i Samla, at migari yang kalili na i Shaul ning Rehobot king lele ning Ilug.
At mete ya i Shaul, at migari yang kalili na i Baal-hanan a anak nang Acbor.
At mete ya i Baal-hanan, at migari yang kalili na i Hadad; at ing laguiu na ning keang ciudad Pai: at ing laguiu na ning keang asawa Mehetabel, a anak nang Matred, a anak nang Me-zahab.
At mete ya i Hadad. At ding pekapun ning Edom ila pin: ing pekapun a Timna, ing pekapun a Alia, ing pekapun a Jetet,
Ing pekapun a Ohalibama, ing pekapun a Ela, ing pekapun a Pinon,
Ing pekapun a Kenas, ing pekapun a Teman, ing pekapun a Mibzar,
Ing pekapun a Magdiel, ing pekapun a Iram. Deti ilang pekapun ning Edom.
Deti ilang anak nang Israel: i Reuben, i Simeon, i Levi, at i Juda, i Isacar, at i Zabulon,
I Dan, i Jose, at i Benjamin, i Naftali, i Gad at i Aser.
Ding anak nang Juda: i Er, at i Onan, at i Sela; atlu la ding penganak na king anak nang babaing Sua a Cananea. At i Er, a pangane nang Juda, marawak ya king panimanman ning GUINU; at pete ne.
At i Tamar a manuyang nang babai penganak ne i Perez at i Zera. Ding anggang anak nang Juda lima la.
Ding anak nang Perez: i Hezron, at i Hamul.
At ding anak nang Zera: i Zimri, at i Etan, at i Heman, at i Calcol, at i Dara; ila ngan lima la.
At ding anak nang Carmi: i Acar, a mapangulu ning Israel, a migkamit metung a pamanalangsang king mitalagang bague.
At ding anak nang Etan: i Azarias.
Ding anak na namang Hezron, a penganak kea: i Jerameel, at i Ram, at i Kelubai.
At i Ram ayanak ne i Aminadab, at i Aminadab ayanak ne i Nason, a principe karing anak nang Juda;
At i Nason ayanak ne i Salma, at i Salma ayanak ne i Boaz,
At i Boaz ayanak ne i Obed, at i Obed ayanak ne i Isai;
At i Isai ayanak ne i Eliab a keang pangane, at i Abinadab ya ing kadua, at i Simea ya ing katlu,
I Netanel ya ing kapat, i Radai ya ing kalima,
I Ozem ya ing kanam, i David ya ing kapitu;
At ding kapatad dang babai ila pin i Zeruia at i Abigail. At ding anak nang lalaking Zeruia: i Abisai, at i Joab, at i Asael, atlu la.
At i Abigail penganak ne i Amasa; at ing ibpa nang Amasa ya i Jeter a Ismaelita.
At i Caleb a anak nang Hezron mika anak ya kang Azuba a asawa na, at kang Jeriot; at deti ilang meguing anak nang lalaki: i Jeser, at i Sobab, at i Ardon.
At mete ya i Azuba, at kinua neng Caleb dikil kea i Efrata, a mipanganak kea kang Hur.
At i Hur ayanak ne i Uri, at i Uri ayanak ne i Bezalel.
At kaibat linub ya i Hezron king anak nang babaing Maquir a ibpa nang Gilead, a kinua nang maguing asawa na inyang anam neng pulung banua tua; at penganak ne kea i Segub.
At i Segub ayanak ne i Jair, nung ninu ing mika ating aduangpulu at atlung ciudad king labuad na ning Gilead.
At kinua nong Gesur at i Aram ding balayan nang Jair ibat karela, pati na ing Kenat, at ding nayun na niti, anam la ping pulung ciudad. Deti ngan ding anak nang Maquir a ibpa nang Gilead.
At pangamate nang Hezron king Caleb-efrata, kanita penganak neng Abias a asawa nang Hezron kea i Asur a ibpa nang Tecoa.
At ding anak nang lalaking Jerameel a pangane nang Hezron ila pin i Ram ing pangane, at i Buna, at i Oren, at i Ozem, i Ahias.
At i Jerameel atin yang aliwang asawa, a ing keang laguiu Atara; ya ing indu nang Onam.
At ding anak nang lalaking Ram a pangane nang Jerameel ila pin i Maaz, at i Jamin, at i Equer.
At ding anak nang lalaking Onam ila pin i Samai, at i Jada. At ding anak nang lalaking Samai: i Nadab, at i Abisur.
At ing laguiu na ning asawa nang Abisur Abihail; at penganak no kea i Aban, at i Molid.
At ding anak nang lalaking Nadab: i Seled, at i Apaim; dapot i Seled mete yang alang anak.
At ding anak nang lalaking Apaim: i Isi. At ding anak nang lalaking Isi: i Sesan. At ding anak nang lalaking Sesan: i Alai.
At ding anak nang lalaking Jada a kapatad nang lalaking Samai: i Jeter, at i Jonatan; at i Jeter mete yang alang anak.
At ding anak nang lalaking Jonatan: i Pelet, at i Zaza. Deti ilang anak nang Jerameel.
Ngeni i Sesan ala yang anak a lalaki, nung e anak lang babai. At i Sesan atin yang metung a ipus, metung yang tau Egipto, a ing keang laguiu Jarha.
At binie neng Sesan ing anak nang babai kang Jarha a keang ipus bang maguing asawa ne; at kea penganak ne i Atai.
At i Atai ayanak ne i Natan, at i Natan ayanak ne i Zabad,
At i Zabad ayanak ne i Eflal, at i Eflal ayanak ne i Obed,
At i Obed ayanak ne i Jehu, at i Jehu ayanak ne i Azarias,
At i Azarias ayanak ne i Helez, at i Helez ayanak ne i Eleasa,
At i Eleasa ayanak ne i Sismai, at i Sismai ayanak ne i Sallum,
At i Sallum ayanak ne i Jecamias, at i Jecamias ayanak ne i Elisama.
At ding anak nang Caleb a kapatad nang lalaking Jerameel ila pin i Mesa a keang pangane, a ya ing ibpa nang Zif; at ding anak nang Maresa a ibpa nang Hebron.
At ding anak nang Hebron: i Core, at i Tapua, at i Requem, at i Sema.
At i Sema ayanak ne i Raham, a ibpa nang Jorqueam; at i Requem ayanak ne i Samai.
At ing anak nang lalaking Samai ya i Maon; at i Maon ya ing ibpa nang Betsur.
At i Efa, a babai nang Caleb, penganak ne i Haran, at i Moza, at i Gases; at i Haran ayanak ne i Gases.
At ding anak nang Jadai: i Regem, at i Jotan, at i Gesan, at i Pelet, at i Efa, at i Saaf.
I Maaca, a babai nang Caleb, penganak ne i Seber at i Tirhana.
Penganak naya naman i Saaf a ibpa nang Madmana, i Seva a ibpa nang Macbena, at ibpa nang Gibea; at ing anak nang babaing Caleb ya i Acsa:
Deti ilang anak nang Caleb, a anak nang Hur, a pangane nang Efrata: i Sobal a ibpa nang Kiriat-jearim,
I Salma a ibpa nang Beth-lehem, i Haref a ibpa nang Bet-gader.
At i Sobal a ibpa nang Kiriat-jearim mika atin yang anak: i Haroe, a kabangal ning Menuhot.
At ding sapni nang Kiriat-jearim: ding Itreos, at ding Puteos, at ding Sumateos, at ding Misraitas, karela la linto ding Zoratitas, at ding Estaolitas.
Ding anak nang Salma: i Bethlehem, at ding Netofatitas, i Atrotbetjoab, at ing kapitna ra ding Manahatitas, a Zoritas.
At ding sapni ra ding escribas a manuknangan king Jabes: ding Tirateos, ding Simeateos, ding Sucateos. Deti ila ding Cineos a dinatang ibat kang Hamat, a ibpa na ning bale nang Recab.
Ngeni deti ila ding anak nang David, a penganak kea king Hebron: ing pangane, ya i Amnon, kang Ahinoam a Jezreelita; ing kadua, i Daniel, kang Abigail a Carmelita;
Ing katlu, i Absalom a anak nang Maaca a anak nang babaing Talmai a ari ning Gesur; ing kapat, i Adonias a anak nang Hagit;
Ing kalima, i Sefatias kang Abital; ing kanam, i Itream kang Egla a asawa na:
Anam la ding penganak kea king Hebron; at karin migaring yang pitung banua at anam a bulan. At karin Jerusalem migari yang atlung pulu at atlung banua;
At deti ilang penganak kea king Jerusalem: i Simea, at i Sobab, at i Natan, at i Solomon, apat la, kang Bat-sua a anak nang babaing Amiel;
At i Ibhar, at i Elisama, at i Elifelet,
At i Noga, at i Nefeg, at i Jafia,
At i Elisama, at i Eliada, at i Elifelet, siam la.
Deti ngan ila ding anak nang lalaking David, makabukud la pa ding anak nang lalaki karing keang babai; at i Tamar ya ing kapatad dang babai.
At ing anak nang lalaking Solomon ya i Rehoboam, i Abias kea yang anak a lalaki, i Asa kea yang anak a lalaki, i Jeosafat kea yang anak a lalaki,
I Joram kea yang anak a lalaki, i Ahazias kea yang anak a lalaki, i Joas kea yang anak a lalaki,
I Amazias kea yang anak a lalaki, i Azarias kea yang anak a lalaki, i Jotam kea yang anak a lalaki,
I Ahaz kea yang anak a lalaki, i Hezequias kea yang anak a lalaki, i Manases kea yang anak a lalaki,
I Amon kea yang anak a lalaki, i Josias kea yang anak a lalaki.
At ding anak nang Josias; ing pangane ya i Joanan, ing kadua ya i Jeoyakim, ing katlu ya i Zedequias, ing kapat ya i Sallum.
At ding anak nang Jeoyakim: i Jeconias a keang anak, i Zedequias a keang anak.
At ding anak nang Jeconias, ing bijag: i Sealtiel a keang anak,
At i Malquiram, at i Pedaya, at i Senazar, i Jekamias, i Hosama, at i Nedabias.
At ding anak nang Pedaya: i Zerubabel, at i Simei. At ding anak nang Zerubabel: i Mesullam, at i Hananias: at i Selomit ya ing kapatad dang babai;
At i Hasuba, at i Ohel, at i Berequias, at i Hasadias, i Jusabhesed, lima la.
At ding anak nang Hananias: i Pelatias, at i Jesaias; ding anak nang Refaias, ding anak nang Arnan, ding anak nang Obadias, ding anak nang Secanias.
At ding anak nang Secanias: i Semaya. At ding anak nang Semaya: i Hatus, at i Igal, at i Barias, at i Nearias, at i Safat, anam la.
At ding anak nang Nearias: i Elioenai, at i Hizquias, at i Azricam, atlu la.
At ding anak nang Elioenai: i Hodavias, at i Eliasib, at i Pelaya, at i Akub, at i Johanan, at i Delaya, at i Anani, pitu la.
Ding anak nang Juda: i Perez, i Hezron, at i Carmi, at i Hur, at i Sobal.
At i Reaya a anak nang Sobal ayanak ne i Jahat; at i Jahat ayanak ne i Ahumai at i Lahad. Deti ilang sapni ra ding Zoratitas.
At deti ila ding anak na ning ibpa nang Etam: i Jezreel, at i Isma, at i Idbas; at ing laguiu na ning kapatad dang babai Hazelelponi;
At i Penuel a ibpa nang Gedor, at i Ezer a ibpa nang Husa. Deti ila ding anak nang Hur, a pangane nang Efrata, a ibpa nang Beth-lehem.
At i Asur a ibpa nang Tecoa atin yang aduang asawa, i Hela at i Naara.
At i Naara penganak ne kea i Ahuzam, at i Hefer, at i Temeni, at i Haahastari. Deti ila ding anak Naara.
At ding anak nang Hela ila pin i Zeret, i Izhar, at i Etnan.
At i Hakoz ayanak ne i Anub, at i Zobeba, at ding sapni nang Aharhel a anak nang Harum.
At i Jabez labis ya dangalan karing kapatad na: at i indu na inaus na ing keang laguiu Jabez, sinabi na, Uling penganak keng kambe ning lugma.

At i Jabez dinalung ya king Dios ning Israel, ngana, Oh mananu sang panuanan mukung tune, at paragulan mu ing kakung angganan, at king ing gamat mu mantabe ya kaku, at king ingatan muku king dewakan, bang e maguing king lugma ku! At pigkalub na kea ning Dios ing keang inawad.
At i Quelub a kapatad nang Suha ayanak ne i Meir, a ya ing ibpa nang Eston.
At i Eston ayanak ne i Bet-rafa, at i Pasea, at i Tehina a ibpa nang Ir-nahas. Deti ila ding lalaki ning Reca.
At ding anak nang Kenaz: i Otniel, at i Seraya. At ding anak nang Otniel: i Hatat.
At i Meonotai ayanak ne i Ofra: at ayanak neng Seraya i Joab a ibpa ra ding Ge-harasim; uling talapangawa la.
At ding anak nang Caleb a anak nang Jefune: i Iru, i Ela, at i Naam; at ding anak nang Ela; at i Kenaz.
At ding anak nang Jehallelel: i Zif, at i Zifa, i Tiria, at i Asarel.
At ding anak nang Ezra: i Jeter, at i Mered, at i Efer, at i Jalon; at penganak ne i Miriam, at i Sami, at i Isba a ibpa nang Estemoa.

At penganak ne ning asawa nang Judia i Jered a ibpa nang Gedor, at i Jeber a ibpa nang Soco, at i Jecutiel a ibpa nang Zanoa. At deti ilang anak nang Bitias a anak nang babaing Faraon, a kinua nang Mered.
At ding anak na ning asawa nang Hodias, a kapatad nang babaing Naham, ya ing ibpa nang Keila a Garmita, at i Estemoa a Maacateo.
At ding anak nang Simon: i Amnon, at i Rina, i Ben-hanan, at i Tilon. At ding anak nang Isi: i Zohet, at i Ben-zohet.
Ding anak nang Sela a anak nang Juda: i Er a ibpa nang Leca, at i Laada a Ibpa nang Maresa, at ding sapni na ning bale ra ding talagawa king imalan a lienzong masinsin, king bale nang Asbea;
At i Jokim, at ding lalaki ning Gozeba, at i Joas, at i Saraf, a ating pamaniakup king Moab, at i Jasubilehem. At ding talajan laun na la.
Deti magtatalu la, at ding manuknangan ning Netaim at ning Gedera: karin la menuknangan a kayabe re ing ari dikil king keang daraptan.
Ding anak nang Simeon: i Nemuel, at i Jamin, i Jarib, i Zera, i Shaul;
I Sallum a keang anak, i Mibsam a keang anak, i Misma a keang anak.
At ding anak nang Misma: i Hamuel a keang anak, i Zacur a keang anak, i Simei a keang anak.
At i Simei atin yang labinganam a anak a lalaki at anam a anak a babai; dapot ding kapatad na ala lang dakal a anak, ni e la merakal man ing mabilug a sapni ra a anti mo ding anak nang Juda.
At menuknangan la king Beer-seba, at king Molada, at king Hazarsual,
At king Bilha, at king Ezem, at king Tolad,
At king Betuel, at king Horma, at king Siclag,
At king Bet-marcabot, at king Hazar-susim, at king Bet-biri, at king Saaraim. Deti ilang ciudad da angga king pamagari nang David.
At ding karelang nayun ila pin ing Etam, at ing Ain, ing Rimon, at ing Toquen, at ing Asan, lima lang ciudad;
At ding anggang nayun da a atiu makapatulug karing ciudad a deti mu rin, angga king Baal. Deti ding meguing tuknangan da, at atin lang pisusulatan karing dai.
At i Mesobab, at i Jamlec, at i Josa a anak nang Amazias,
At i Joel, at i Jehu a anak nang Josibias, a anak nang Seraya, a anak nang Asiel,
At i Elioenai, at i Jaacoba, at i Jesoaya, at i Asaya, at i Adiel, at i Jesimiel, at i Benaya,
At i Ziza a anak nang Sifi, a anak nang Allon, a anak nang Jedaya, a anak nang Simri, a anak nang Semaya-
Deting mesaglawe laguiu principes la karing karelang sapni: at ding bale ra ding karelang mangatua merakal lang bina.
At mine la king piluluban ning Gedor, angga pin king nangan nang aslagan ning libis, barong ipanintun pastulan ding karelang tupa.
At menakit lang matabang pastulan at mayap, at ing labuad maliwalas, at tajimik, at payapa; uling ding anak nang Ham ilang manuknangan karin king minuna.

At deting makasulat a laguiu dinatang la king kayaldawan nang Hezequias a ari ning Juda, at sigatan nala ding karelang kubu, at ding Meunim a meakit karin, at sinintang dong lubus angga king aldo ngeni, at menuknangan lang kalili ra; uling ating pastulan karin dikil karing karelang kawan a tupa.

At ding mapilan karela, karing anak na ping Simeon, lima lang dalan a lalaki, mine la king bunduk ning Seir, a ding karelang capitan i Pelatias, at i Nearias, at i Refaias, at i Uziel, a anak nang Isi.
At sinugat dala ding mitagan karing Amalecitas a mitakas, at menuknangan la karin angga king aldo ngeni.

At ding anak nang Reuben a pangane nang Israel (uling ya ing pangane; dapot anti na ning dinatan ne ing pagkeran nang ibpa na, miabie ing katuliran nang pangapangane karing anak nang Jose a anak nang Israel; at king pisusulatan karing dai e karampatan ibilang tungkul king pangapangane.
Uling i Juda minyaul ya karing keang kapatad, at menibatan ya kea ing principe; dapot ing pangapangane kang kang Jose),
Ding anak nang Reuben a pangane nang Israel: i Hanoc, at i Pallu, i Hezron, at i Carmi.
Ding anak nang Joel: i Semaya a keang anak, i Gog a keang anak, i Simei a keang anak,
I Mica a keang anak, i Reaia a keang anak, i Baal a keang anak,
I Beera a keang anak, a binijag nang Tilgat-pilneser a ari ning Asiria: ya ing principe karing Reubenitas.
At ding kapatad na king pamamilatan ding karelang sapni, inyang ing pisusulatan karing karelang dai mesiasat ya: ing pekabuntuk, ya i Jeiel, at i Zacarias,
At i Bela a anak nang Azaz, a anak nang Sema, a anak nang Joel, a menuknangan king Aroer, angga pin king Nebo at king Baal-meon:
At nangan king aslagan munuknangan ya angga pin king piluluban na ning ilang manibatan king ilug ning Eufrates, uling ding karelang animal merakal la king labuad na ning Gilead.

At karing kayaldawan nang Saul, mekipamuk la karing Agarenos, a menabu la king pamamilatan na ning karelang gamat; at menuknangan la karing karelang kubu king mabilug a labuad na ning aslagan ning Gilead.
At ding anak nang Gad menuknangan la king tulid da, king labuad na ning Basan angga king Saleca:
I Joel a pekabuntuk, at i Safam ya ing kadua, at i Janai, at i Safat king Basan.
At ding karelang kapatad karing bale ra ding karelang mangatua: i Micael, at i Mesullam, at i Sheba, at i Jorai, at i Jacan, at i Zia, at i Eber, pitu la.
Deti ilang anak nang Abihail, a anak nang Huri, a anak nang Jaroa, a anak nang Gilead, a anak nang Micael, a anak nang Jesisai, a anak nang Jado, a anak nang Buz;
I Ahi a anak nang Abdiel, a anak nang Guni, a pekabuntuk karing bale ra ding keang mangatua.
At menuknangan la king Gilead king Basan, at karing keang balen, at karing anggang kapanguluan ning Saron, angga karing karelang angganan.
Deti ngan makatala la karing pisusulatan ding dai karing kayaldawan nang Jotam a ari ning Juda, at karing kayaldawan nang Jeroboam a ari ning Israel.

Ding anak nang Reuben, at ding Gaditas, at ding kapitna nang daing Manases, a bayaning lalaki, lalaking makapagdalang kalasag at talibung, at makabugnus king bai, at maguematan king pamakipamuk, apat lang pulu at apat a libu pitung dalan at anamapulu, a malyaring milual king pamakipamuk.
At mekipamuk la karing Agarenos, a kayabe nang Jetur, at i Nafis, at i Nodab.

At seupan dalang salang karela, at ding Agarenos miabie la king karelang gamat, at ding anggang kayabe ra; uling dinalung la king Dios king labanan, at apausigan de karela, uling binili ra ing kapanaligan da kea.
At dela rala ding karelang animal; karing karelang camello limangpulung libu, at karing tupa aduang dalan at limangpulung libu, at karing asno aduang libu, at karing tau dinalan a libu.
Uling dakal la ding miragsa a mete, uling ing pamipamuk king Dios. At menuknangan la king karelang karinan angga king pangabijag.
At ding anak da ding kapitna nang daing Manases menuknangan la king labuad: merakal la manibat king Basan angga king Baal-hermon at king Senir at king bunduk na ning Hermon.

At deni ilang pekabuntuk da ding bale ra ding karelang mangatua: i Efer pin, at i Isi, at i Eliel, at i Azriel, at i Jeremias, at i Hodavias, at i Jadiel, masikanan a lalaki ning tapang, bantug a lalaki, pekabuntuk karing bale ra ding karelang mangatua.
At sinalangsang la salang king Dios da ding karelang mangatua, at memialung la king pangapatutut agpang karing dioses da ding balayan ning labuad, a lesakan na ning Dios king arapan da.

At inaguiag ne ning Dios ning Israel ing espiritu nang Pul a ari ning Asiria, at ing espiritu nang Tilgat-pilneser a ari ning Asiria, at dela nala, ding Reubenitas pin, at ding Gaditas, at ing kapitna ra ding dai nang Manases, at dela no angga king Hala, at king Habor, at king Hara, at king ilug ning Gozan, angga king aldo a iti.
Ding anak nang Levi: i Gerson, i Coat, at i Merari.
At ding anak nang Coat: i Amram, i Izar, at i Hebron, at i Uziel.
At ding anak nang Amram: i Aaron, at i Moises, at i Miriam. At ding anak nang Aaron: i Nadab, at i Abiu, i Eleazar, at i Itamar.
I Eleazar ayanak ne i Fineas, i Fineas ayanak ne i Abisua,
At i Abisua ayanak ne i Buki, at i Buki ayanak ne i Uzi,
At i Uzi ayanak ne i Zeraias at i Zeraias ayanak ne i Meraiot,
I Meraiot ayanak ne i Amarias, at i Amarias ayanak ne i Ahitub,
At i Ahitub ayanak ne i Zadoc, at i Zadoc ayanak ne i Ahimaaz,
At i Ahimaaz ayanak ne i Azarias, at i Azarias ayanak ne i Joanan,
At i Joanan ayanak ne i Azarias (ya ing darapat king katungkulan a pangasacerdote king bale a telakad nang Solomon king Jerusalem),
At ayanak neng Azarias i Amarias, ta i Amarias ayanak ne i Ahitub,
At i Ahitub ayanak ne i Zadoc, at i Zadoc ayanak ne i Sallum,
At i Sallum ayanak ne i Hilcias, at i Hilcias ayanak ne i Azarias,
At i Azarias ayanak ne i Seraya, at i Seraya ayanak ne i Jeosadac;
At i Jeosadac linub ya king pangabijag, inyang dalan ning GUINU ing Juda at ing Jerusalem king pamamilatan ning gamat nang Nabucodonosor.
Ding anak nang Levi: i Gersom, i Coat, at i Merari.
At deti ila ding laguiu ra ding anak nang Gersom: i Libni at i Simei.
At ding anak nang Coat ila pin i Amram, at i Izar, at i Hebron, at i Uziel.
Ding anak nang Merari: i Mali at i Musi. At deti ilang sapni ra ding Levitas agpang karing bale ra ding karelang mangatua.
Kang Gersom: i Libni a keang anak, i Jahat a keang anak, i Zimma a keang anak,
I Joa a keang anak, i Iddo a keang anak, i Zera a keang anak, i Jeaterai a keang anak.
Ding anak nang Coat: i Aminadab a keang anak, i Core a keang anak, i Asir a keang anak,
I Elcana a keang anak, at i Ebiasaf a keang anak, at i Asir a keang anak,
I Tahat a keang anak, i Uriel a keang anak, i Uzias a keang anak, at i Shaul a keang anak.
At ding anak nang Elcana: i Amasai, at i Ahimot.
At tungkul kang Elcana, ding anak nang Elcana: i Sofai a keang anak, at i Nahat a keang anak.
I Eliab a keang anak, i Jeroham a keang anak, i Elcana a keang anak.
At ding anak nang Samuel: ing pangane, i Joel, at ing pangadua i Abias.
Ding anak nang Merari: i Mali, i Libni a keang anak, i Simei a keang anak, i Uza a keang anak,
I Simea a keang anak, i Hagia a keang anak, i Asaya a keang anak.
At deti ila ding binili nang David king kasuyuwan king dalit king bale ning GUINU, kaibat nang mipainawa ning kaban.

At menibala la king pamamilatan na ning dalit king arapan na ning tabernaculo ning kubu ning pamitipun, angga king telakad neng Solomon ing bale ning GUINU king Jerusalem: at tinupad la king karelang katungkulan agpang king karelang pamialialili.
At deti ilang sinuyu, at ding karelang anak. Karing anak da ding Coatitas: i Heman a taladalit, a anak nang Joel, a anak nang Samuel,
A anak nang Elcana, a anak nang Jeroham, a anak nang Eliel, a anak nang Toa,
A anak nang Zuf, a anak nang Elcana, a anak nang Mahat, a anak nang Amasai,
A anak nang Elcana, a anak nang Joel, a anak nang Azarias, a anak nang Zofanias,
A anak nang Tahat, a anak nang Asir, a anak nang Ebiasaf, a anak nang Core,
A anak nang Izar, a anak nang Coat, a anak nang Levi, a anak nang Israel.
At ing kapatad nang i Asaf, a ya ing tinalakad king dane nang wanan, i Asaf pin a anak nang Berequias, a anak nang Simea,
A anak nang Micael a anak nang Baaseya, a anak nang Malquias,
A anak nang Etni, a anak nang Zera, a anak nang Adaya,
A anak nang Etan, a anak nang Zima, a anak nang Simei,
A anak nang Jahat, a anak nang Gersom, a anak nang Levi.
At king dane rang kaili ding karelang kapatad a anak nang Merari: i Etan a anak nang Quisi, a anak nang Abdi, a anak nang Malluc,
A anak nang Hasabias, a anak nang Amazias, a anak nang Hilcias,
Ing anak nang Amzi, a anak nang Bani, a anak nang Semer,
A anak nang Mali, a anak nang Musi, a anak nang Merari, a anak nang Levi.
At ding kapatad da a Levitas mitulduan la dikil king anggang kasuyuwan king tabernaculo ning bale na ning Dios.

Dapot i Aaron at ding keang anak minain la king babo na ning altar king ain a durulukan, at king babo na ning altar ning labun, dikil king anggang daraptan king kabanalbanalan a karinan, at bang dapat pamisut dikil king Israel, agpang king anggang inutus nang Moises a talasuyu na ning Dios.
At deti ilang anak nang Aaron: i Eleazar a keang anak, i Fineas a keang anak i Abisua a keang anak,
I Buki a keang anak, i Uzzi a keang anak i Abisua a keang anak,
I Meraiot a keang anak, i Amarias a keang anak, i Ahitub a keang anak,
I Zadoc a keang anak, i Ahimaaz a keang anak.

Ngeni oreni ding tuknangan dang karinan agpang karing karelang pamanalakad karing karelang angganan: karing anak nang Aaron, a atiu karing sapni ra ding Coatitas (uling ing karela ya ing mumunang kalma),
Karela binie ra ing Hebron king labuad na ning Juda, at ding kapanguluan na niti king makapatulug;
Dapot ding marangle na ning ciudad, at ding nayun na niti, binie ro kang Caleb a anak nang Jefune.
At karing anak nang Aaron binie ro ding ciudad a piampunan, ing Hebron; ing Libna man pati na ding keang kapanguluan, at ing Jatir, at ing Estemoa pati na ding keang kapanguluan,
At ing Hilen pati na ding keang kapanguluan, ing Debir pati na ding keang kapanguluan,
At ing Asan pati na ding keang kapanguluan, at ing Bet-semes pati na ding keang kapanguluan;

At king dai nang Benjamin, ing Geba pati na ding keang kapanguluan, at ing Allemet pati na ding keang kapanguluan, at ing Anatot pati na ding keang kapanguluan. Ding anggang ciudad da karing sapni ra labi lang atlung ciudad.
At karing makatagan a anak nang Coat miabie la king kalma, a ibat king sapni na ning dai, a ibat king kapitnang dai, ing capitna nang Manases, ding apulung ciudad.

At karing anak nang Gersom, agpang karing karelang sapni, ibat king dai nang Isacar, at ibat king dai nang Aser, at ibat king dai nang Naftali, at ibat king dai nang Manases king Basan, ding labingatlung ciudad.

Karing anak nang Merari miabie la king pamamilatan na ning pamipaningalma, agpang karing karelang sapni, ibat king dai nang Reuben, at ibat king dai nang Gad, at ibat king dai nang Zabulon, ding labingaduang ciudad.
At ding anak na ning Israel binie ro karing Levitas ding ciudad pati na ding karelang kapanguluan.

At binie ro king pamamilatan na ning pamipaningalma ibat king dai ra ding anak nang Juda, at ibat king dai ra ding anak nang Simeon, at ibat king dai ra ding anak nang Benjamin, ding ciudad a deti a mesaglawe laguiu.
At ding mapilan karing sapni ra ding anak nang Coat atin lang ciudad king karelang angganan a ibat king dai nang Efraim.
At binie ro karela ding ciudad a piampunan, ing Siquem king karinan a bunduk-bundukan ning Efraim pati na ding keang kapanguluan; ing Gezer man pati na ding keang kapanguluan,
At i Jocmeam pati na ding keang kapanguluan, at ing Bet-horon pati na ding keang kapanguluan,
At ing Aijalon pati na ding keang kapanguluan, at ing Gat-rimon pati na ding keang kapanguluan;
At ibat king kapitna nang daing Manases, ing Aner pati na ding keang kapanguluan, at ing Bileam pati na ding keang kapanguluan, dikil king makatagan king sapni ra ding anak nang Coat.
Karing anak nang Gersom miabie la, ibat king sapni ra ding kapitna nang daing Manases, ing Golan king Basan pati na ding keang kapanguluan, at ing Astarot pati na ding keang kapanguluan;
At ibat king dai nang Isacar, ing Cades pati na ding keang kapanguluan, ing Daberat pati na ding keang kapanguluan,
At ing Ramot pati na ding keang kapanguluan, at i Anem pati na ding keang kapanguluan;
At ibat king dai nang Aser, ing Masal pati na ding keang kapanguluan, at ing Abdon pati na ding keang kapanguluan,
At ing Hucoc pati na ding keang kapanguluan, at ing Rehob pati na ding keang kapanguluan;
At ibat king dai nang Naftali, ing Cades king Galilea pati na ding keang kapanguluan, at ing Hamon pati na ding keang kapanguluan, at ing Kiriat-aim pati na ding keang kapanguluan.
Karing mitagan karing Levitas, ding anak nang Merari, miabie la, ibat king dai nang Zabulon, ing Rimono pati na ding keang kapanguluan, ing Tabor pati na ding keang kapanguluan;

At king nangan na karin ning Jordan king Jerico, king nangan aslagan ning Jordan, miabie la karela, ibat king dai nang Reuben, ing Bezer king ilang pati na ding keang kapanguluan, at ing Jaza pati na ding keang kapanguluan,
At ing Quedemot pati na ding keang kapanguluan, at ing Mefaat pati na ding keang kapanguluan;
At ibat king dai nang Gad, ing Ramot king Gilead pati na ding keang kapanguluan, at ing Mahanaim pati na ding keang kapanguluan,
At ing Hesbon pati na ding keang kapanguluan, at ing Jazer pati na ding keang kapanguluan.
At karing anak nang Isacar: i Tola, at i Pua, i Jasub, at i Simron, apat la.

At ding anak nang Tola: i Uzzi, at i Refaya, at i Jeriel, at i Jamai, at i Ibsam, at i Semuel, pekabuntuk la karing bale ra ding karelang mangatua, nanan ta, kang Tola; masikanan lang lalaki ning tapang karing karelang dai: ing bilang da karing kayaldawan nang David aduangpulu at aduang libu at anam a dalan.
At ding anak nang Uzzi: i Izrahias. At ding anak nang Izrahias: i Micael, at i Obadias, at i Joel, i Isias, lima la; ila ngan lalaki lang pekapun.

At kayabe ra, agpang karing karelang dai, agpang karing bale ra ding karelang mangatua, tapuk la king ejercito tungkul king pamakipamuk, atlu lang pulu at anam a libu; uling atin lang dakal a asawa at anak.
At ding kapatad da karing anggang sapni nang Isacar, a masikanan lang lalaki ning tapang, a mebilang la ngan agpang king pisusulatan karing dai, walu lang pulu at pitung libu.
Ding anak nang Benjamin: i Bela, at i Bequer, at i Jediael, atlu la.

At ding anak nang Bela: i Esbon, at i Uzzi, at i Uziel, at i Jerimot, at i Iri, lima la; pekabuntuk la karing bale ra ding mangatua, masikanan lang lalaki ning tapang; at makabilang la agpang king pisusulatan karing dai, adua lang pulu at aduang libu at atlungpulu at apat.
At ding anak nang Bequer: i Zemira, at i Joas, at i Eliezer, at i Elioenai, at i Omri, at i Jeremot, at i Abias, at i Anatot, at i Alamet. Deti ngan ila ding anak nang Bequer.

At makabilang la agpang king pisusulatan karing dai, agpang karing karelang dai, pekabuntuk la karing bale ra ding karelang mangatua, masikanan lang lalaki ning tapang, adua lang pulung libu at aduang dalan.
At ding anak nang Jediael: i Bilhan. At ding anak nang Bilhan: i Jeus, at i Benjamin, at i Ehud, at i Quenaana, at i Zetan, at i Tarsis, at i Ahisahar.

Deti ngan anak nong Jediael, agpang karing pekabuntuk karing bale ra ding karelang mangatua, masikanan lang lalaki ning tapang, labi lang pitung libu at lalaki ning tapang, labi lang pitung libu at aduang dalan, ding malyaring lual king ejercito bang makipamuk.
I Supim man, at i Hupim, a anak nang Ir, i Husim, a anak nang Aher.
Ding anak nang Naftali: i Jaziel, at i Guni, at i Jezer, at i Sallum, a anak nang Bilha.
Ding anak nang Manases: i Asriel, ya ing penganak na ning keang babai a Aramita; penganak ne i Maquir a ibpa nang Gilead.
At i Maquir kinanua yang asawa kang Hupim at kang Supim, a ing laguiu na ning keang kapatad a babai Maaca; at ing laguiu na ning kadua Zelofehad: at i Zelofehad menganak yang babai.
At i Maaca a asawa nang Maquir menganak yang metung a lalaki, at inaus ne ing keang laguiu Peres; at ing laguiu na ning kapatad nang lalaki Seres; at ding anak nang lalaki ila pin i Ulam at i Raquem.
At ding anak nang Ulam: i Bedan. Deti ilang anak nang Gilead a anak nang Maquir, a anak nang Manases.
At ing kapatad nang babai i Hamolequet penganak ne i Ishod, at i Abiezer, at i Mila.
At ding anak nang Semida ila pin i Ahian, at i Siquem, at i Likhi, at i Aniam.
At ding anak nang Efraim: i Sutela, at i Bered a anak nang lalaki, at i Tahat a anak na, at i Eleada a anak na, at i Tahat a keang anak,
At i Zabad a keang anak, at i Sutela a keang anak, at i Ezer, at i Elead, a ilang pete ra ding lalaki ning Gat a bait king labuad, uling kinuldas la barong dalan ilako ding karelang animal.
At i Efraim a ibpa ra migpaldas yang dakal a aldo, at dinatang la ding kapatad na bareng patulan.
At linub ya king asawa na, at kinagli ya, at menganak yang metung a lalaki, at inaus na ing laguiu na Beria, uling ing dewakan migbili king keang bale.
At ing keang anak a babai ya i Seera, a ya ing mitalakad king Bet-horon ing king mababa at ing king matas, at ing Uzen-seera.
At i Refa ya ing anak na, at i Resef, at i Tela a keang anak, at i Tahan a keang anak,
I Ladan a keang anak, i Amiud a keang anak, i Elisama a keang anak,
I Nun a keang anak, i Josue a keang anak.

At ding karelang pibandian at ding karelang tuknangan ya ing Betel at ding keang balen, at ing nangan aslagan ya ing Naaran, at ing nangan albugan ya ing Gezer, pati na ding keang balen; ing Siquem man at ding keang balen, angga king Aza at ding balen na niti;

At king siping da ding angganan ding anak nang Manases, ing Bet-sean at ding keang balen, ing Taanac at ding keang balen, ing Megido at ding keang balen, ing Dor at ding keang balen. Kareti karin la menuknangan ding anak nang Jose a anak nang Israel.
Ding anak nang Aser: i Imna, at i Isva, at i Isvi, at i Beria, at i Sera a kapatad dang babai.
At ding anak nang Beria: i Heber, at i Malquiel, a ya ing ibpa nang Birzait.
At i Heber ayanak ne i Jaflet, at i Somer, at i Hotam, at i Sua a kapatad dang babai.
At ding anak nang Jaflet: i Pasac, at i Bimhal, at i Asvat. Deti ilang anak nang Jaflet.
At ding anak nang Semer: i Ahi, at i Roga, i Jehuba, at i Aram.
At ding anak nang Helem a kapatad nang lalaki: i Sofa, at i Imna, at i Seles, at i Amal.
Ding anak nang Zofa: i Sua, at i Harnefer, at i Sual, at i Beri, at i Imra,
I Bezer, at i Hod, at i Sama, at i Silsa, at i Itran, at i Beera.
At ding anak nang Jeter: i Jefune, at i Pispa, at i Ara.
At ding anak nang Ulla: i Ara, at i Haniel, at i Rizia.

Deti ngan ilang anak nang Aser, a pekabuntuk da ding bale ra ding mangatua, pili at masikanan lang lalaki ning tapang, pekapun dala ding principes. At ing bilang dang mebilang agpang king pisusulatan da ding dai dikil king kasuyuwan king pamakipamuk aduangpulu at anam a libung lalaki.
At i Benjamin ayanak ne i Bela a keang pangane, i Asbel ing kadua, at i Ahara ing katlu,
I Noha ing kapat, at i Rafa ing kalima.
At i Bela atin yang anak a lalaki: i Adar, at i Gera, at i Abiud,
At i Abisua, at i Naaman, at i Ahoa,
At i Gera, at i Sefufan, at i Huram.
At deti ilang anak nang Ehud; deti ilang pekabuntuk karing bale ra ding mangatua ra karing manuknangan king Geba, at dela rong bijag king Manahat.
At i Naaman, at i Ahias, at i Gera, dela nong bijag; at ayanak ne i Uzza at i Ahiud.
At i Saharaim mika anak ya king marangle na ning Moab, kaibat nong pepalakuan; i Husim at i Baara ilang keang asawa.
At ayanak no kang Hodes a keang asawa, i Jobab, at i Zibia, at i Mesa, at i Malcam,
At i Jeuz, at i Saquias, at i Mirma. Deti ilang anak na, a pekabuntuk karing bale ra ding mangatua.
At kang Husim ayanak ne i Abitub at i Elpaal.
At ding anak nang Elpaal: i Eber, at i Misam, at i Semed a ya ing mitalakad king Ono at king Lod, pati na ding balen na niti;
At i Beria, at i Sema, a pekabuntuk karing bale ra ding mangatua karing manuknangan king Aijalon, a ilang pepatakas karing manuknangan king Gat;
At i Ahio, i Sasac, at i Jeremot,
At i Zebadias, at i Arad, at i Eder,
At i Micael, at i Ispa, at i Joha, a anak nang Beria,
At i Zebadias, at i Mesullam, at i Hizki, at i Heber,
At i Ismerai, at i Islia, at i Jobab, a anak nang Elpaal,
At i Jakim, at i Zicri, at i Zabdi,
At i Elienai, at i Zilletai, at i Eliel,
At i Adaya, at i Beraya, at i Simrat, a anak nang Simei,
At i Ispan, at i Eber, at i Eliel,
At i Abdon, at i Zicri, at i Hanan,
At i Hananias, at i Elam, at i Antotias,
At i Ifdeya, at i Penuel, a anak nang Sasac,
At i Samserai, at i Seharias, at i Atalia,
At i Jaaresias, at i Elias, at i Zicri, a anak nang Jeroam.
Deti ilang pekabuntuk karing bale ra ding mangatua karing anggang karelang dai, pekapun lang lalaki; deti menuknangan la king Jerusalem.
At king Gibeon menuknangan ya ing ibpa nang Gibeon, i Jeiel, a ing laguiu na ning keang asawa Maaca;
At ing keang pangane a anak a lalaki i Abdon, at i Zur, at i Cis, at i Baal, at i Nadab,
At i Gedor, at i Ahio, at i Zequer.
At i Miclot ayanak ne i Simea. At deti menuknangan la naman a kayabe ra ding karelang kapatad king Jerusalem, king tulid da ding karelang kapatad.
At ayanak neng Ner i Cis; at i Cis ayanak ne i Saul; at i Saul ayanak ne i Jonatan, at i Malqui-sua, at i Abinadab, at i Es-baal.
At ing anak nang Jonatan ya i Merib-baal; at i Merib-baal ayanak ne i Mica.
At ding anak nang Mica: i Piton, at i Melec, at i Tarea, at i Ahaz.
At i Ahaz ayanak ne i Jeoada; at i Jeoada ayanak ne i Alemet, at i Azmavet, at i Zimri; at i Zimri ayanak ne i Moza.
At i Moza ayanak ne i Binea; i Rafa ya ing keang anak, i Eleasa a keang anak, i Azel a keang anak.
At i Azel atin yang anam a anak a ding karelang laguiu oreni: i Azricam, i Boqueru, at i Ismael, at i Searias, at i Obadias, at i Hanan. Deti ngan ilang anak nang Azel.
At ding anak nang Esec a keang kapatad a lalaki: i Ulam a keang pangane, i Jeus ya ing kadua, at Elifelet ya ing katlu.

At ding anak nang Ulam masikanan lang lalaki ning tapang, mamana, at atin lang dakal a anak a lalaki, at anak a lalaki ding anak a lalaki, a dinalan la at limangpulu. Deti ngan karin lang anak nang Benjamin.

Nanupata ing mabilug a Israel mibilang la agpang king pisusulatan karing dai; at, oreni, makasulat la king libru ra ding ari ning Israel. At ing Juda midala yang bijag king Babilonia king uli ning karelang pamanalangsang.
Ngeni ding minunang manuknangan a menuknangan karing karelang pibandian karing karelang ciudad ila pin ing Israel, ding sacerdotes, ding Levitas, at ding Netinim.
At king Jerusalem menuknangan la ding karing anak nang Juda, at ding karing anak nang Benjamin, at karing anak nang Efraim at Manases:
I Utai a anak nang Amihud, a anak nang Omri, a anak nang Imri, a anak nang Bani, karing anak nang Perez, a anak nang Juda.
At karing Silonitas: i Asaya ing pangane, at ding keang anak.
At karing anak nang Zera: i Jeuel, at ding karelang kapatad, a anam a dalan at siamapulu.
At karing anak nang Benjamin: i Sallu a anak nang Mesullam, a anak nang Hodavias, a anak nang Hasenua,
At i Ibneias a anak nang Jeroham, at i Ela a anak nang Uzzi, a anak nang Micri, at i Mesullam a anak nang Sefatias, a anak nang Reuel, a anak nang Ibnias;
At ding karelang kapatad, agpang karing karelang dai, siam lang dalan limangpulu at anam. Deti ngang lalaki pekabuntuk la karing bale ra ding karelang mangatua karing bale ra ding mangatua.
At karing sacerdotes: i Jedaya, at i Jeoiarib, i Jaquin,
At i Azarias a anak nang Hilcias, a anak nang Mesullam, a anak nang Zadoc, a anak nang Meraiot, a anak nang Ahitub, a talapamajala king bale na ning Dios;
At i Adaya a anak nang Jeroham a anak nang Pashur, a anak nang Malquias, at i Maasai a anak nang Adiel, a anak nang Jazera, a anak nang Mesullam, a anak nang Mesillemit, a anak nang Imer;
At ding karelang kapatad, a pekabuntuk karing bale ra ding karelang mangatua, libu la at pitung dalan at anamapulu; lalaki lang binang biasa king dapat a kasuyuwan king bale na ning Dios.
At karing Levitas: i Semaya a anak nang Hasub, a anak nang Azricam, a anak nang Hasabias, karing anak nang Merari;
At i Bacbakar, i Heres, at i Galal, at i Matanias a anak nang Mica, a anak nang Zicri, a anak nang Azaf,
At i Obadias a anak nang Semaya, a anak nang Galal, a anak nang Jedutun, at i Berequias a anak nang Asa, a anak nang Elcana, a menuknangan karing nayun da ding Netofatitas.
At ding bante pasbul: i Sallum, at i Akub, at i Talmon, at i Ahiman, at ding karelang kapatad (i Sallum ya ing pekapun),
A angga ngeni manatili la king pasbulan dalan na ning ari king nangan aslagan: ila ding bante pasbul dikil king parang da ding anak nang Levi.

At i Sallum a anak nang Core, a anak nang Ebiasaf, a anak nang Cora, at ding kapatad na, king bale na ning keang ibpa, ding Coraitas, atilu king pamamajala king pamaniapat kasuyuwan, a talaingat karing piluluban ning tabernaculo: at ding karelang mangatua meguing atilu king pamamajala king parang ning GUINU, talaingat la king piluluban.
At i Fineas a anak nang Eleazar talapamajala ya karela king panaun a miralan, at Ing GUINU mamantabe ya kea.
I Zacarias a anak nang Meselemias bante ya king pasbul na ning tabernaculo ning pamitipun.

Deting sablang mepili bang maguing bante karing pasbulan adua lang dalan at labingadua. Deti mibilang la king pisusulatan karing dai karing karelang nayun, a i David at i Samuel a talapanakit tituk da king tungkul dang pangakatiwala.
Inya ila at ding karelang anak menibala la a pekabante karing pasbulan dalan na ning bale ning GUINU, ing bale na pin ning tabernaculo, agpang king pamialialili.
Karing apat a nayun karin la ding talapagbante, king nangan aslagan, albugan, paralaya at mauli.
At ding karelang kapatad, karing karelang nayun, kailangan lang daratang king balang kapitung aldo king balang kapanaunan bang mabe karela:
Uling ding apat a pun talapagbante pasbul, a Levitas la, atilu king metung a katungkulan a pangakatiwala, at mamajala la karing silid at mamajala karing pisisinupan pibandian king bale na ning Dios.
At menuknangan la king makapatulug ning bale na ning Dios, uling ing katungkulan karin makatumpak karela; at karela makatutuk ing pamamusni kaniti balang abak.
At ding mapilan karela atin lang katungkulan karing kasangkapan king pamaniapat kasuyuwan; uling milulub la agpang king bilang da deti at milulual la agpang king bilang da deti.
Ding aliwa mu naman karela mitulduan lang mamajala king kasangkapan, at karing anggang kasangkapan ning santuario, at king mapinung arina, at king alak, at king laru, at king labun, at king pabanglu.
At ding mapilan karing anak da ding sacerdotes misadia la king pamipasalingalngal pabanglu.
At i Matitias, a metung karing Levitas, a ya ing pangane nang Sallum a Coraita, atiu king katungkulan a pangakatiwala karang bague a lulutu karing kawali.
At ding mapilan karing karelang kapatad, karing anak da ding Coateos, ilang mamajala king tinape a ain, bang isadia re iti balang sabbath.

At deti ila ding taladalit, a pekabuntuk karing bale ra ding mangatua ra ding Levitas, a manuknangan karing silid at timawa la king aliwang kasuyuwan; uling makabili la king karelang daraptan king aldo at bengi.
Deti ilang pekabuntuk karing bale ra ding mangatua ra ding Levitas, king kabilugan ning karelang dai, karing lalaking pekapun: deti menuknangan la king Jerusalem.
At king Gibeon menuknangan ya i ibpa nang Gibeon, i Jeiel, a ing laguiu na ning keang asawa Maaca;
At ing pangane nang anak a lalaki i Abdon, at i Zur, at i Cis, at i Baal, at i Ner, at i Nadab,
At i Gedor, at i Ahio, at i Zacarias, at i Miclot.
At i Miclot ayanak ne i Simeam. At ila menuknangan la naman king Jerusalem a kayabe ro ding karelang kapatad, king tulid da ding karelang kapatad.
At i Ner ayanak ne i Cis; at i Cis ayanak ne i Saul, at i Saul ayanak ne i Jonatan, at i Malquisua, at i Abinadab, at i Esbaal.
At ing anak nang Jonatan ya i Merib-baal; at i Merib- baal ayanak ne i Mica.
At ding anak nang Mica: i Piton, at i Melec, at i Tarea, at i Ahaz.
At i Ahaz ayanak ne i Jara; at i Jara ayanak ne i Elemet, at i Azmavet, at i Zimri; at i Zimri ayanak ne i Moza;
At i Moza ayanak ne i Binea; at i Refaya a keang anak, i Eleasa a keang anak, i Azel a keang anak.
At i Azel mika atin yang anam a anak a lalaki, a ding karelang laguiu ila deti: i Azricam, i Boqueru, at i Ismael, at i Searia, at i Obadias, at i Hanan: deti ilang anak nang Azel.
Ngeni ding Filisteos mekipamuk lang salang king Israel: at tinakas la ding lalaki ning Israel ibat king arapan da ding Filisteos, at miragsa lang mengamate king bunduk na ning Gilboa.
At ding Filisteos tinuki lang masipit king gugulutan nang Saul at king gugulutan ding keang anak; at pete re ding Filisteos i Jonatan, at i Abinadab, at i Malqui-sua, a anak nang Saul.
At ing labanan metalik a bina salang kang Saul, at atagal de ding mamana; at megutgut ya king uli ra ding mamana.

Kanita sinabi nang Saul king keang talapagdalang sandata, Bagutan me ing kekang talibung, at saksakanan muku kaniti, magkang ding e tuling deti datang la at daptananan dakung milalu. Dapot e mebisa ing keang talapagdalang sandata; uling bina yang mitakutan. Inya pin kinua neng Saul ing keang talibung, at pepairagsa ya kaniti.
At inyang ikit na ning keang talapagdalang sandata king i Saul mete ya, ya man pepairagsa ya king keang talibung, at mete ya.
Makanian yang mete i Saul, at ding atlu nang anak; at ing keang mabilug a bale mete a miabeabe.

At inyang akit da ding anggang lalaki ning Israel a atiu king libis king tinakas la, at king i Saul at ding keang anak mete la, pepaimburisan do ding karelang ciudad, at tinakas la; at ding Filisteos dinatang la at menuknangan la kareti.
At milyari panga kabukasan, inyang mine la ding Filisteos barong lubasan ding mete, king ikit de i Saul at ding keang anak miragsa la king bunduk ning Gilboa.
At libasan de, at kinua re ing keang buntuk, at ing keang sandata, at peparala re king labuad da ding Filisteos king makapatulug, barang dalan ing balita karing karelang idolos, at king balayan.
At binili re ing sandata na king bale ra ding karelang dioses, at pinaku re ing keang buntuk king bale nang Dagon.
At inyang damdaman na ning mabilug a Jabes-gilead ing anggang depatan da ding Filisteos kang Saul,

Ding anggang matapang a lalaki tinalakad la, at kinua re ing katawan nang Saul, at ding katawan da ding keang anak, at dela ro king Jabes, at kitkut do ding karelang butul king lalam na ning encina king Jabes, at migayunu lang pitung aldo.

Makanian yang mete i Saul king uli ning keang pamanalangsang a keang kimtan a salang king GUINU, uli ning amanu ning GUINU, a e na iningat; at king uli na naman ning kinanua yang usuk king metung a ating espiritung marawak, bayang mangutang kea,
At e ya mengutang king GUINU: inya pin pete ne, at linipat na ing kayarian kang David a anak nang Isai.
Kanita mitipun ing mabilug a Israel kang David king Hebron, a sinabi ra, Oini, butul mukami at laman mukami.

King panaun a milabas, kanitang ari ya pa pin i Saul, ika ing milulual at milulub king Israel: at Ing GUINU a kekang Dios sinabi na keka, Maguing pastul ka king kakung balayan Israel, at maguing principe ka king kakung balayan Israel.

Inya ding anggang makatua ning Israel dinatang la king ari king Hebron; at i David guinawa yang tipan karela king Hebron king arapan ning GUINU; at linian de i David a magari king Israel, agpang king amanu ning GUINU king pamamilatan nang Samuel.
At i David at ing mabilug a Israel mine Jerusalem (a ya naman ing Jebus); at ding Jebuseos, a manuknangan king labuad, atilu karin.
At sinabi ra ding manuknangan king Jebus kang David, Ika e ka milub keti. Makanian man kinua nang David ing kutang matibe ning Zion; a ya naman ing ciudad nang ciudad nang David.
At sinabi nang David, Ninumang munang sumugat karing Jebuseos maguing pekapun ya at capitan. At i Joab a anak nang Zeruia ya ing sinampang minuna, at meguing pekapun ya.
At menuknangan ya i David king kutang matibe; uli na nita inaus deng ing ciudad nang David.
At telakad ne ing ciudad king makapatulug, manibat king Millo king makapatulug pin; at lerinan nang Joab ing mitagan king ciudad.
At i David mirangal neng mirangal; uling Ing GUINU ra ding ejercitos mamantabe ya kea.

Ngeni deti ilang pekapun da ding masikanan a lalaki a atiu kang David, a masikan pepakit kea king keang kayarian, pati na ing mabilug a Israel, bareng gawan ari, a makayagpang king amanu ning GUINU tungkul king Israel.

At oiti ing bilang da ding masikanan a lalaki a atiu kang David: i Jasobeam, a anak nang na ning metung a Hecmonita, a pekapun da ding atlungpulu; tinas ne ing keang tandus salang karing atlung dalan at pete no king misan mung ukdu.
At kaibat na ya i Eleazar a anak nang Dodo, a Ahohita, a metung karing atlung masikanan a lalaki.

Kayabe neng David king Pasdamim, at karin ding Filisteos mitipun lang makapamisan balang makipamuk, king nung nu ating metung a dake a gabun a mitmung cebada; at ing balayan tinakas ibat king arapan da ding Filisteos.
At tinalakad la king libutad na ning kapising gabun, at pinlualu re, at pete rala ding Filisteos; at linigtas nong GUINU king metung a maragul a pamagtagumpe.
At ding atlu karing atlungpulung pekapun kinuldas la king roca kang David, king lukib na ning Adullam; at ing ejercito ra ding Filisteos menalakad la king libis na ning Refaim.
At i David atiu kanita king kutang matibe, at ing ejercito ra ding Filisteos atiu kanita king Beth-lehem.
At i David mengisnawa yang saldak, at sinabi na, Oh atin sang metung mu mang munie kanaku king danum bang ainum ku king talaga na ning Beth-lehem, a atiu king siping ning pasbulan dalan!

At ding atlu sinagasa la king ejercito ra ding Filisteos, at sinaklu la king danum na ning talaga ning Bethlehem, a atiu king siping ning pasbulan dalan, at kinua ra iti, at dela ra iti kang David: dapot e mininum i David kaniti, nung e bilus na dikil king GUINU,

At sinabi na, E na itulut kanaku ning kakung Dios, a daptan ku iti: inuman ku wari ing daya ra ding lalaking deti a binili ra ing bie ra king panganeb? uling king ikapajamak ning bie ra karelang dela iti. Inya pin e na ininum iti. Ding bague a deti depatan dala ding atlung masikanan a lalaki.
At i Abisai, a kapatad nang Joab, ya ing pekapun da ding atlu; uling tinas ne ing keang tandus salang karing atlung dalan at pete nala, at mika atin yang metung a laguiu karing atlu.
Karing atlu, lalu yang mapuri a maiguit karing adua, at megawa yang capitan da: makanian man e ya miabut karing minunang atlu.

I Benaya a anak nang Jeoiada, a anak na ning metung a lalaking matapang karin king Cabzeel, a dinapat king mangasikanan a dapat, pete nala ding adua nang anak Ariel ning Moab: kinuldas ya naman at mekamate yang metung a leon king libutad na ning metung a kulkul king panaun na ning nieve.

At pete ne ing tau Egipto, metung yang lalaking maragul a tubu, lima yang siku king katas; at king gamat na ning tau Egipto atiu ing metung a tandus a anti mo ing pabakle na ning mamabal; at kildasan ne a maki metung a tukud, at simsam ne king gamat na ning Egipcio ing tandus, at pete ne king keang sariling tandus.
