Ding bague a deti depatan nong Benaya a anak nang Jeoiada, at mika atin yang metung a laguiu karing atlung masikanan a lalaki.
Oini, lalu yang mapuri a maiguit karing atlungpulu, dapot karing mumunang atlu e ya miabut: at binili neng David a mamajala karing keang bante.
Anti naman ding masikanan a lalaki ding ejercitos: i Asael a kapatad nang Joab, i Elhanan a anak nang Dodo ning Beth-lehem,
I Samot a Harorita, i Helez a Pelonita,
I Ira a anak nang Ikes a Tecoita, i Abiezer a Anatotita,
I Sibecai a Husatita, i Ilai a Ahoita,
I Maharai a Netofatita, i Heled a anak nang Baana a Netofatita,
I Itai a anak nang Ribai ning Gibea karing anak nang Benjamin, i Benaya a Piratonita,
I Hurai karing batis na ning Gaas, i Abiel a Arbatita,
I Asmavet a Baharumita, i Eliaba a Saalbonita,
Ding anak nang Hasem a Gizonita, i Jonatan a anak nang Sagee a Hararita,
I Ahiam a anak nang Sacar a Hararita, i Elifal a anak nang Ur,
I Hefer a Mequeratita, i Ahias a Pelonita,
I Hezro a Carmelita, i Naarai a anak nang Ezbai,
I Joel a kapatad nang Natan, i Mibhar a anak nang Hagri,
I Zelec a Ammonita, i Naarai a Berotita, talapagdala neng sandatang Joab a anak nang Zeruia,
I Ira a Itrita, i Gareb a Itrita,
I Urias a Heteo, i Zabad a anak nang Alai,
I Adina a anak nang Siza a Reubenita, metung yang pekapun da ding Reubenitas, at kayabe nala ding atlungpulu,
I Hanan a anak nang Maaca, at i Josafat a Mitnita,
I Uzias a Asteratita, i Sama at i Jeiel a anak nang Hotam a Aroerita,
I Jediael a anak nang Simri, at i Joha a kapatad nang lalaki, a Tizita,
I Eliel a Mahavita, at i Jeribai, at i Josavia, a anak nang Elnaam, at i Itma a Moabita,
I Eliel, at i Obed, at i Jaasiel a Mezobaita.
Ngeni deti ilang dinatang kang David king Siclag, kabang sasalikut ya king uli nang Saul a anak nang Cis; at ila makayabe la karing masikanan a lalaki, a keang kasaup king pamakipamuk.

Makasandata lang bai, at malyari reng gamitan ing wanan a gamat at ing kaili king pamamugnus batu king honda at king pamamugnus karing uyung manibat king bai: deti atilu karing kapatad nang Saul kang Benjamin.
Ing pekapun ya i Ahiezer; tutuki i Joas, a anak nang Semaa a Gibeatita, at i Jeziel, at i Pelet, a anak nang Azmavet, at i Beraca, at i Jehu a Anatotita,
At i Ismaias a Gibeonita, metung yang masikanan a lalaki karing atlungpulu, a mamajala karing atlungpulu, at i Jeremias, at i Jahaziel, at i Johanan, at i Jozabad a Gederatita,
I Eluzai, at i Jerimot, at i Bealias, at i Semarias, at i Sefatias a Harufita,
I Elcana, at i Isias, at i Azarel, at i Jeezer, at i Jasobeam, a Coraitas,
At i Joela, at i Zebadias, a anak nang Jeroham ning Gedor.

At karing Gaditas kinawani la a mekiabe kang David king kutang matibe king ilang, masikanan lang lalaki ning tapang, lalaki lang mipabiasnan king pamakipamuk, a makatalan kalasag at tandus; a ding karelang lupa anti la mo ding lupa ra ding leon, at mangasalusu lang anti mong usa karing babo bunduk:
I Eser ya ing pekapun, i Obadias ya ing kadua, i Eliab ya ing katlu,
I Mismana ya ing kapat, i Jeremias ya ing kalima,
I Atai ya ing kanam, i Eliel ya ing kapitu,
I Joanan ya ing kawalu, i Elzabad ya ing kasiam,
I Jeremias ya ing kapulu, i Macbanai ya ing kalabing metung.
Deti ila ding anak nang Gad a capitan ning ejercito: ing malating dili katimbang yang dinalan, at ing maragul dili katimbang yang libu.

Deti ila ding dinalakit king Jordan king mumunang bulan, inyang lumapo ya karing sabla nang pampang; at pepatakasan dala ding anggang atiu karing libis, ding king nangan aslagan at makanian mu naman ding king nangan albugan.
At ating dinatang karing anak nang Benjamin at Juda king kutang matibe kang David.

At i David linual yang seganan nala, at mekibat ya at sinabi na karela, Nung ikayu dinatang ko keting payapa kanaku bang sumaup ko kaku, ing kanakung pusu makisugue ya kekayu; dapot nung dinatang kayu bang pagtaksilan yuku karing kakung kasalang, akakit yung alang dewakan karing kakung gamat, lawan na ning Dios da ding kekatang mangatua, at sabianan na iti.

Kanita ing Espiritu dinatang ya kang Amasal, a ya ing pekapun da ding atlungpulu, at sinabi na, Keka kami, David, at king dane mu, ika a anak nang Isai: kapayapan, kapayapan keka, at kapayapan karing talasaup mu; uling ing kekang Dios sasaupan naka. Kanita tinggap nong David, at guewa nong capitan king tapuk.

Karin mang kang Manases ating mapilan a kinawaning mekiabe kang David, inyang miras ya a kayabe no ding Filisteos salang kang Saul bang makilaban: dapot e ro seupan; uling ding guinu ra ding Filisteos king kausukan pepalakuan de, ngara, Menabu ya king keang guinung i Saul king ikapajamak da ding kekatang buntuk.
Inyang ume ya king Siclag, menabu la kea karing kang Manases, i Adna, at i Jozabad, at i Jediael, at i Micael, at i Jozabad, at i Eliu, at i Zilletai, a capitan karing libu-libu, karing kang Manases.
At sinaup la kang David salang king tapuk ding tulisan: uling ila ngan masikanan lang lalaki ning tapang, at capitan la king ejercito.
Uling aldo-aldo ding lalaki daratang la kang David bareng saupan, angga king meguing maragul yang ejercito, anti mo ing ejercito na ning Dios.
At deti ila ding bilang da ding karelang pekabuntuk ding sandatajan dikil king pamipamuk, a dinatang kang David king Hebron, barang ibantiwas kea ing kayarian nang Saul, agpang king amanu ning GUINU.
Ding anak nang Juda a tinalan kalasag at tandus anam lang libu at walung dalan, a ating sandata dikil king pamipamuk.
Karing anak nang Simeon, masikanan lang lalaki ning tapang dikil king pamipamuk, pitu lang libu at dinalan.
Karing anak nang Levi apat lang libu at anam a dalan.
At i Jeoiada ya ing talataid ning bale nang Aaron; at ding kayabe na atlu lang libu at pitung dalan.
At i Zadoc, a metung a kayanakan a lalaking masikanan a ating tapang, at king bale na ning keang ibpa adua lang pulu at aduang capitan.
At karing anak nang Benjamin, ding kapatad nang Saul, atlu lang libu: uling ding keraklan karela iningat da ing pamipasakup da king bale nang Saul.
At karing anak nang Efraim adua lang pulung libu at walung dalan, a masikanan lang lalaki ning tapang, bantug lang lalaki karing bale ra ding karelang mangatua.
At king kapitna nang daing Manases labi lang walung libu, a mebangguit a laguiu, balang datang at gawan deng ari i David.

At karing anak nang Isacar, lalaki lang maki pamanalastas king panaun, barang pakibaluan nung nanu ing karampatan nang daptan ning Israel, ding pekabuntuk karela adua lang dalan; at ding anggang kapatad da atilu king karelang utus.

Kang Zabulon, detang malyaring milual king ejercito, a makapiayus king pamipamuk, a ating sarisaring kasangkapan king pamipamuk, a limangpulung libu, at ding makautus king makaayus a pamipamuk, at e la karing adua pilubluban.
At kang Naftali libu lang capitan, at ding kayabe ra a ating kalasag at tandus atlu lang pulu at pitung libu.
At karing Danitas ding malyaring makapiayus king pamipamuk adua lang pulu at walung libu at anam a dalan.
At kang Aser, detang malyaring milual king ejercito, a malyaring makapiayus king pamipamuk, apat lang pulung libu.

At king kangatba na ning Jordan, karing Reubenitas, at karing Gaditas, at king kapitna nang daing Manases, a kagum ding sarisaring kasangkapan king pamipamuk dikil king labanan, dinalan la at aduangpulung libu.

Deting sabla, anti ning lalaki la king pamipamuk, a makautus king makaayus a pamipamuk, dinatang la king Hebron a ating sakdal a pusu, bareng gawan ari i David king mabilug a Israel: at ding anggang mitagan naman king Israel mikametung la lub bareng gawan ari i David.
At atilu karin atlung aldo a kayabe nang David, mamangan at miminum; uling ding karelang kapatad dinapat lang pamagsadia dikil karela.

Bukud pa keta ding makalapit karela, a kakametung na pin a dayu ning Isacar at ning Zabulon at ning Naftali, migdala lang tinape a atiu babo ra ding asno, at king babo ra ding camello, at king babo ra ding mula, at king babo ra ding vaca, bakal a pamangan, mamon higos, at pinunggul a pasas, at alak, at laru, at vaca, at tupa a labislabis: uling ating saya king Israel.
At mekisangguni ya i David karing capitan ding libu-libu at karing dinadinalan, king balang talataid pin.

At sinabi nang David king mabilug a kapulungan ning Israel, Nung babalakan yung mayap kekayu, at nung makanian king GUINU a kekatang Dios, tara mitubud tamu king nu pa man karin karing kekatang kapatad a melakuan king mabilug a labuad ning Israel, a kayabe rala ding sacerdotes at Levitas karing karelang ciudad a ating kapanguluan, balang makapakipamisan kekatamu;
At tara dalan tayang pasibayu ing kaban ning kekatang Dios kekatamu: uling e tamu penintun iti karing kayaldawan nang Saul.
At ing mabilug a kapulungan sinabi na king daptan dang makanian; uling iting bague matulid karing mata na ning mabilug a balayan.

Inya tinipun nang makapamisan David ing mabilug a Israel, manibat king Sihor a batis ning Egipto angga pin king piluluban na ning Hamat, bareng dalan ing kaban na ning Dios a manibat king Kiriat-jearim.

At i David sinampa ya, at ing mabilug a Israel, king Baala, a ya ing, atiu king Kiriat-jearim, a makatungkul kang Juda, bareng isampa manibat karing ing kaban na ning Dios a GUINU a makalukluk babo ra ding querubines, a mayayaus king uli ning Laguiu.
At dela re ing kaban na ning Dios makasake ya king metung a bayung karitun, at dela reng ibat king bale nang Abinadab: at pepaguliut de di Uza at i Ahio ing karitun.

At i David at ing mabilug a Israel menigtigan la king arapan na ning Dios king mabilug dang sikanan, kagum da ding dalit, at kagum da ding alpa, at kagum da ding salterio, at kagum da ding pandareta, at kagum da ding cimbalo, at kagum da ding pakakak.
At inyang datang la king pidadaran na ning Quidon, inatyat neng Uza ing keang gamat baneng kawatan ing kaban; uling ding vaca mitisud la.
At ing mua ning GUINU milablab salang kang Uza, at sigatan ne, uling inatyat ne ing keang gamat king kaban; at mete ya karin king arapan na ning Dios
At e ya metula i David, uling mimua ya Ing GUINU kang Uza: at ing karinan a ita inaus nang Perez-uza, angga king aldo iti.
At i David mitakutan ya king Dios king aldo ita, ngana, Makananu keng yuli kanaku ing kaban ning Dios?
Inya i David e ne linipat kea king ciudad nang David ing kaban, nung e selangi neng linub king bale nang Obed-edom a Geteo.
At ing kaban na ning Dios melakuan ya king sapni nang Obed-edom king keang bale king atlung bulan: at pepanuanan neng GUINU ing bale nang Obed-edom, at ing sablang atiu kea.
At i Hiram a ari ning Tiro mipabal yang tubud kang David, at dutung a cedro, at aluaguing batu, at aluagui, bareng ipanalakad metung a bale.
At atingid nang David king inalal neng GUINU bang magari king Israel; uling ing keang kayarian mitalakad yang matas, king uli ning keang balayan Israel.
At i David kinanua ya pang asawa na king Jerusalem; at i David mika anak ya pang lalaki at babai.
At oreti ding laguiu ra ding meguing anak na king Jerusalem: i Samua, at i Sobab, i Natan, at i Solomon,
At i Ibhar, at i Elisua, at i Elifelet,
At i Noga, at i Nefeg, at i Jafia,
At i Elisama, at i Beeliada, at i Elifelet.

At inyang dimdam da ding Filisteos king i David milanian yang ari king mabilug a Israel, ding anggang Filisteos sinampa la bareng panintunan i David: at dimdam nang David iti, at linual yang salang karela.
Ngeni ding Filisteos dinatang la at milusuk la king libis na ning Refaim.
At i David mengutang ya king Dios, ngana, Sampa kung salang karing Filisteos? at ibie mula king kanakung gamat? At sinabi ning GUINU kea, Sampa ka: uling ibie kula king kekang gamat.

Nanupata sinampa la king Baal-perazim, at i David sigatan no karin; at sinabi nang David, Lesakan no ning Dios ding kakung kasalang king pamamilatan na ning kanakung gamat, a anti mong bulus ning danum. Inya pin ing laguiu na ning karinan a ita inaus dang Baal-perazim.
At likuan do karin ding karelang dioses; at i David minie yang utus, at dilukan do king api.
At milusuk lang pasibayu ding Filisteos king libis.
At i David mengutang yang pasibayu king Dios; at sinabi na ning Dios kea, E ka sasampang tutuki karela: liputan mula, at mulusuk ka karela king tulid da ding dutung a morales.

At malyari, pamanamdam mu king biung ning lakad king sepu ra ding dutung a morales, king kanita lual ka king labanan; uling ing Dios linual ya king mumuna mu banang sugatan ing ejercito ra ding Filisteos.
At i David depatan na nung makananung inutus na kea ning Dios: at sigatan da ing ejercito ra ding Filisteos manibat king Gibeon angga pin king Gezer.
At mikalat ing kabantugan nang David king mabilug a labuad; at dela ning GUINU karing anggang bansa ing takut da kea.
At guinawa yang bale i David dikil kea king ciudad nang David; at misadia yang metung a karinan dikil king kaban na ning Dios, at mitalakad ya dikil kaniti metung a kubu.

Kanita sinabi nang David, Alang sukat magdala king kaban na ning Dios nung e mu ding Levitas: uling ila ding pinili ning GUINU bang magdala king kaban na ning Dios, at bang manibala dikil kea king kapilan pa man.
At tinipun nang David ing mabilug a Israel king Jerusalem, bareng isampa ing kaban ning GUINU king karinan na, a keang sidia dikil kaniti.
At i David tinipun nong makapamisan ding anak nang lalaking Aaron, at ding Levitas:
Karing anak nang Coat, i Uriel a pekapun, at ding keang kapatad dinalan la at aduangpulu;
Karing anak nang Merari, i Asaya a pekapun, at ding keang kapatad adua lang dalan at aduangpulu;
Karing anak nang Gersom, i Joel a pekapun, at ding keang kapatad dinalan la at atlungpulu;
Karing anak nang Elizafan, i Semaya a pekapun, at ding keang kapatad adua lang dalan;
Karing anak nang Hebron, i Eliel a pekapun, at ding kapatad na walu lang pulu;
Karing anak nang Uziel, i Aminadab a pekapun, at ding keang kapatad dinalan la at labingadua.
At inaus nong David i Zadoc at i Abiatar a sacerdotes, at ding Levitas, i Uriel, i Asaya, at i Joel, i Semaya, at i Eliel, at i Aminadab,

At sinabi na karela, Ikayu ding pekabuntuk karing bale ra ding mangatua karing Levitas: magpakabanal kayu, ikayu at ding kekong kapatad, bayeng isampa ing kaban ning GUINU, a Dios ning Israel, king karinan a sidia ku dikil kaniti.
Uling king e yu pamagdala kaniti king minuna, Ing GUINU a kekatang Dios mimua ya kekatamu, uling e taya penintun agpang king tuntunan.
Nanupata ding sacerdotes at ding Levitas migpakabanal la bareng isampa ing kaban ning GUINU, a Dios ning Israel.
At pisanan de ding anak da ding Levitas ing kaban na ning Dios king pamamilatan da ding tambayuk na, anti mo ing inutus nang Moises agpang king amanu ning GUINU.

At sinabi nang David king pekapun da ding Levitas a yalal dala ding karelang kapatad a taladalit, a ating titigtigan king musica, ding salterio at ding alpa at ding cimbalo, a pakatni lang masikan at tatas da ing siwala ra a kagum ning tula.

Inya inalal de ding Levitas i Heman a anak nang lalaking Joel; at karing keang kapatad, i Asaf a anak nang Berequias; at karing anak nang Merari a karelang kapatad, i Etan a anak nang lalaking Cusaias;

At kayabe rala ding karelang kapatad king kaduang balitang, i Zacarias, i Ben, at i Jaaziel, at i Semiramot, at i Jehiel, at i Uni, i Eliab, at i Benaya, at i Maaseias at i Matitias, at i Elifelehu, at i Micneias, at i Obed-edom, at i Jeiel, ding bante pasbul.
Nanupata ding taladalit, i Heman, i Asaf, at i Etan, mialal lang ating cimbalong tangsu barong pakatnian masikan;
At i Zacarias, at i Aziel, at i Semiramot, at i Jehiel, at i Uni, at i Eliab, at i Maaseias, at i Benaya, a ating salterio a linapat king Alamot;
At i Matitias, at i Elifelehu, at i Micneias, at i Obed-edom, at i Jeiel, at i Azazias, a ating alpa a linapat king Seminit, bang manimuna.
At i Quenanias, a pekapun karing Levitas, mamajala ya king pamanialit; ya ing tuturu king pamanialit, uling sane ya.
At i Berequias at i Elcana bante lang pasbul dikil king kaban.

At i Sebanias, at i Josafat, at i Netanel, at i Amasai, at i Zacarias, at i Benaya, at i Eliezer, a sacerdotes, titiup lang pakakak king arapan ning kaban ning Dios; at i Obed-edom at i Jehias bante lang pasbul dikil king kaban.
Nanupata i David, at ding makatua ning Israel, at ding capitan a mamajala karing libulibu, mine la bareng isampa ing kaban ning tipan ning GUINU manibat king bale nang Obed-edom kagum ning tula.
At milyari, inyang saupan no ning Dios ding Levitas a magdala king kaban ning tipan ning GUINU, king midaun lang pitung vaca at pitung tupa.

At i David makapiblas yang metung a balabal a lienzong masinsin, at ding anggang Levitas a mamusan king kaban, at ding taladalit, at i Quenanias a talaturu king dalit kayabe re ding taladalit: at i David atin yang metung a efod a lienzo.

Makanian neng simpa ning mabilug a Israel ing kaban ning tipan ning GUINU kagum ning kulio, at ning katni ning corneta, at ding pakakak, at ding cimbalo, a kakatning masikan kagum ding salterio at ding alpa.

At milyari, kabang ing kaban ning tipan ning GUINU daratang ya king ciudad nang David, i Mical a anak nang Saul tinando ya king awang, at ikit ne ing aring David a teterak ya at titigtig; at inumis ne king keang pusu.
At linub de ng kaban ning Dios, at binili re king libutad ning tabernaculo a telakad nang David dikil kaniti: at minain lang ain a durulukan at ain king kapayapan king arapan ning Dios.
At inyang i David meari neng minain king ain a durulukan at ain king kapayapan, pepanuanan na ing balayan king laguiu ning GUINU.
At minie ya king balang metung king Israel, karing lalaki at karing babai, king balang metung, metung a tinape, at metung a dake lamankati, at metung a mamon pasas.
At minalal yang mapilan karing Levitas bang manibala king arapan na ning kaban ning GUINU, at bang magmasusi at bang pasalamat at bang muri king GUINU, a Dios ning Israel:

I Asaf yang pekapun, at ing kadua na i Zacarias, i Jeiel, at i Semiramot, at i Jehiel, at i Matitias, at i Eliab, at i Benaya, at i Obed-edom, at i Jeiel, a ating salterio at alpa; at i Asaf atin yang cimbalo, a kakatning masikan:
At i Benaya at i Jahaziel a sacerdotes a ating pakakak a manatili, king arapan na ning kaban ning tipan ning Dios.
Kanita king aldo a ita karin ing mumunang pamanutus nang David bang munie pasalamat king GUINU, king pamamilatan na ning gamat nang Asaf at ding keang kapatad.
Oh munie kong pasalamat king GUINU, maus kayu king keang laguiu; Ipakilala yo ding keang dapat karing balayan.
Dalit ko kea, dalit kong kapurian kea: Maniabi kayu tungkul karing anggang makapagmulala nang dapat.
Paligaya kayu king keang banal a laguiu; Pabustan yung ing pusu ra tumula ya detang manintun king GUINU.
Panintunan ye Ing GUINU at ing keang sikanan; Panintunan ye ing keang lupa kapilan man.
Ganakan yo ding makapagmulalang dapat na a keang depatan, Ding keang pagmumulalan, at ding kayatulan na ning keang asbuk,
Oh ikong bini nang Israel a keang talasuyu, Ikong anak nang Jacob, a keang pinili.
Ya Ing GUINU a kekatang Dios; ding keang kayatulan atilu king mabilug a labuad.
Ganakan yu ing keang tipan king kapilan pa man, Ing amanu a keang inutus karing libung dai,
Ing tipan a depatan na kang Abraham, At ing sumpa na kang Isaac,
At patutuan na naman iti kang Jacob anting metung a pekatuntunan, Kang Israel metung a peka alang anggang tipan,
Ngana, Keka ibie ku ing labuad na ning Canaan, Ing kalma ning kekang mana;
Kanitang ikayu ditak kayu mu katau king bilang, Wa, binang ditak, at manaliwang balayan kaniti;
At ila mine la king bansa at bansa, At manibat king metung a kayarian angga king aliwang balayan.
E na pibata a ninumang lalaki dapat yang e matulid karela; Wa, pengamanuan nala ding ari king uli ra,
Ngana, E yo tatagkilan ding kanakung linian, At e yo nananan balang ding kanakung manula.
Dalit kayu king GUINU, mabilug a labuad; Pakit yu ing keang pamagligtas aldo-aldo.
Ipasiag yu ing keang ligaya king libutad da ding bansa, Ding keang makapagmulalang dapat king libutad da ding anggang balayan.
Uling marangal ya Ing GUINU, at sukat yang purian a bina: Ya sukat ya mu namang takutan lapo karing sablang dioses.
Uling ding anggang dioses da ding balayan idolos la: Dapot Ing GUINU ya ing linalang karing banua.
Puri at kamalan ing atiu king arapan na: Sikanan at saya ing atiu king keang karinan.
Pabandi yu king GUINU, ikong kamaganakan da ding balayan, Pabandi yu king GUINU ing ligaya at sikanan;
Pabandi yu king GUINU ing ligayang mangaintulid king keang laguiu: Magdala kong metung a ain, at ume ko king arapan na; Samban ye Ing GUINU king ayus a banal.
Galgal king arapan na, ing mabilug a labuad: Ing yatu man mitatag ya a e malyaring makimut.
Pabustan lang magsaya ding banua, at pabustan yang tumula ing labuad; At pabustan lang sabian da king libutad da ding bansa, Ing GUINU magari ya.
Pabustan yang mamius ing dayatmalat, at ing anggang atiu kea; Pabustan tumula ing marangle, at ing anggang atiu karin;
Kanita dalit la ding dutung ning karutungan dikil king tula king arapan ning GUINU; Uling datang ya bang atulan na ing labuad.
Oh munie kong pasalamat king GUINU; uling mayap ya; Uling ing keang kapakaluluan manatili kapilan man.

At sabian yu, Iligtas mukami, Oh Dios na ning kekeng kaligtasan, At tipunan mukeng makapamisan, at iligtas mukami manibat karing bansa, Bang munie pasalamat king kekang banal a laguiu, At bang magtagumpe king kekang kapurian.
Nuan ya Ing GUINU, a Dios ning Israel, Manibat king alang angga angga pin king alang angga. At sinabi na ning mabilug a balayan, Yanasa, at pinuri re Ing GUINU.

Nanupata likuan no karin, king arapan na ning kaban ning tipan ning GUINU, i Asaf at ding keang kapatad, bang manibalang magparati king arapan na ning kaban, agpang king kakailanganan na ning dapat king aldoaldo;
At i Obed-edom a kayabe ra ding karelang kapatad, a anamapulu at walu; i Obed-edom man a anak nang Jedutun at i Hosa balang maguing bante pasbul;
At i Zadoc a sacerdote, at ding keang kapatad a sacerdotes, king arapan na ning tabernaculo ning GUINU king matas a karinan a atiu king Gibeon,

Balang miain ain a durulukan king GUINU king babo na ning altar ning ain a durulukan a makaparati king abak at gatpanapun, agpang pin king anggang makasulat king kautusan ning GUINU, a inutus na king Israel;
At kayabe ra ila pin i Heman at i Jedutun, at ding mitagan a mepili, a mesambitla king laguiu, bang munie pasalamat king GUINU, uling ing keang kapakaluluan manatili kapilan man;

At kayabe ra ila pin i Heman at i Jedutun a ating pakakak at cimbalo dikil karing pakatning masikan, at ating instrumentos dikil karing dalit king Dios; at ding anak nang Jedutun balang mibili king pasbulan dalan.
At ing mabilug a balayan minuli la balang katau king keang bale: at i David mibalik ya baneng panuanan ing keang bale.

At milyari, inyang i David tinuknang ya king keang bale, king sinabi nang David kang Natan a manula, Oini, aku manuknangan ku king metung a bale a cedro, dapot ing kaban ning tipan ning GUINU manuknangan ya king lalam da ding tabing.
At sinabi nang Natan kang David, Daptan mu ing sablang atiu king kekang pusu; uling ing Dios mamantabe ya keka.
At milyari king bengi mu ring ita, king ing amanu na ning Dios dinatang kang Natan, ngana,
Ume ka at sabian mu kang David a kakung talasuyu, Makanian ing sabi ning GUINU, Ika e muku ipanalakad metung a bale a nung nuku manuknangan:
UIing e ku pa menuknangan king metung a bale manibat king aldo a dela kung simpa ing Israel, angga king aldo ngeni, nung e mine ku king kubu at kubu, at king tabernaculo at tabernaculo.

King sablang karinan a kanakung lekaran a kayabe ku ing mabilug a Israel, miniabi kung metung a amanu mu man kaninu man karing ukum na ning Israel, a nung ninu ding inutusan ku a maguing pastul ning kanakung balayan, ngaku, Baket e yuku panalakad metung a bale a cedro?

Ngeni pin makanian ing sabian mu king talasuyu kung i David, Makanian ing sasabian ning GUINU ra ding ejercitos, Aku kinua raka king pastulan, ibat king pamanuki karing tupa, bakang maguing principe king kakung balayan a Israel:

At aku minantabe ku keka nu ka man mine, at sebat kula ding anggang kasalang mu ibat king kekang arapan; at aku gawan dakang metung a laguiu, a anti mo ing laguiu ra ding mangarangal a atiu king labuad.

At tuldu kung metung a karinan dikil king balayan kung Israel, at itanam kula, balang makapanuknangan king sarili rang karinan, at e no makimut pa; ni e ra no asira ding anak na ning dewakan, a anti mo king minuna,

At anti ing manibat king aldo a minutus kung ukum bang mamajala king balayan kung Israel; at pasukuan kula ding anggang kekang kasalang. Bukud kaniti sasalesean ku keka a ipanalakad naking GUINU metung a bale.

At mapalyari, nung matupad no ding kekang aldo a ika karampatan na kang ume bang akayabe ra ding kekang mangatua, king italakad ku ing kekang bini a katuki mu, a maguing karing kekang anak a lalaki; at itatag ku ing keang kayarian.
Ipanalakad nakung metung a bale, at itatag ke ing keang luklukan king kapilan pa man.
Akung maguing ibpa na, at ya maguing anak ke: at e ku ilako ing kakung kayubuan a lub kea, a anti mo ing pamangua ku kaniti ibat ketang minuna keka.
Dapot ibili ke king kakung bale at king kakung kayarian king kapilan pa man; at ing keang luklukan mitatag ya king kapilan pa man.
Agpang karing anggang amanung deti at agpang king anggang malikmatang iti, makanian nang sinabing Natan kang David.
Kanita linub ya ing aring David, at linukluk ya king arapan ning GUINU; at sinabi na, Ninu aku, Oh GUINUNG Dios, at nanu ya ing kanakung bale, bang dalan muku king anti kaniang dayu?

At iti metung a malating bague karing kekang mata, Oh Dios; dapot kekang sinabi tungkul king bale na ning kekang talasuyu ing king maluat a panaun a daratang, at binilang muku agpang king bili na ning metung a tau a ating matas a pangabilian, Oh GUINUNG Dios.
Nanu pa ing asabi nang David keka tungkul king dangalan a merapat king kekang talasuyu? uling balu me ing kekang talasuyu.
Oh GUINU, king uli ning kekang talasuyu, at agpang king sariling kekang pusu, depatan mu ing anggang dangalan a iti, bamong ipakilala ding anggang mangaragul a bague a deti.
Oh GUINU, alang anti ika, ni ala nang metung mang Dios subali keka, agpang king anggang dimdam mi karing kekeng balugbug.

At nanu yang metung a bansa king labuad a anti mo ing kekang balayan Israel, a inatbus na ning Dios bang maguing sarili nang balayan, banakang gawan metung a laguiu king pamamilatan na ning maragul at makapangilabut a bague, king pamitabi karing bansa ibat king arapan na ning kekang balayan, a inatbus mu king Egipto?
Uling ing kekang balayan Israel guewa mung sarili mung balayan king kapilan pa man; at ika, GUINU, meguing ikang Dios da.
At ngeni, Oh GUINU, pabustan mung mitatag ing amanu a sinabi mu tungkul king kekang talasuyu, at tungkul king keang bale, king kapilan pa man, at daptan mu anti mo ing kekang sinabi.

At ing kekang laguiu pabustan meng mitatag at dagul king kapilan pa man, ngana, Ing GUINU ra ding ejercitos ya ing Dios ning Israel, metung ya ping Dios king Israel: at ing bale nang David a talasuyu mu mitatag ya king arapan mu.
Uling ika, Oh kanakung Dios, pepatilip mu king kekang talasuyu king ipanalakad meng metung a bale: inya ikit na ning kekang talasuyu king keang pusu a manalangin ya king arapan mu.
At ngeni, Oh GUINU, ika ing Dios, at pengaku mu ing mayap a bague a iti king kekang talasuyu:
At ngeni mekapatula keka ing panuanan me ing bale na ning kekang talasuyu, bayang manatili king kapilan pa man king arapan mu: uling ika, Oh GUINU, pepanuan ka, at meguing nuan king kapilan pa man.
At kaibat na niti milyari, king sigatan nong David ding Filisteos, at pepasuku nala, at kinua na ing Gat at ding keang balen ibat king gamat da ding Filisteos.
At sigatan na ing Moab; at ding Moabitas meguing talasuyu nong David, at pesipagdala lang buis.
At sigatan neng David i Hadarezer a ari ning Soba king Hamat, kabang mame ya bang itatag na ing keang sasakupan king siping ning ilug Eufrates.

At kinanua ya i David kea libung carro, at pitung libung makasake kabayu, at aduangpulung lalaking maglakad; at pinile nong David ding anggang kabayu ra ding carro, dapot mitagan ya karela dikil karing dinalan a carro.
At inyang ding tau Siria ning Damasco dinatang la bang sumaup kang Hadarezer a ari ning Soba, sinugat ya i David karing tau Siria aduangpulu at aduang libung lalaki.
Kanita i David minili yang ejercito king Siria ning Damasco; at ding tau Siria meguing talasuyu nong David, at migdala lang buis. At dininan neng pamagtagumpe GUINU i David nu ya man mine.
At kinua nong David ding kalasag a guintu a atiu karing talasuyu nang Hadarezer, at dela no Jerusalem.

At manibat king Tibhat at manibat king Cun, a ciudad nang Hadarezer, kinanua ya i David binang dakal a tangsu, a iti ya ing pengawa nang Solomon king metung a dayatmalat a tangsu, at ding asias, at ding kasangkapan a tangsu.
At inyang damdaman nang Tou a ari ning Hamat a sigatan nang David ing mabilug nang ejercitong Hadarezer a ari ning Soba,

Tinubud ne i Hadoram a keang anak king aring David, bayang gumalang kea, at bang panuanan ne, uling mekipamuk ya salang kang Hadarezer at sinugat ne (uling i Hadarezer mika pamakipamuk ya kang Tou); at migdala yang sarisaring kasangkapan a guintu at pilak at tangsu.

Deti man telaga no ning aring David king GUINU, pati na ing pilak at guintu a kinua na karing anggang bansa; ing menibatan king Edom at menibatan king Moab, at menibatan karing anak nang Ammon, at menibatan karing Filisteos, at menibatan kang Amalec.
Bukud kaniti i Abisai a anak nang Zeruia sinugat nala ding Edomeos king Libis na ning Asin labi lang walung libu.
At minili yang ejercitos king Edom; at ding anggang Edomeos meguing talasuyu nong David. At dininan neng pamagtagumpe GUINU i David nu ya man mine.
At i David migari ya king mabilug a Israel; at depatan na ing justicia at katuliran king mabilug nang balayan.
At i Joab a anak nang Zeruia atiu king pamanibala king ejercito; at i Jeosafat a anak nang Ahilud ya ing talatala;
At i Zadoc a anak nang Ahitub, at i Abimelec a anak nang Abiatar, sacerdotes la; at i Savsa kalijim ya;
At i Benaya a anak nang Jeoiada ya ing mamajala karing Kereteos at karing Peleteos; at ding anak nang David pekapun la king siping ning ari.
At milyari kaibat na niti, king mete ya i Nahas a ari ra ding anak nang Ammon, at ing keang anak migari yang kalili na.

At sinabi nang David, Pakit kung ganaka kang Hanun a anak nang Nahas, uling i ibpa na pepakit yang ganaka kanaku. Inya pepabal yang tubud i David bareng patulan tungkul king keang ibpa. At dinatang la ding talasuyu nang David king labuad da ding anak nang Ammon kang Hanun, bareng patulan.

Dapot sinabi ra ding principes da ding anak nang Ammon kang Hanun, Ukulan mu waring parangalan neng David i ibpa mo, king pamitubud nang mamatula keka? e wari ding keang talasuyu dinatang la keka balang maniasat, at balang manlasak, at barang tiktikan ing labuad?
Inya kinua nong Hanun ding talasuyu nang David, at sitsatan nala, at kinutud na ing karelang susulud king libutad, angga pin king karelang lomu, at pepalakuan nala.

Kanita mine la ding mapilan katau, at selese ra kang David nung makananu lang melingap ding lalaki. At mitubud ya bang saganan dala; uling ding lalaki merine lang bina. At sinabi na ning ari, Manaya ko king Jerico angga king ding kekong balbas tumubu la, at kanita mibalik na kayu.

At inyang ikit da ding anak nang Ammon a ila meguing makamua lang bina kang David, i Hanun at ding anak nang Ammon peparala lang libung talentong pilak balang manupa karela karing carro at karing talapaniake kabayu a manibat king Mesopotamia, at manibat king Arammaaca, at manibat king Soba.

Nanupata menupa la karela atlungpulu at aduang libung carro, at ing ari ning Maaca at ing keang balayan, a deti dinatang la at menalakad la king arapan na ning Medeba. At ding anak nang Ammon mitipun lang makapamisan a manibatan karing karelang ciudad, at dinatang la balang makilaban.
At inyang dimdam nang David iti, tinubud ne i Joab, at ing mabilug a ejercito ding masikanan a lalaki.
At ding anak nang Ammon linual la, at binili ra king ayus ing pamipamuk king pasbulan dalan na ning ciudad: at ding ari a dinatang melakuan lang makakawani king marangle.
Ngeni inyang ikit nang Joab a ing labanan makasadiang salang kea king arapan at king gugulutan, memili karetang piling lalaki ning Israel, at binili no king ayus salang karing tau Siria.
At ing makatagan king balayan pepanibala na king gamat na ning kapatad nang i Abisai; at binili ra king ayus ing sarili ra salang karing anak nang Ammon.
At sinabi na, Nung ding tau Siria milalu la kasikan kanaku, kanita sumaup ka kaku; dapot nung ding anak nang Ammon milalu la kasikan keka, kanita sumaup ku keka.
Magpakatatag kang mayap, at daptan ta ing pangalalaki dikil king kekatang balayan, at dikil karing ciudad na ning kekatang Dios: at daptan ning GUINU ing pamayapan na.
Inya i Joab at ing balayan a kayabe na linapit la king arapan ding tau Siria king labanan; at tinakas la king arapan na.
At inyang akit da ding anak nang Ammon king ding tau Siria tinakas la, tinakas la naman king arapan nang Abisai a keang kapatad, at linub la king ciudad. Kanita i Joab dinatang ya Jerusalem.

At inyang akit da ding tau Siria king mibili la king lalung dewakan king arapan na ning Israel, pepabal lang tubud, at dela ro ding tau Siria a atiu king nangan na karin ning Ilug, pati na i Sofac a capitan ning ejercito nang Hadarezer king mumuna karela.

At mipabalu kang David; at tinipun nang makapamisan ing mabilug a Israel, at dinalakit la king Jordan, at miras la karela, at binili ra king ayus ing labanan salang karela. Inya kanitang i David abili na king ayus ing labanan salang karing tau Siria, mekipamuk la kea.

At ding tau Siria tinakas la king arapan na ning Israel; at i David apate no karing tau Siria ding lalaki karing pitung libung carro, at apatapulung libung lalakad, at pete ne i Sofac a capitan ning ejercito.

At inyang ikit da ding talasuyu nang Hadarezer king mibili la king lalung marawak king arapan na ning Israel, mekipagpayapa la kang David, at sinuyu la kea: ni e no sinaup pa ding tau Siria karing anak nang Ammon.

At milyari, king panaun a pamibalik na ning banua, king panaun a ding ari lulual la king labanan, king patnubayan nang Joab ing ejercito, at sinira ra ing karinan da ding anak nang Ammon, at dinatang la at kibkuban da ing Rabba. Dapot i David menaya ya king Jerusalem. At sigatan nang Joab ing Rabba, at sinira na iti.

At kinua neng David ing corona na ning karelang ari ibat king babo na ning keang buntuk, at ikit na king atin yang timbang metung a talentong guintu, at ating mangaulagang batu kaniti; at miputung ya king buntuk nang David: at liwal na ing mesamsam king ciudad, binang dakal.

At liwal na ing balayan a atiu karin, at kinutud no karing lagari, at karing pamatag a bakal, at karing palakul. At makanian ing depatan nang David karing anggang ciudad da ding anak nang Ammon. At i David at ing mabilug a balayan mibalik Jerusalem.
At milyari kaibat na niti, king mika pamipamuk king Gezer karing Filisteos: kanita pete neng Sibecai a Husatita i Sipai, a karing anak na ning gigante; at sinuku la.

At mika ating pasibayung pamipamuk karing Filisteos; at pete neng Elhanan a anak nang Jair i Lami a kapatad nang Goliat a Geteo, a ing palda na ning keang tandus anti ya mo ing pabakle na ning mamabal.

At mika ating pasibayung pamipamuk king Gat, nung nu ating metung a lalaking maragul a pamikakatawan, a ding taliri ra ding gamat na at bitis adua lang pulu at apat, anam king balang gamat at anam king balang bitis; at penganak ya naman king gigante.
At inyang inumis na ing Israel, i Jonatan a anak nang Simea a kapatad nang lalaking David pete ne.
Deti penganak la king gigante king Gat; at miragsa la king pamamilatan na ning gamat nang David, at king pamamilatan na ning gamat da ding keang talasuyu.
At tinalakad ya i satanas salang king Israel, at kimutan ne i David bang bilangan na ing Israel.

At sinabi nang David kang Joab at karing principes ning balayan, Ume kayu, bilangan yu ing Israel manibat king Beerseba angga king Dan; at pagdala yukung amanu, bang abalu ku ing kabilugan dang bilang.

At sinabi nang Joab, Gawan ning GUINU ing keang balayan makatadinalan a ukdu iguit karakal king karela: dapot, ing aring guinu ku, e la ngan wari talasuyu na ning kakung guino? Baket aduan na ning guinu ku ing bague a iti? baket ya maguing metung yang sangkan ning kasalanan king Israel?
Makanian man ing amanu na ning ari minyaul salang kang Joab. Inya pin i Joab meko ya, at mine ya king mabilug a Israel, at dinatang ya Jerusalem.

At binie nang Joab ing kabilugan a bilang na ning balayan kang David. At ding sabla king Israel libung libu la at dinalan a libung lalaki a tinalan talibung: at ing Juda apat lang dalan at pitungpulung libung lalaki a tinalan talibung.
Dapot i Levi at i Benjamin e no pekibilang karela; uling ing amanu na ning ari makasumami kang Joab.
At ing Dios e ya metula king bague a iti; inya pin sigatan na ing Israel.

At sinabi nang David king Dios, Mikasala kung tutung maragul, king pamaniapat ku king bague a iti: dapot ngeni ilako mu, pagamuamu ku keka, ing dewakan na ning kekang talasuyu; uling dinapat kung binang kamangmangan.
At Ing GUINU miniabi ya kang Gad, a talapanakit nang David, ngana,
Ume ka at maniabi ka kang David, ngamu, Makanian ing sabi ning GUINU, Yaluk ku keka ing atlung bague: mamili kang metung kareti, bang ya ing daptan ku keka.
Inya dinatang ya i Gad kang David, at sinabi na kea, Anti keni ing sabi ning GUINU, Kuanan me ing buri mu:

Maguing atlung banuang danup; o atlung bulan a pangalipul king arapan da ding kekang kasalang, kabang ing talibung da ding kekang kasalang atatagal naka; o kaya atlung aldo ing talibung ning GUINU, ing salut pin king labuad, at ing angel ning GUINU manlasak ya karing anggang angganan na ning Israel. Ngeni isipan mu nung nanu ing pakibat a ibalik ku king mitubud kanaku.

At sinabi nang David kang Gad, Ati ku king metung a maragul a kalipitan: pabustan mukung manabu, pagamuamu ku, king gamat ning GUINU; uling bina lang mangaragul ding keang pakalulu: at e muku pabustan mananabu king gamat ning tau.
Inya pepagpa yang metung a salut Ing GUINU king Israel; at miragsa la king Israel ding pitungpulung libung lalaki.

At ing Dios Mitubud yang metung a angel king Jerusalem bang lasakan na iti: at inyang ume na nang lasakan, Ing GUINU linawe ya, at sinisi ya tungkul king dewakan, at sinabi na king manlasak a angel, Makaguiu na; ngeni ituknang me ing kekang gamat. At ing angel ning GUINU tinalakad ya king lele na ning pidadaran nang Ornan a Jebuseo.

At i David tinas no ding keang mata, at ikit ne ing angel ning GUINU makatalakad ya king pilatan na ning labuad at ning banua, at tatalan yang metung a makabagut a talibung king keang gamat a makayatyat king Jerusalem. Kanita i David at ding makatua, migsakab la a makaimalan suput.

At sinabi nang David king Dios, Aliwa wari aku ing pepabilang king balayan? aku rin pin ing mikasala at dinapat king binang marawak; dapot ding tupang deti, nanu ing depatan da? pabustan mung ing kekang gamat, pagamuamu ku keka, Oh GUINU a kakung Dios, maguing salang ya kanaku, at salang king bale na ning kakung ibpa; dapot e salang king kekang balayan, a bang mika atin lang salut.
Kanita inutusan ne ning angel ning GUINU i Gad banang sabian kang David, king sampa ya i David, at mitalakad yang metung a altar king GUINU king pidadaran nang Ornan a Jebuseo.
At sinampa ya i David agpang king sabi nang Gad, a sinabi na king laguiu ning GUINU.
At i Ornan mibalik ya, at ikit ne ing angel; at ding keang apat a anak a lalaki a kayabe na migpanpan la. Ngeni i Ornan dadara yang trigu.
At kabang i David miraras ya kang Ornan, i Ornan linawe ya at ikit ne i David, at linual ya king pidadaran, at diku ne kang David ing keang lupa king gabun.

Kanita sinabi nang David kang Ornan, Ibie mu kanaku ing karinan ning pidadaran a iti, bakeng apitalakaranan metung a altar king GUINU; king mabilug nang alaga ibie mu kanaku, bang ing salut tuknang king balayan.

At sinabi nang Ornan kang David, Kuanan mung keka, at pabustan mung daptan na ning ari kung guinu ing mayap karing keang mata: oini, kanaku lang babie keka ding vaca dikil karing ain a durulukan, at ding kasangkapan na ning pidadaran dikil king dutung, at ing trigu dikil king ain a pamangan; aku ibabie ku ngan iti.
At sinabi na ning aring David kang Ornan, Ali; nung e tune a saliwan ku iti king mabilug a alaga: uling e ku kuanan ing keka a idikil king GUINU, ni miain man king ain a durulukan king alang bayad.
Inya binie nong David kang Ornan ding timbang a anam a dalan a siclong guintu dikil king karinan.

At mitalakad ya karin i David metung a altar king GUINU, at minain yang ain a durulukan at ain king kapayapan, at minaus ya king GUINU; at pekibatan neng ibat banua king pamamilatan ning aping dimpa king altar ning ain a durulukan.
At inutusan neng GUINU ing angel; at binili neng pepasibayu ing keang talibung king kaluban na niti.
King panaun a ita, inyang ikit nang David king pekibatan neng GUINU king pidadaran nang Ornan a Jebuseo, kanita dinaun ya karin.
Uling ing tabernaculo ning GUINU, a guewa nang Moises king ilang, at ing altar ning ain a durulukan, atilu king panaun a ita king matas a karinan king Gibeon.
Dapot i David e ya malyaring ume king arapan na bayang mangutang king Dios; uling mitakutan ya king uli ning talibung na ning angel ning GUINU.
Kanita sinabi nang David, Iti ya ing bale ning GUINUNG Dios, at iti ya ing altar ning ain a durulukan dikil king Israel.

At inutus nang David a tipunan dong makapamisan ding aliwang labuad a atiu king labuad na ning Israel; at minili yang aluaguing batu balang manitsura karing meari nang batu bayang mitalakad ing bale na ning Dios.
At i David misadia yang bakal a labislabis dikil karing paku karing pasbul da ding pasbulan dalan, at dikil karing sugpung; at tangsung labislabis a alang timbang;
At dutung a cedro a alang bilang: uling ding Sidonios at ding king Tiro migdala lang dutung a cedro a labislabis kang David.

At sinabi nang David, I Solomon a anak ku anak ya mu at maina pa, at ing bale a mitalakad dikil king GUINU karampatan yang binang maragul matibe at masanting, king kabantugan at king kaligayan karing sablang karinan; gawa ku ping pamagsadia dikil kaniti. Inya misadia ya i David a labislabis bayu ing keang kamatayan.
Kanita pepayaus ne i Solomon a keang anak, at penabilinan neng mitalakad metung a bale dikil king GUINU, a Dios ning Israel.
At sinabi nang David kang Solomon a keang anak, Tungkul kanaku, atiu king kanakung pusu ing mitalakad metung a bale king laguiu ning GUINU a kanakung Dios.

Dapot ing amanu ning GUINU dinatang kanaku, sinabi na, Mibubu kang binang dakal a daya, at dinapat kang mangaragul a pamipamuk: e ka mitatalakad metung a bale king kanakung laguiu, uling mibubu kang dakal a daya king labuad king kanakung panimanman.

Oini, ing metung a anak a lalaki ipanganak ya keka, a ya ing lalaki ning kapainawan; at dinan keng kapainawan karing sabla nang kasalang king makapatulug; uling ing keang maguing laguiu Solomon, at dinan kung kapayapan at katajimikan ing Israel karing keang kayaldawan.
Mitalakad yang metung a bale dikil king kanakung laguiu; at maguing anak ke, at maguing ibpa naku; at itatag ke ing luklukan na ning keang kayarian king Israel king kapilan pa man.
Ngeni, anak ku, Ing GUINU mantabe ya keka; at mipala ka, at italakad me ing bale ning GUINU a kekang Dios, anti mo ing sinabi na tungkul keka.
Pagkaluban naka mu sang GUINU king tenakan at pamanalastas, at panabilinan naka tungkul king Israel; king bang ingatan mung makanian ing kautusan ning GUINU a kekang Dios.

Kanita mipala ka, nung pamintuan mong daptan ding tuntunan at ding kautusan a penabilin ning GUINU kang Moises tungkul king Israel: magpakasikan ka, at mapakatatag mayap; e ka tatakut, ni mangalambut man.

Ngeni, oini, king kanakung kasakitan migsadia ku dikil king bale ning GUINU dinalan a libung talentong guintu, at libung libu a talentong pilak, at king tangsu at bakal a alang timbang; uli ning keraklan na: karing dutung anti naman at batu misadia ku; at malyari mung aragdagan pa ita.
Bukud kaniti ating kayabe mu a talapanyapat a labislabis, manitsura at talapanyapat king batu at dutung, at ding anggang taung maguematan king nanumang dapat:
King guintu, king pilak, at king tangsu, at king bakal, alang bilang. Talakad ka at dapat, at Ing GUINU mantabe ya keka.
Inutus nala namang David ding anggang principes ning Israel bang sumaup la kang Solomon a anak na, ngana,

E wari Ing GUINU a kekong Dios mamantabe ya kekayo? at e nako dininan kapainawan king balang dake? uling binie nala ding manuknangan king labuad king kanakung gamat; at ing labuad makasuku king arapan ning GUINU, at king arapan na ning keang balayan.

Ngeni isadia ye ing kekong pusu at ing kekong kaladua bang panintunan ye Ing GUINU a kekong Dios; mibangun ko pin, at italakad ye ing santuario ning GUINUNG Dios, bayang dalan ing kaban ning tipan ning GUINU, at ding banal a kasangkapan na ning Dios, king kilub ning bale a mitalakad king laguiu ning GUINU.
Ngeni i David pin matua ne at ganap ne karing aldo; at guewa neng ari ning Israel i Solomon a keang anak.
At tinipun nalang makapamisan ding anggang principes ning Israel, pati na ding sacerdotes at ding Levitas.
At ding Levitas binilang dala manibat king atlungpulung banua tua at paitas: at ding bilang da agpang king balang buntuk, sikakatau, atlu lang pulu at walung libu.
Kareti, adua lang pulu at apat a libu ding maguing talapanibala king dapat king bale ning GUINU; at ding anam a libu pekapun la at ukum;
At ding apat a libu bante lang pasbul; at ding apat a libu pupuri la king GUINU a ating instrumentos a kanakung guewa, sinabi nang David, barang ipamuri.
At pirake nong David king telatag agpang karing anak nang Levi: i Gerson, i Coat, at i Merari.
Karing Gersonitas: i Ladan at i Simei.
Ding anak nang Ladan: i Jehiel a pekapun, at i Zetam, at i Joel, atlu la.
Ding anak nang Simei: i Selomot, at i Haziel, at i Haran, atlu la. Deti ila ding pekabuntuk karing bale ra ding mangatua nang Ladan.
At ding anak nang Simei: i Jahat, i Zina, at i Jeus, at i Beria. Ding apat a deti anak nong Simei.
At i Jahat ya ing pekapun, at i Sisa ya ing kadua: dapot i Jeus at i Beria e la dakal a anak; inya pin ila meguing mibilang lang metung a bale ra ding mangatua.
Ding anak nang Coat: i Amram, i Izhar, i Hebron, at i Uziel, apat la.

Ding anak nang Amram: i Aaron at i Moises; at i Aaron mikawani ya, banong papagbanalan ding bague a kabanalbanalan, ya at ding keang anak, king kapilan pa man, bang duluk labun king arapan ning GUINU, bang manibala kea, at bang panuan king keang laguiu, king kapilan pa man.
Dapot tungkul kang Moises a lalaki ning Dios, ding keang anak meaus lang miabe king dai nang Levi.
Ding anak nang Moises: i Gersom at i Eliezer.
Ding anak nang Gersom: i Sebuel a pekapun.
At ding anak nang Eliezer ila pin: i Rehabias a pekapun; at i Eliezer e ya mika ating aliwang anak a lalaki; dapot ding anak nang Rehabias bina lang dakal.
Ding anak nang Izhar: i Selomit a pekapun.
Ding anak nang Hebron: i Jerias ing pekapun, i Amarias ya ing kadua, i Jahaziel ya ing katlu, at i Jecameam ya ing kapat.
Ding anak nang Uziel: i Mica ya ing pekapun, at i Isias ya ing kadua.
Ding anak nang Merari: i Mali at i Musi. Ding anak nang Mali: i Eleazar at i Cis.
At mete ya i Eleazar, at ala yang anak a lalaki, nung e mu anak a babai: at ding karelang kapatad a anak nang lalaking Cis kinua rong maguing asawa ra.
Ding anak nang Musi: i Mali, at i Eder, at i Jeremot, atlu la.

Deti ilang anak nang Levi agpang karing bale ra ding karelang mangatua, ding pekabuntuk pin karing bale ra ding karelang mangatua karing mebilang, king bilang da ding karelang laguiu agpang karing karelang buntuk, a darapat king dapat dikil king kasuyuwan king bale ning GUINU, manibat king aduangpulung banua tua at paitas.
Uling i David sinabi na, Ing GUINU, a Dios na ning Israel, minie yang kapainawan king keang balayan; at manuknangan ya king Jerusalem king kapilan pa man:
At anti naman ding Levitas e na kailangan a dalan de pa ing tabernaculo at ding anggang kasangkapan na dikil king kasuyuwan kaniti.
Uling king uli ding tauli nang amanung David mebilang la ding anak nang Levi, manibat king aduangpulung banua tua at paitas.

Uling ing karelang katungkulan ya ing manaya la karing anak nang Aaron dikil king kasuyuwan king bale ning GUINU, karing patio, at karing silid, at king pamanlinis karing anggang banal a bague, king dapat pin king pamanyuyu king bale na ning Dios;

Makanian mu naman dikil king tinape a ain, at dikil king mapinung arina dikil king metung a ain a pamangan, maguing karing maimpis a tinape a lang levadura, o kanitang linutu king kawali, o king sinoso, at dikil karing anggang sarisaring panyukad at panakal;
At bang talakad balang abak bang pasalamat at muri king GUINU, at makanian mu naman king gatpanapun;

At bang miain king anggang ain a durulukan king GUINU, karing sabbath, karing bayung bulan, at karing makatuldung pista, king bilang agpang king tuntunan tungkul karela, a makaparati king arapan ning GUINU;

At king ila ing mingat king katungkulan king tabernaculo ning pamitipun, at king katungkulan king banal a karinan, at king katungkulan da ding anak nang Aaron a karelang kapatad, dikil king kasuyuwan king bale ning GUINU.
At ding panga dake-dake ra ding anak nang Aaron ila deti. Ding anak nang Aaron: i Nadab at i Abiu, i Eleazar at i Itamar.
Dapot i Nadab at i Abiu mete lang minuna king karelang ibpa, at ala lang anak: inya pin i Eleazar at i Itamar ilang dinapat king katungkulan a pangasacerdote.
At i David a kayabe nang Zadoc karing anak nang Eleazar, at i Ahimelec karing anak nang Itamar, pirake nala agpang king karelang tuktuk king karelang pamanyuyu.

At ating lalung dakal a lalaking pekapun a meakit karing anak nang Eleazar kesa karing anak nang Itamar; at makanian dong pirake: karing anak nang Eleazar ating labinganam, a pekabuntuk ding bale ra ding mangatua; at karing anak nang Itamar, agpang karing bale ra ding karelang mangatua, walu la.

Makanian dong pirake king pamamilatan na ning pamipaningalma, ning balang metung king metung karela; uling ating principes ning santuario, at principes ning Dios, karing anak nang Eleazar, at karing anak nang Itamar.

At i Semaya a anak nang Netanel a escriba, a metung ya karing Levitas, sinulat nala king arapan ning ari, at ding principes, at i Zadoc a sacerdote, at i Ahimelec a anak nang Abiatar, at ding pekabuntuk ding bale ra ding mangatua karing sacerdotes at karing Levitas; ing metung a bale dikil karing mangatua meakua ya dikil kang Eleazar, at ing metung meakua ya dikil kang Itamar.
Ngeni ing mumunang kalma linual ya dikil kang Jeoiarib, ing kadua kang Jedaya,
Ing katlu kang Harim, ing kapat kang Seorim,
Ing kalima kang Malquias, ing kanam kang Mijamin,
Ing kapitu kang Hakoz, ing kawalu kang Abias,
Ing kasiam kang Jesua, ing kapulu kang Secanias,
Ing kalabing metung kang Eliasib, ing kalabing adua kang Jakim,
Ing kalabing atlu kang Hupa, ing kalabing apat kang Jesebeab,
Ing kalabing lima kang Bilga, ing kalabing anam kang Imer,
Ing kalabing pitu kang Hesir, ing kalabing walu kang Hapizez,
Ing kalabing siam kang Petayas, ing kaduang pulu kang Jehezkel,
Ing kaduang pulu at metung kang Jaquin, ing kaduang pulu at adua kang Gamul,
Ing kaduang pulu at atlu kang Delaya, ing kaduang pulu at apat kang Maazias.

Iti ya ing tutuk da king karelang pamanyuyu, bang lungub king bale ning GUINU agpang king tuntunan a miabie karela king pamamilatan nang Aaron a karelang ibpa, anti mo ing inutus na keang GUINU, a Dios ning Israel.
At karing mitagan karing anak nang Levi: karing anak nang Amram, i Subael; karing anak nang Subael, i Jedeias.
Kang Rehabias: karing anak nang Rehabias, i Isias a pekapun.
Karing Izaritas, i Selomot; karing anak nang Selomot, i Jahat.
At ding anak nang Hebron: i Jerias a pekapun, i Amarias ya ing kadua, i Jahaziel ya ing katlu, i Jecameam ya ing kapat.
Ding anak nang Uziel, i Mica; karing anak nang Mica, i Samir.
Ing kapatad nang lalaking Mica, i Isias; karing anak nang Isias, i Zacarias.
Ding anak nang Merari: i Mali at i Musi; ding anak nang Jeazias: i Beno.
Ding anak nang Merari: kang Jaazias, i Beno, at i Soham, at i Zacur, at i Ibri.
Kang Mali: i Eleazar, a alang anak a lalaki.
Kang Cis; ding anak nang Cis: i Jerameel.
At ding anak nang Musi: i Mali, at i Eder, at i Jerimot. Deti ilang anak da ding Levitas agpang karing bale ra ding karelang mangatua.

Deti depatan da naman ing pamipaningalma anti mo pin ding karelang kapatad a anak nang Aaron king arapan nang aring David, at i Zadoc, at i Ahimelec, at ding pekabuntuk karing bale ra ding mangatua ra ding sacerdotes at ding Levitas; ding bale ra ding mangatua ra ding pekapun anti mu naman pin detang king keang waling lalaki.

Bukud kaniti i David at ding capitan ning ejercito mikawani lang mapilan dikil king pamanyuyu karing anak nang Asaf, at karing kang Heman, at karing kang Jedutun, a pasipanula kagum ding alpa, kagum ding salterio, at kagum ding cimbalo: at ing kabilangan da ding dinapat king dapat agpang king karelang pamanyuyu ila pin:
Karing anak nang Asaf: i Zacur, at i Jose, at i Netanias, at i Asarela, a anak nang Asaf, king lalam na ning gamat nang Asaf, a menula agpang king utus ning ari.

Kang Jedutun; ding anak nang Jedutun: i Gedalias, at i Zeri, at i Jesaias, i Hasabias, at i Matitias, anam la, king lalam na ning kayupayan na ning ibpa rang i Jedutun kagum ning alpa, a menula king pamamie pasalamat at pupuri king GUINU.
Kang Heman; ding anak nang Heman: i Bukias, i Matanias, i Uziel, i Sebuel, at i Jerimot, i Hananias, i Hanani, i Eliata, i Gidalti, at i Romamti-ezer, i Josbecasa, i Malloti, i Hotir, i Mahaziot.
Deti ngan anak nong Heman a talapanakit na ning ari karing amanu na ning Dios, baneng itas ing sagu. At ing Dios minie ya kang Heman labing apat a anak a lalaki at atlung anak a babai.

Deti ngan atilu karing lalam nang gamat ning karelang ibpa dikil king dalit king bale ning GUINU, a ating cimbalo, salterio, at alpa, dikil king pamanyuyu king bale na ning Dios; i Asaf, i Jedutun, at i Heman anti king makapailalam la king utus ning ari.
At ing bilang da, pati na ding karelang kapatad a mituruan king pamanyalit king GUINU, ding anggang biasa pin, adua lang dalan walungpulu at walu.
At depatan da ing pamipaningalma dikil king karelang katungkulan, ila ngan mikakametung la, nung makananu ya ing malati makanian ya naman ing maragul, ing talaturu anti naman ing ituturu.
Ngeni ing mumunang kalma a linto kang Asaf mebaldug ya kang Jose: ing kadua kang Gedalias; ya at ding keang kapatad at anak a lalaki labi lang adua:
Ing katlu kang Zacur, ding keang anak at ding keang kapatad, labi lang adua:
Ing kapat kang Izri, ding keang anak at ding keang kapatad, labi lang adua:
Ing kalima kang Netanias, ding keang anak at ding keang kapatad, labi lang adua:
Ing kanam kang Bukias, ding keang anak at ding keang kapatad, labi lang adua:
Ing kapitu kang Jesarela, ding keang anak at ding keang kapatad, labi lang adua:
Ing kawalu, kang Jesaias, ding keang anak at ding keang kapatad, labi lang adua:
Ing kasiam kang Matanias, ding keang anak at ding keang kapatad, labi lang adua:
Ing kapulu kang Simei, ding keang anak at ding keang kapatad, labi lang adua:
Ing kalabing metung kang Azarel, ding keang anak at ding keang kapatad, labi lang adua:
Ing kalabing adua kang Hasabias, ding keang anak at ding keang kapatad, labi lang adua:
Dikil king kalabing atlu, i Subael, ding keang anak at ding keang kapatad, labi lang adua:
Dikil king kalabing apat, i Matitias, ding keang anak at ding keang kapatad labi lang adua:
Dikil king kalabing lima kang Jeremot, ding keang anak at ding keang kapatad, labi lang adua:
Dikil king kalabing anam kang Hananias, ding keang anak at ding keang kapatad, labi lang adua:
Dikil king kalabing pitu kang Josbecasa, ding keang anak at ding keang kapatad, labi lang adua:
Dikil king kalabing walu kang Hanani, ding keang anak at ding keang kapatad, labi lang adua:
Dikil king kalabing siam kang Malloti, ding keang anak at ding keang kapatad, labi lang adua:
Dikil king kaduang pulu kang Eliata, ding keang anak at ding keang kapatad, labi lang adua:
Dikil king kaduang pulu at metung kang Hotir, ding keang anak at ding keang kapatad, labi lang adua:
Dikil king kaduang pulu at adua kang Gidalti, ding keang anak at ding keang kapatad, labi lang adua:
Dikil king kaduang pulu at atlu kang Mahaziot, ding keang anak at ding keang kapatad, labi lang adua:
Dikil king kaduang pulu at apat kang Romamti-ezer, ding keang anak at ding keang kapatad, labi lang adua.
Dikil king panga dake-dake ra ding bante pasbul: karing Coraitas, i Meselemias a anak nang Core, karing anak nang Asaf.
At i Meselemias atin yang anak a lalaki: i Zacarias ya ing pangane, i Jediael ya ing kadua, i Zebadias ya ing katlu, i Jatniel ya ing kapat,
I Elam ya ing kalima, i Jeohanan ya ing kanam, i Elieoenai ya ing kapitu.
At i Obed-edom atin yang anak a lalaki: i Semaya ya ing pangane, i Jeozabad ya ing kadua, i Joa ya ing katlu, at i Sacar ya ing kapat, at i Netanel ya ing kalima,
I Amiel ya ing kanam, i Isacar ya ing kapitu, i Peulletai ya ing kawalu; uling pepanuanan ne ning Dios.
Makanian mu naman kang Semaya a keang anak ding keang anak a lalaki mibait la, a memajala king bale nang ibpa ra; uling masikanan lang lalaki ning tapang.
Ding anak nang Semaya: i Otni, at i Refael, at i Obed, i Elzabad, a ding kapatad na lalaki lang bayani, i Eliu, at i Semaquias.
Deti ngan karin lang anak nang Obed-edom: ila at ding karelang anak at ding karelang kapatad, mayaguiu lang lalaki king sikanan dikil king pamanyuyu; anam lang pulu at adua kang Obed-edom.
At i Meselemias atin yang anak a lalaki at kapatad, bayaning lalaki, labi lang walu.
I Hosa man, karing anak nang Merari, atin yang anak: i Simri a pekapun (uling king bistat aliwa ya ing pangane, makanian man guewa neng pekapun ibpa na),
I Hilcias ya ing kadua, i Tebalias ya ing katlu, i Zacarias ya ing kapat: ding anggang anak nang lalaki at kapatad nang Hosa labi lang atlu.
Kareti atiu ing panga dake-dake karing bante pasbul, ding pekapun ping lalaki, a ating katungkulan a anti mo ding karelang kapatad, bang manibala king bale ning GUINU.
At depatan da ing pamipaningalma, ding mangalati anti mo ding mangaragul, agpang karing bale ra ding karelang mangatua, dikil king balang pasbulan dalan.
At ing kalma king dane aslagan mebaldug kang Selemias. Kanita dikil kang Zacarias a keang anak, metung a pantas a talausuk, depatan da ing pamipaningalma; at ing keang kalma linto king dane paralaya.
Kang Obed-edom ing dane mauli; at karing keang anak ing kamalig.
Kang Supim at kang Hosa ing dane albugan, king siping ning pasbulan dalan ning Sallequet, king dalan a mumukiat, a bante salang king bante.
King dane aslagan anam lang Levitas, king dane paralaya apat king balang aldo, king dane mauli apat king balang aldo, at dikil king kamalig tidua-tidua.
Dikil king Parbar king dane albugan, apat la king dalan, at adua king Parbar.
Deti ding panga dake-dake ra ding bante pasbul; karing anak da ding Coraitas, at karing anak nang Merari.
At karing Levitas, i Ahias ya ing mimingat karing pibandian ning bale na ning Dios, at karing pibandian ding mitalagang bague.
Ding anak nang Ladan, ding anak da ding Gersonitas a makatungkul kang Ladan, ding pekabuntuk karing bale ra ding mangatua a makatungkul kang Ladan a Gersonita: i Jehieli.
Ding anak nang Jehieli: i Zetam, at i Joel a kapatad na, a mamajala karing pibandian na ning bale ning GUINU.
Karing Amramitas, karing Izharitas, karing Hebronitas, karing Uzielitas:
At i Sebuel a anak nang Gersom, a anak nang Moises, pekapun yang mamajala karing pibandian.
At ding keang kapatad: kang Eliezer linto ya i Rehabias a keang anak, at i Jesaias a keang anak, at i Joram a keang anak, at i Zicri a keang anak, at i Selomot a keang anak.

Ing Selomot a iti at ding keang kapatad mamajala la karing anggang pibandian ding mitalagang bague, a telaga nang David a ari, at ding pekabuntuk karing bale ra ding mangatua, ding capitan da ding balang libu-libu at dina-dinalan, at ding capitan ning ejercito.
King mesamsam a simbut da king labanan karin la mitalaga bang paglarin king bale ning GUINU.

At ing anggang telaga nang Samuel a talapanakit, at i Saul a anak nang Cis, at i Abner a anak nang Ner, at i Joab a anak nang Zeruia, ing nanumang bague a telaga na ning ninuman, atiu king lalam nang gamat Selomot, at ding keang kapatad.
Karing Izharitas, i Quenanias at ding keang anak mirikil la king dapat king lual a mamajala king Israel, dikil karing pekapun at ukum.

Karing Hebronitas, i Hasabias at ding keang kapatad, a lalaki ning tapang, libu la at pitung dalan, talapanibala la king Israel king nangan na karin ning Jordan king dane albugan, dikil king anggang daraptan king GUINU, at dikil king kasuyuwan king ari.

Karing Hebronitas i Jerias a pekapun, karing Hebronitas pin, agpang karing dai ra king pamamilatan da ding bale ra ding mangatua. King kapat apulung banua ning pamagari nang David penintun dala, at atin lang ikit karela a masikanan a lalaki ning tapang king Jazer ning Gilead.

At ding keang kapatad, a lalaki ning tapang, adua lang libu at pitung dalan, a pekabuntuk karing bale ra ding mangatua, a ilang guewa nang David a talapanibala karing Reubenitas, at karing Gaditas, at karing kapitnang dai ding Manasitas, king balang kabagayan a makatungkul king Dios, at dikil karing pisasabian ning ari.

Ngeni ding anak na ning Israel agpang king karelang bilang, ngana wari, ding pekabuntuk karing bale ra ding mangatua at capitan karing libu-libu at karing dina-dinalan, at ding karelang pekapun a sinuyu king ari, king nanumang bague pisasabian king pamirake a lulub at lulual bulan-bulan karing sablang bulan na ning pabanua-king balang pamirake aduangpulu at apat a libu.
King mumunang pamirake dikil king mumunang bulan ya i Jasobeam a anak nang Zabdiel: at king keang dake adua lang pulu at apat a libu.
Ya karin yang anak nang Perez, a pekapun karing anggang capitan ning ejercito dikil king mumunang bulan.
At ing mamajala king pamirake king kaduang bulan ya i Dodai a Ahohita, at ing keang dake; at i Miclot a pekapun: at king keang dake adua lang pulu at apat a libu.
Ing katlung capitan king ejercito makatungkul king katlung bulan ya i Benaia, a anak nang Jeoiada a sacerdote, pekapun ya: at king keang dake adua lang pulu at apat a libu.
Iti ya itang Benaia, a masikanan a lalaki karing atlungpulu, at mamajala karing atlungpulu: at king keang dake ya i Amizabad a anak na.
Ing kapat a capitan a makatungkul king kapat a bulan ya i Asael a kapatad nang Joab, at i Zebadias a keang anak ya ing tinuki kea: at king keang dake adua lang pulu at apat a libu.
Ing kalimang capitan a makatungkul king kalimang bulan ya i Samhut a Izraita: at king keang dake adua lang pulu at apat a libu.
Ing kanam a capitan, a makatungkul king kanam a bulan ya i Ira a anak nang Ikes a Tecoita: at king keang dake adua lang pulu at apat a libu.
Ing kapitung capitan a makatungkul king kapitung bulan ya i Helez a Pelonita, karing anak nang Efraim at king keang dake adua lang pulu at apat a libu.
Ing kawalung capitan a makatungkul king kawalung bulan ya i Sibecai a Husatita, karing Zeraitas: at king keang dake adua lang pulu at apat a libu.
Ing kasiam a capitan a makatungkul king kasiam a bulan ya i Abiezer a Anatotita, karing Benjamitas: at king keang dake adua lang pulu at apat a libu.
Ing capulung capitan a makatungkul king kapulung bulan ya i Maharai a Netofatita, karing Zeraitas: at king keang dake adua lang pulu at apat a libu.
Ing kalabing metung a capitan a makatungkul king kalabing metung a bulan ya i Benaia a Piratonita, karing anak nang Efraim: at king keang dake adua lang pulu at apat a libu.
Ing kalabing aduang capitan a makatungkul king kalabing aduang bulan ya i Heldai a Netofatita, ning Otniel: at king keang dake adua lang pulu at apat a libu.
Bukud kaniti mamajala la karing dai na ning Israel: karing Reubenitas ya i Eliezer a anak nang Zicri a pekapun: karing Simeonitas, ya i Sefatias a anak nang Maaca:
Kang Levi, i Hasabias a anak nang Kemuel: keng Aaron, i Zadoc:
Kang Juda, i Eliu, a metung karing kapatad nang David: kang Isacar, i Omri a anak nang Micael:
Kang Zabulon, i Ismaias a anak nang Obadias: kang Naftali, i Jeremot a anak nang Azriel:
Karing anak nang Efraim, i Hoseas a anak nang Azazias: karing kapitna nang daing Manases, i Joel a anak nang Pedaya:
Karing kapitna nang daing Manases king Gilead, i Iddo a anak nang Zacarias: kang Benjamin, i Jaasiel a anak nang Abner:
Kang Dan, i Azarel a anak nang Jeroham. Deti ilang capitan da ding dai na ning Israel.
Dapot e na depatan David ing pamamilang karela manibat king aduangpulung banua tua at pababa, uling sinabi ning GUINU a keang parakalan ing Israel a anti mo ding batuin banua.
I Joab a anak nang Zeruia migmula yang minilang, dapot e meari; at dinatang king Israel ing mua dikil kaniti; ni e mibili ing bilang king talajan ding cronica ning aring David.

At i Asmavet a anak nang Adiel ya ing mamajala karing pibandian na ning ari: at ya ing mamajala karing pibandian karing marangle, karing ciudad, at karing nayun, at karing castillo, ya i Jonatan a anak nang Uzias:
At ing mamajala karing gagalo king marangle dikil king pamananaman king gabun ya i Ezri a anak nang Quelub:
At ing mamajala karing uvasan ya i Simei a Ramatita: at ing mamajala king pakinabang karing uvasan dikil karing kamalig ning alak ya i Zabdi a Zifmita:
At ing mamajala karing dutung a olivo at karing dutung a sicomoro a atiu king mababang labuad ya i Baal-hanan a Gederita: at ing mamajala karing kamalig ning laru ya i Joas:
At ing mamajala karing kawan a vaca a papastulan da king Saron ya i Sitrai a Saronita: at ing mamajala karing kawan a vaca a atiu karing libis ya i Safat a anak nang Adlai:
At ing mamajala karing Camello ya i Obil a Ismaelita: at ing mamajala karing asno ya i Jedeias a Meronotita: at ing mamajala karing kawan a tupa ya i Jaziz a Hagreo.
Deti ngan talapamajala la king pibandian ning aring David.
I Jonatan man, a bapa nang David, metung yang talausuk, metung yang lalaki ning pamanalastas, at metung a escriba: at i Jehiel a anak nang Hacmoni atiu mamantabe karing anak ning ari:
At i Ahitofel talausuk ne ning ari; at i Husai a Arquita kakaluguran ne ning ari:
At ing tutuki kang Ahitofel ya i Jeoiada a anak nang Benaia, at i Abiatar: at ing capitan ning ejercito na ning ari ya i Joab.

At tinipun nong David ding anggang principes ning Israel, ding principes da ding dai, at ding capitan da ding tapuk a susuyu king ari agpang king pamialialili, at ding capitan da ding libu-libu, at ding capitan da ding dinadinalan, at ding talapamajala king anggang pagkabiayan at kayatinan na ning ari at ding keang anak, a kayabe ra ding pekapun, at ding masikanan a lalaki, ding anggang masikanan ping lalaki ning tapang, king Jerusalem.

Kanita tinalakad ya ing aring David karing keang bitis, at sinabi na, Pakiramdaman yuku, kanakung kapatad, at kanakung balayan: tungkul kaku, atiu king pusu ku ing mitalakad metung a bale pipainawan dikil king kaban ning tipan ning GUINU, at dikil king dalpakan na ning kekatang Dios; at migsadia na ku dikil king pamitalakad.
Dapot sinabi na ning Dios kanaku, E me tatalakad ing metung a bale dikil king kanakung laguiu, uling ika lalaki ka king pamipamuk, at mibubu kang daya.

Makanian man Ing GUINU, a Dios ning Israel, pinili naku king mabilug a bale nang ibpa ku bang maguing ari king Israel king kapilan pa man: uling pinili ne i Juda bang maguing principe; at king bale nang Juda, ing bale na ning kanakung ibpa; at king libutad da ding anak na ning kanakung ibpa metula ya kaku banakung gawan ari king mabilug a Israel;
At karing anggang kakung anak a lalaki (uling dininan nakung dakal a anak a lalaking GUINU), pinili ne i Solomon a kakung anak bayang lukluk king luklukan na ning kayarian ning GUINU king Israel.
At sinabi na kanaku, I Solomon a kekang anak, ya ing mitalakad king kanakung bale at karing kakung patio; uling pinili ke bayang maguing kakung anak, at aku maguing ibpa naku.
At itatag ku ing keang kayarian king kapilan pa man, nung panatilian nong daptan ding kanakung utus at ding kakung tuntunan, anti mo king aldo ngeni.

Ngeni pin, king lalawan na ning mabilug a Israel, ing kapulungan ning GUINU, at king pakiramdam na ning kekatang Dios, tuparan yula at panintunan ding anggang utus ning GUINU a kekong Dios; bayung abandian ing mayap a labuad a iti, at lakuan yung metung a pekamana karing kekong anak a tuki kekayu king kapilan pa man.

At ika, Solomon a kanakung anak, kilalanan me ing Dios na ning kekang ibpa, at suyuwan me king metung a sakdal a pusu at king metung a kusang pamiisip; uling Ing GUINU sasaliksikan no ding anggang pusu, at atatalastas na ing anggang balak da ding kaisipan. Nung panintunan me, akit me; dapot nung paimburisan me, isakuil naka king kapilan pa man.
Mingat ka ngeni; uling pinili naking GUINU bameng italakad ing metung a bale dikil king santuario: magpakasikan ka, at daptan mu iti.

Kanita binie neng David kang Solomon a keang anak ing pilulupan na ning portico ning templo, at ding kabalenan na, at ding pisisimpanan nang pibandian, at ding mangatas nang silid, at ding masiduan nang silid, at ing karinan ning luklukan na ning pakalulu;

At ing pilulupan ning anggang aisip na king pamamilatan na ning Espiritu, tungkul karing patio ning bale ning GUINU, at tungkul karing anggang silid king makapatulug, tungkul karing pisisimpanan nang pibandian ning bale ning Dios, at tungkul karing pisisimpanan pibandian karing makatalagang bague;

Anti naman tungkul king panga dake-dake ra ding sacerdotes at ding Levitas, at tungkul king anggang daraptan a kasuyuwan king bale ning GUINU, at tungkul karing anggang kasangkapan king pamanyuyu king bale ning GUINU;

Ing guintu king pamamilatan na ning timbang dikil karing kasangkapan a guintu, dikil karing anggang kasangkapan king miayaliwang kasuyuwan; ing pilak dikil karing anggang kasangkapan a pilak king pamamilatan na ning timbang, dikil karing anggang kasangkapan king miayaliwang kasuyuwan;

King pamamilatan na naman ning timbang dikil karing pagkandilan a guintu, at dikil karing sulugui na niti, king guintu, king pamamilatan na ning timbang dikil king balang pagkandilan at dikil karing sulugui na niti; at dikil karing pagkandilan a pilak, pilak king pamamilatan na ning timbang dikil king balang pagkandilan at dikil karing sulugui na niti, agpang king kagamitan na ning balang pagkandilan;
At ing guintu king pamamilatan na ning timbang dikil karing dulang ning tinape a ain, dikil king balang dulang; at pilak dikil karing dulang a pilak;

At ding pangalawit laman-kati, at ding palanggana, at ding copa, a guintung dalise; at dikil karing mangkuk a guintu king pamamilatan na ning timbang king balang mangkuk; at dikil karing mangkuk a pilak king pamamilatan na ning timbang dikil king balang mangkuk;

At dikil king altar ning labun guintung dalise king pamamilatan na ning timbang; at guintu dikil king pilulupan na ning carro, ding querubin pin, a makaladlad la ding karelang baguius, at lililungan de ing kaban ning tipan ning GUINU.
Ing sablang iti, sinabi nang David, atalastas ku king sulat a menibatan king gamat ning GUINU, ing anggang dapat pin king anti kaniting pilulupan.

At sinabi nang David kang Solomon a keang anak, Magpakasikan ka at magpakatatag mayap, at daptan mu iti: e ka tatakut, ni mangalambut man; uling Ing GUINUNG Dios, a kanakung Dios pin, mamantabe ya keka; e naka lakuan, ni paimburisan man, angga king ing anggang dapat dikil king pamanyuyu king bale ning GUINU mayari.

At, oini, oreta ding panga dakedake karing sacerdotes at karing Levitas, dikil king anggang kasuyuwan king bale ning Dios: at mika atin ka king sarisaring dapat ning balang tau a ating kusang kaburian a ating kaguematan, dikil king sarisaring kasuyuwan: anti naman ding capitan at ing mabilug a balayan magbili lang lubus king kekang utus.

At sinabi na ning aring David king mabilug a kapulungan, I Solomon a kanakung anak, a ya mung bukud ing pinili na ning Dios, anak ya pa at maina, at ing dapat maragul; uling ing palacio e ya dikil king tau, nung e dikil ya king GUINUNG Dios.

Ngeni misadia ku king kakung mabilug a sikanan dikil king bale na ning kakung Dios guintu dikil karing bague a guintu, at pilak dikil karing bague a pilak, at tangsu dikil karing bague a tangsu, bakal dikil karing bague a bakal, at dutung dikil karing bague a dutung; batung onix, at batung pangalupkup, batung pangayak, at ating sarisaring kule, at ding anggang sarisaring maulagang batu, at ding batung marmol a labislabis.

Bukud pa kaniti, uling binili ku ing kanakung pamalsinta king bale na ning kanakung Dios, anti ning atin kung pibandian a sarili a guintu at pilak, babie ku king bale na ning kanakung Dios, bukud king anggang sidia ku dikil king banal a bale,
Atlu lang libung talentong guintu pin, a guintu ning Ofir, at pitung libung talentong dalise pilak, bang pangalupkup karing dalig ding kabalenan;

Guintu dikil karing bague a guintu, at pilak dikil karing bague a pilak, at dikil karing sarisaring dapat a gawan king pamamilatan da ding gamat da ding talapangawa. Ninu pin ing miyayain laus king lub bang italaga na ing sarili na king aldo a iti king GUINU?

Kanita ding principes karing bale ra ding mangatua, at ding principes karing dai na ning Israel, at ding capitan da ding libu-libu at ding dinadinalan, pati na ding pekapun a mamajala king dapat na ning ari, minain lang kusa;

At minie la dikil king kasuyuwan king bale na ning Dios king guintu lima lang libung talento at apulung libung darico, at king pilak apulung libung talento, at king tangsu labingwalung libung talento, at king bakal dinalan a libung talento.
At detang ating maulagang batu a meakit binie rala king pibandian na ning bale ning GUINU, king lalam na ning gamat nang Jehiel a Gersonita.
Kanita metula ing balayan, uling minain lang kusa, uling kagum ning metung a pusung sakdal minain lang kusa king GUINU: at ing aring David man metula ya king maragul a tula.
Inya pin pepanuanan neng David Ing GUINU king arapan na ning mabilug a kapulungan; at sinabi nang David, Nuan ka, Oh GUINU, a Dios nang Israel a kekeng ibpa, king kapilan pa man.

Keka, Oh GUINU, ing dangalan, at ing kayupayan, at ing ligaya, at ing pamagtagumpe, at ing degulan: uling ing anggang atiu karing banua at king labuad keka; keka ing kayarian, Oh GUINU, at mitas ka a pekabuntuk babo ning sabla.
Ing pibandian at ing puri manibatan keka, at ika ing sasakup king sabla; at atiu king kekang gamat ing kayupayan at sikanan; at atiu king kekang gamat ing pamiparagul, at pamipasikan karing sabla.
Ngeni pin, kekaming Dios, pasalamat kami keka, at pupurian miya ing kekang maligayang laguiu.

Dapot ninu aku, at nanu ing kakung balayan, bang malyari keng makaain kusa a binang laus king lub agpang king anti kaniting kaparalanan? uling ing sablang bague manibatan keka, at king kekang sarili mu rin karin ke minie keka.
Uling tau kami king aliwang labuad king arapan mu, at manaliwa keng balayan, anti mo ding anggang mangatua mi: ding kekeng aldo king labuad anti la mung metung a anino, at alang pamanatili.
Oh GUINUNG kekaming Dios, ding anggang tipun a deti a kekaming sidia bang ipanalakad dakang metung a bale dikil king kekang banal a laguiu ibat la king kekang gamat, at sarili mung bandi ngan.

Pangabaluan ku naman, Dios ko, king susubukan me ing pusu, at atin kang tula king matulid. Tungkul kanaku, king katuliran na ning kanakung pusu inain kong kusa ding anggang bague a deti: at ngeni akakit kung kagum ning tula ing kekang balayan, a atiu keti, a mamain kusa keka.

Oh GUINU, a Dios nang Abraham, nang Isaac, at nang Israel, a kekaming mangatua, ingatan mu iti mangga man king kapilan king pamibule ra ding pamiisip ning pusu ning kekang balayan, at isadia me ing karelang pusu keka;

At dinan me i Solomon a kanakung anak metung a pusung sakdal, banong ingatan ding kekang utus, ding kekang pamipatutu, at ding kekang tuntunan, at bang tuparan no ding anggang bague a deti, at baneng italakad ing palacio, a dikil king nung kaisanu ku dinapat pamagsadia.

At sinabi nang David king mabilug a kapulungan, Ngeni panuanan ye Ing GUINU a kekong Dios. At ing mabilug a kapulungan pepanuan king GUINU, a Dios da ding karelang mangatua, at diku ro ding buntuk da, at simban de Ing GUINU, at ing ari.

At midaun la karing daun king GUINU, at minain la karing ain a durulukan king GUINU, king kabukasan kaibat na ning aldo a ita, libu la ping vaca, libung tupang lalaki, at libung cordero, pati na ding karelang ain a inuman, at daun a labislabis dikil king mabilug a Israel.

At mengan la at mininum king arapan ning GUINU king aldo a ita a ating maragul a tula. At guewa reng ari i Solomon a anak nang David king kaduang ukdu, at linian de king GUINU bayang maguing principe, at i Zadoc bayang maguing sacerdote.
Kanita linukluk ya i Solomon king luklukan ning GUINU a anti mong ari a kalili nang David a keang ibpa, at mipala ya; at ing mabilug a Israel memintu kea.
At ding anggang principes, at ding masikanan a lalaki, at anti naman ding anggang anak na ning aring David, pepasakup da ing sarili ra king aring Solomon.
At peparagul neng bining GUINU i Solomon king panlalawe na ning mabilug a Israel, at binili na kea ing anti kanitang degulan a panga ari a e mike king kaninu mang ari a minuna kea king Israel.
Ngeni i David a anak nang Isai migari ya king mabilug a Israel.
At ing panaun na ning keang pamagari king Israel apatapulung banua; pitu yang banua a migari king Hebron, at atlungpulu at atlung banua ing pamagari na king Jerusalem.
At mete ya king mayap a ketuan, ganap ya karing aldo, pibandian, at kapurian: at i Solomon a keang anak migari yang kalili na.
Ngeni ding dapat na ning aring David, minuna at tauli, oreni, makasulat la king bie nang Samuel a talapanakit, at king bie nang Natan a manula, at king bie nang Gad a talapanakit.
Kagum ning mabilug nang pamagari at ning keang sikanan, at ding panaun a delanan na, at ning Israel, at ding anggang kayarian da ding karinan.
At i Solomon a anak nang David mipasiknangan ya king keang kayarian, at Ing GUINU a keang Dios mamantabe ya kea, at peparagul neng bina.

At miniabi ya i Solomon king mabilug a Israel, karing capitan da ding libu-libu at karing dina-dinalan, at karing ukum, at king balang principe king mabilug a Israel, karing pekabuntuk karing bale ra ding mangatua.

Inya i Solomon, at ing mabilug a kapulungan a kayabe na, mine king matas a karinan a atiu king Gibeon; uling atiu karin ing tabernaculo ning pamitipun king Dios, a guewa na king ilang Moises a talasuyu ning GUINU.
Dapot ing kaban na ning Dios dela neng simpang David manibat king Kiriatjearim angga king karinan a sidia nang David dikil kaniti; uling penalakad neng metung a kubu king Jerusalem.

Makabukud kaniti ing altar a tangsu, a guewa nang Bezalel a anak nang Uri, a anak nang Hur, atiu karin king arapan na ning tabernaculo ning GUINU: at siniasat neng Solomon at ning mabilug a kapulungan.
At i Solomon sinampa ya king altar a tangsu king arapan ning GUINU, a atiu king tabernaculo ning pamitipun, at miain yang libung ain a durulukan babo na.
King benging ita pepaket ya ing Dios kang Solomon, at sinabi na kea, Aduan mu nung nanu ing bibie ku keka.
At sinabi nang Solomon king Dios, Pepakit kang maragul a kayubuan a lub kang ibpa kung i David, at guewa mukung ari a kalili na.
Ngeni, Oh GUINUNG Dios, papagtibayan mu sa ing kekang pengaku kang David a ibpa ku; uling guewa mukung ari king metung a balayan a anti mo ing alikabuk na ning labuad king karakal.
Dinan muku ngening kabiasnan at beluan, bakung milual at milub king arapan na ning balayan a iti; uling ninung makayatul kaniting kekang balayan, a binang maragul?
