At ding anggang atiu king makapatulug karela seupan dala karing kasangkapan a pilak, king guintu, king pibandian, at karing animal, at karing maulagang bague, makabukud karing kusang miain.
Liwal nala naman ning aring Ciro ding lulanan king bale ning GUINU, a liwal nang Nabucodonosor ibat king Jerusalem, at binili nala king bale ra ding keang dioses;
Deta man ping liwal nang Ciro a ari ning Persia king pamamilatan na ning gamat nang Mitredat a talaingat pibandian, at binilang nala kang Sesbazar, a principe ning Juda.
At oiti ing bilang da: atlungpulung pinggan a guintu, libung pinggan a pilak, aduangpulu at siam a cutsilo,
Atlungpulung mangkuk a guintu, ding mangkuk a pilak king kaduang ayus apat lang dalan at apulu, at ding aliwang kasangkapan libu la.

Ding anggang kasangkapan a guintu at pilak lima lang libu at apat a dalan. Deti ngan pepasampa nong Sesbazar, ding kanitang atilu king pangabijag pepasampa ralang menibatan Babilonia angga king Jerusalem.

Ngeni deti pin ila ding anak ning lalawigan, a sinampa a menibatan king pangabijag karetang midala, a dela na Babiloniang Nabucodonosor a ari ning Babilonia, at mibalik Jerusalem at Juda, a ing balang metung king keang ciudad;
At dinatang a kayabe nang Zerubabel, i Jesua, i Nehemias, i Seraya, i Reelaya, i Mardoqueo, i Bilsan, i Mispar, i Bigvai, i Rehum, i Baana. Ing bilang da ding lalaki ning balayan ning Israel:
Ding anak nang Paros, adua lang libu at dinalan at pitungpulu at adua.
Ding anak nang Sefatias, atlu lang dalan pitungpulu at adua.
Ding anak nang Ara, pitu lang dalan pitungpulu at lima.
Ding anak nang Pahat-moab, karing anak nang Jesua at Joab, adua lang libu walung dalan at labingadua.
Ding anak nang Elam, libu la aduang dalan limangpulu at apat.
Ding anak nang Zatu, siam lang dalan apatapulu at lima.
Ding anak nang Zacai, pitu lang dalan anamapulu.
Ding anak nang Bani, anam lang dalan apatapulu at adua.
Ding anak nang Bebai, anam lang dalan aduangpulu at atlu.
Ding anak nang Azgad, libu la aduang dalan aduangpulu at adua.
Ding anak nang Adonicam, anam lang dalan anamapulu at anam.
Ding anak nang Bigvai, adua lang libu limangpulu at anam.
Ding anak nang Adin, apat lang dalan limangpulu at apat.
Ding anak nang Ater, kang Hezequias, siam lang pulu at walu.
Ding anak nang Bezai, atlu lang dalan aduangpulu at atlu.
Ding anak nang Jora, dinalan la at labingadua.
Ding anak nang Hasum, adua lang dalan aduangpulu at atlu.
Ding anak nang Gibar, siam lang pulu at lima.
Ding anak nang Beth-lehem, dinalan la aduangpulu at atlu.
Ding lalaki ning Netofa, lima lang pulu at anam.
Ding lalaki ning Anatot, dinalan la aduangpulu at walu.
Ding anak nang Azmavet, apat lang pulu at adua.
Ding anak nang Kiriat-arim, Cefira, at Beerot, pitu lang dalan apatapulu at atlu.
Ding anak nang Rama at i Geba, anam lang dalan aduangpulu at metung.
Ding lalaki ning Micmas, dinalan la aduangpulu at adua.
Ding lalaki ning Bet-el at Ai, adua lang dalan aduangpulu at atlu.
Ding anak nang Nebo, lima lang pulu at adua.
Ding anak nang Magbis, dinalan la limangpulu at anam.
Ding anak na ning metung a Elam, libu la aduang dalan limangpulu at apat.
Ding anak nang Harim, atlu lang dalan at aduangpulu.
Ding anak nang Lod, Hadid, at Ono, pitu lang dalan aduangpulu at lima.
Ding anak nang Jerico, atlu lang dalan apatapulu at lima.
Ding anak nang Senaa, atlu lang libu at anam a dalan at atlungpulu.
Ding sacerdotes: ding anak nang Jedaya, king bale nang Jesua, siam lang dalan pitungpulu at atlu.
Ding anak nang Imer, libu la limangpulu at adua.
Ding anak nang Pashur, libu la aduangdalan apatapulu at pitu.
Ding anak nang Harim, libu la at labingpitu.
Ding Levitas: ding anak nang Jesua at i Cadmiel, karing anak nang Hodavias, pitu lang pulu at apat.
Ding taladalit: ding anak nang Asaf, dinalan la aduangpulu at walu.

Ding anak da ding bante pasbul: ding anak nang Sallum, ding anak nang Ater, ding anak nang Talmon, ding anak nang Akub, ding anak nang Hatita, ding anak nang Sobai, ding keganagana dinalan la atlungpulu at siam.
Ding Netineos: ding anak nang Ziha, ding anak nang Hasufa, ding anak nang Tabaot,
Ding anak nang Keros, ding anak nang Siaha, ding anak nang Padon,
Ding anak nang Lebana, ding anak nang Hagaba, ding anak nang Akub,
Ding anak nang Hagab, ding anak nang Samlai, ding anak nang Hanan,
Ding anak nang Gidel, ding anak nang Gahar, ding anak nang Reaya,
Ding anak nang Rezin, ding anak nang Necoda, ding anak nang Gazam,
Ding anak nang Uza, ding anak nang Pasea, ding anak nang Besai.
Ding anak nang Asna, ding anak nang Meunim, ding anak nang Nefisim,
Ding anak nang Bacbuc, ding anak nang Hacufa, ding anak nang Harhur,
Ding anak nang Bazlut, ding anak nang Mehida, ding anak nang Harsa,
Ding anak nang Barcos, ding anak nang Sisera, ding anak nang Tema,
Ding anak nang Nezia, ding anak nang Hatifa.
Ding anak da ding talasuyu nang Solomon: ding anak nang Sotai, ding anak nang Hasoferet, ding anak nang Peruda,
Ding anak nang Jaala, ding anak nang Darcon, ding anak nang Gidel,
Ding anak nang Sefatias, ding anak nang Hatil, ding anak nang Poquerethazebaim, ding anak nang Ami.
Ding anggang Netineos, at ding anak da ding talasuyu nang Solomon, atlu lang dalan siamapulu at adua.
At deti ilang sinampa a menibatan king Tel-mela, Tel-harsa, Querub, Adan, at Imer; dapot e ro apakit ding bale ra ding karelang mangatua, at ding karelang bini, nung king Israel la;
Ding anak nang Delaya, ding anak nang Tobias, ding anak nang Necoda, anam lang dalan limangpulu at adua.
At karing anak da ding sacerdotes: ding anak nang Habaia, ding anak nang Hakoz, ding anak nang Barzillai. a mekiasawa karing anak nang Barzillai a Gileadita, at meaus la agpang king karelang laguiu.
Deti penintun do ding karelang talajan karing mebilang agpang king pisulatan karing dai, dapot e la meakit: inya pin mibilang lang marinat at milako la king pangasacerdote.
At sinabi na karela ning gobernador, king e la mamangan karing kabanalbanalan a bague, angga king ating tinalakad metung a sacerdote a ating Urim at Tumim.
Ing mabilug a kapulungan a miabe apatapulu at aduang libu atlung dalan at anamapulu,
Subali karing karelang alipan a lalaki at ding karelang alipan a babai, a atin lang pitung libu atlung dalan atlungpulu at pitu: at atin lang aduang dalan a taladalit a lalaki at taladalit a babai.
Ding karelang kabayu pitu lang dalan atlungpulu at anam; ding karelang mula, adua lang dalan apatapulu at lima;
Ding karelang camello, apat lang dalan atlungpulu at lima; ding karelang asno, anam lang libu pitung dalan at aduangpulu.

At ding mapilan karing pekabuntuk karing bale ra ding mangatua, inyang dinatang la king bale ning GUINU a atiu king Jerusalem, minain lang kusa dikil king bale ning Dios bareng italakad king keang karinan:
Minie la agpang king karelang kaguiuwan king simpanan pibandian ning gagawan anam lang pulu at metung a libung daricong guintu, at limang libung librang pilak, at dinalan a imalan sacerdotes.

Inya ding sacerdotes, at ding Levitas, at ding mapilan king balayan, at ding taladalit, at ding bante pasbul, at ding Netineos, menuknangan la karing ciudad da, at ing mabilug a Israel karing karelang ciudad.
At inyang miras ing kapitung bulan, at ding anak na ning Israel atilu karing ciudad, ing balayan mitipun makapamisan anting metung a lalaki king Jerusalem.

Kanita tinalakad ya i Jesua a anak nang Josadac, at ding keang kapatad a sacerdotes, at i Zerubabel a anak nang Sealtiel, at ding keang kapatad, at telakad ne ing altar na ning Dios ning Israel, bang main la babo na karing ain a durulukan, anti mo ing makasulat king kautusan nang Moises a lalaki ning Dios.

At timpak de ing altar king keang katatalakaran; uling ing takut atiu karela king uli ra ding balayan da ding labuad: at minain lang ain a durulukan king babo na king GUINU, ding ain a durulukan pin king abak at gatpanapun.

At pigmasusian da ing pista ra ding tabernaculos, anti mo ing makasulat, at inain da ing aldawan a ain a durulukan king pamamilatan ning bilang, a makayagpang king tuntunan, anti mo ing katungkulan a mayayawad king balang aldo;

At kaibat ing makaparating ain a durulukan, at ding ain karing bayung bulan, at karing anggang makatuldung pista ning GUINU a nung isanu ding mitalaga, at king balang metung a minain kusa king metung a kusang ain king GUINU.
Manibat king mumunang aldo ning kapitung bulan migmula lang minain karing ain a durulukan king GUINU: dapot ing pitatalakaran ning templo ning GUINU e ya pa mibili.

Minie la namang salapi karing aluaguing batu, at karing aluagui; at pamangan, at inuman, at laru, karing tau king Sidon, at ding king Tiro, balang magdalang dutung a cedro a manibatan king Libano a iparalan dala king dayatmalat, angga king Joppe, agpang king kapaintulutan a atiu karela a menibatan kang Ciro a ari ning Persia.

Ngeni king kaduang banua ning paniatang da king bale ning Dios karin Jerusalem, king kaduang bulan, migmula ya i Zerubabel a anak nang Sealtiel, at i Jesua a anak nang Josadac, at ding mitagan karing karelang kapatad a sacerdotes at ding Levitas, at ila ngan a menibatan king pangabijag a mine king Jerusalem, at tilduan dala ding Levitas, manibat king aduangpulung banua tua at paitas, bang mika ating pamaniasat king dapat king bale ning GUINU.

Kanita tinalakad ya i Jesua a kayabe nala ding keang anak a lalaki at ding keang kapatad, i Cadmiel at ding keang anak a lalaki, a anak nang lalaking Juda, a miabeabe, bang mika ating pamaniasat karing talapaniapat king bale ning Dios: ding anak nang lalaking Henadad, kayabe ro ding karelang anak a lalaki at ding karelang kapatad a Levitas.

At inyang ding manalakad binili re ing pitatalakaran ning templo ning GUINU, binili rala ding sacerdotes king piblas da a atin lang pakakak, at ding Levitas a anak nang Asaf a atin lang cimbalo, balang muri king GUINU, agpang king ayus nang David a ari ning Israel.

At dinalit la ing metung at metung king pamamuri at pamamie pasalamat king GUINU, sinabi ra, Uling mayap ya, uling ing keang kapakaluluan manatili kapilan man king Israel. At ing mabilug a balayan kinulisak king metung a masikan a kulisak, kanitang minuri la king GUINU, uling ing pitatalakaran na ning bale ning GUINU mibili ne.

Dapot dakal la karing sacerdotes at Levitas at pekabuntuk karing bale ra ding mangatua, ding makatuang lalaki a menakit king bale a minuna, inyang ing pitatalakaran na ning bale a iti mibili ya king arapan da ding karelang mata, kiniak la king metung a masikan a siwala; at ding keraklan kinulisak lang masikan king uli ning tula:

Nanupata e na malyaring akilala ning balayan ing inge na ning kulisak king tula king inge na ning kiak ning balayan; uling ing balayan kinulisak king metung a masikan a kulisak, at ing inge meramdam king marayu.
Ngeni inyang dimdam da ding kasalang na ning Juda at Benjamin king ding anak ning pangabijag mitatalakad lang metung a templo king GUINU, a Dios na ning Israel;

Kanita linapit la kang Zerubabel, at karing pekabuntuk da ding bale ra ding mangatua, at sinabi ra karela, Pabustan yung manalakad keng kayabe yu; uling panintunan miya ing kekong Dios, a anti mo ikayu; at ikami dumaun ke kea manibat karing kayaldawan nang Esarhadon a ari ning Asiria, a misampa kekami keti.

Dapot i Zerubabel, at i Jesua, at ding makatagan karing pekabuntuk karing bale ra ding mangatua na ning Israel, sinabi ra karela, Ala kong pakialam kekami king pamitalakad metung a bale king kekaming Dios; nung e king kasarilinan mi a miabeabe ipanalakad miya Ing GUINU, ing Dios ning Israel, anti mo ing inutus na kekaming Ciro a ari ning Persia.
Kanita pepaina no ning balayan ning labuad ding gamat na ning balayan ning Juda, at lingasngasan dala king pamanalakad,
At menupa lang talausuk salang karela, barang sayangan ing karelang nasa, karing anggang kayaldawan nang Ciro a ari ning Persia, angga pin king pamagari nang Dario a ari ning Persia.
At king pamagari nang Asuero, king pamagmula na ning keang pamagari, sinulat lang metung a sumbung salang karing manuknangan ning Juda at Jerusalem.

At karing kayaldawan nang Artajerjes sinulat la i Bislam, i Mitredat, i Tabeel, at ding mitagan karing keang kayabe, kang Artajerjes a ari ning Persia; at ing pangasulat na ning sulat misulat king letrang Ciriaca, at milimbag king amanung Ciriaca.
I Rehum a pekapun a ukum at i Simsai a escriba sinulat yang metung a sulat salang king Jerusalem king aring Artajerjes king anti kanining kaparalanan:

Kanita sinulat ya i Rehum a pekapun a ukum, at i Simsai a escriba, at ding aliwa karing karelang kayabe, ding Dinaitas, at ding Afarsatquitas, ding Tarpelitas, ding Afarsitas, ding Arquevitas, ding tau Babilonia, ding Susanquitas, ding Dehaitas, ding Elamitas,
At ding mitagan karing bansa a delakit na ning marangal at mapiang Osnapar, at binili nala king ciudad ning Samaria, at king mitagan king labuad king nangan na karin ning Ilug, at aliwa pa.
Oiti ing likas na ning sulat a pepadala ra king aring Artajerjes: Ding kekang talasuyung lalaki king nangan na karin ning Ilug, at aliwa pa.

Abalu na pin ning ari, king ding Judios a sinampa a menibatan keka miras la kekami king Jerusalem; karela yang tatalakad ing mapanlaban at marawak a ciudad, at meari no ding kuta, at lerinan do ding pitatalakaran.
Abalu na pin ngeni ning ari, king, nung ing ciudad a iti mitalakad ya, at ding kuta mayari la, e no mamayad king buis, king aduana, o king pamanialakit, at king kawakasan ikapanganyaya ra ding ari.
Ngeni uling kakanan mi ing asin king palacio, at e karampatan kekami a akit mi ing makayalang puri king ari, inya pin mitubud kami at pepatutu king ari;

King bang ing pamanintun marapat king libru ra ding talajan da ding kekang mangatua: kaniti akit mu king libru ra ding talajan, at abalu mu king ing ciudad a iti metung yang mapanlaban a ciudad, a makapanganiaya karing ari at lalawigan, at king kinimut lang dinapat bala kilub niti mu rin kanitang minunang panaun; a ya ing kelasak na ning ciudad a iti.
Patutuan mi king ari king, nung ing ciudad a ini mitalakad ya, at ding kuta mayari la, king kaparalanan a iti e ka mika ating dake king nangan na karin ning Ilug.

Kanita ing ari peparala na ing pakibat kang Rehum a pekapun a ukum, at kang Simsai a escriba, at karing aliwa karing kayabe ra a manuknangan king Samaria, at king aliwang karinan a nangan na karin ning Ilug; Kapayapan, at aliwa pa.
Ing sulat a peparala yu kekami mebasa yang malino king arapan ku.
At minie kung utus, at ing kapaniasatan merapat, at meakit king ing matuang ciudad a iti dinapat pamanalangsang salang karing ari, at ing kapaglabanan at ing pamaniapat bala a ita merapat karin.
Mika atin mu namang aring masikanan king Jerusalem, a sinakup king mabilug a labuad king nangan na karin ning Ilug; at ing buis, ing bayad king aduana, at ing bayad king pamanialakit, mibayad karela.
Gawa kong utus ngeni a patuknangan yula ding taung deti, at bang ing ciudad a iti e mitalakad, angga king ing metung a utus agawa ke.
At mingat kayu a e ko magpakamangmang kaniti; baket ing kasiran tumubu king ikapanganiaya ra ding ari?

Kanita inyang mabasa ya ing likas na ning sulat na ning aring Artajerjes king arapan nang Rehum, at Simsai a escriba, at ding karelang kayabe, migmalagawa lang mine king Jerusalem karing Judios, at pepatuknangan dala king pamamilatan na ning sikanan at ning kayupayan.
Kanita mituknang ing dapat king bale na ning Dios a atiu king Jerusalem; at mituknang angga king kadua nang banua ning pamagari nang Dario a ari ning Persia.
Ngeni ding manula, i Haggeo a manula, at i Zacarias a anak nang Iddo, menula la karing Judios a atiu king Juda at king Jerusalem; king laguiu na ning Dios ning Israel menula la karela.

Kanita tinalakad ya i Zorobabel a anak nang Sealtiel, at i Jesua a anak nang Josadac, at pigmulan deng telakad ing bale na ning Dios a atiu king Jerusalem; at kayabe rala ding manula na ning Dios, a sasaup karela.

Kanita mu ring panaun a ita dinatang ya karela i Tatenai, a gobernador king nangan na karin ning Ilug, at i Setarbozenai, at ding karelang kayabe, at miniabi lang anti kanini karela, Ninung minie utus kekayu bayeng italakad ing bale a iti, at bang arian ye ing kutang iti?
Kanita miniabi kami karela king anti kanining kaparalanan, nung nanu la laguiu ding tau a guinawa king bale a iti.

Dapot ing mata na ning karelang Dios atiu karing makatua karing Judios, at e ro pepatuknang, angga king ing bague dinatang kang Dario, at kanita ing pakibat sukat ibalik king pamamilatan na ning sulat tungkul kaniti.

Ing likas na ning sulat a i Tetanai, a gobernador king nangan na karin ning Ilug, at i Setar-bozenai, at ding keang kayabe a Afarsaquitas, a atiu king nangan na karin ning Ilug, pepadala re king aring Dario;
Pepadala lang metung a sulat kea, a nung nu makasulat ing anti kanini: Kang aring Dario, ing sablang kapayapan.

Abalu na pin ning ari, king mine kami king lalawigan na ning Juda, king bale na ning maragul a Dios, a mitalakad karing mangaragul a batu, at dutung la ding milapat karing kuta; at ing dapat a iti susulung king sipagan at mipapala ya king karelang gamat.
Kanita kitnan mila ding makatuang deta, at miniabi ke karelang makanian, Ninung minie utus kekayu bayeng italakad ing bale a iti, at bang arian ya ing kutang iti?
Kitang mi mu naman ing karelang laguiu, baming patutuan keka, baming asulat ing laguiu ra ding lalaki a pekabuntuk da.

At makanian ing binalik dang pakibat kekami, sinabi ra, Talasuyu nakami ning Dios ning banua at ning labuad, at tatalakad miya ing bale a iti a mitalakad ne king dakal nang banuang milabas, a telakad ne at inari ning metung a maragul a ari ning Israel.

Dapot kaibat na nita ding kekeng mangatua pemungkasian de king mua ing Dios ning banua, binie no king gamat nang Nabucodonosor a ari ning Babilonia, Caldeo ya, a ya ing linasak king bale a iti, at dela na ing balayan karin Babilonia.
Dapot king mumuna nang banuang Ciro a ari ning Babilonia, ing aring Ciro guinawa yang metung a utus bang italakad ya iting bale ning Dios.

At ing guintu at ding kasangkapan a pilak man king bale na ning Dios, a liwal nang Nabucodonosor king templo a atiu king Jerusalem, at dela nala king kilub ning templo ning Babilonia, deta ilang liwal na ning aring Ciro ibat king templo ning Babilonia, at miabie la king metung a milaguiung Sesbazar, a ya ing guewa nang gobernador;
At sinabi na kea, Kuanan mo ding lulanan a deti, ume ka, ilub mula king templo a atiu karin Jerusalem, at pabustan mung mitalakad ya ing bale na ning Dios king keang karinan.

Kanita iti mu ring Sesbazar dinatang ya, at binili nala ding pitatalakaran na ning bale ning Dios a atiu king Jerusalem: at manibat king panaun a ita angga pin ngeni mitatalakad ne, at makanianman e ya pa miganap.

Ngeni pin, nung babalakan nang mayap ning ari, pabustan mika kapaniasatan a marapat king bale pisisimpanan nang pibandian ning ari, a atiu karin king Babilonia, nung makanian pin, king ing metung a utus guewa ne ning aring Ciro bang italakad ne ing bale nang iti ning Dios king Jerusalem; at ipabal na sa ning ari ing keang tula kekami makatungkul kaniting bague.
Kanita ing aring Dario guinawa yang metung a utus, at ing pamaniasat merapat king bale ra ding aklat, nung nu la makabili ding pibandian king Babilonia.
At ating meakit king Acmeta, king palacio a atiu king lalawigan na ning Media, metung a lulun, at karin makasulat ing anti kaniti a metung a pekatalajan:

King mumuna nang banua ning aring Ciro, ing aring Ciro guinawa yang metung a utus: Makatungkul king bale ning Dios king Jerusalem, pabustan yang mitalakad ing bale, ing karinan a karelang piainan karing daun, at pabustan a ding pitatalakaran na mibili lang matibe; ing katas na anamapulung siku, at ing liwalas na anamapulung siku;
Pati na ding atlung talatag ding mangaragul a batu, at metung a talatag karing bayung dutung: at ing magugul pabustan miabie a manibatan king bale ning ari.

At anti naman pabustan a ding lulanan a guintu at pilak king bale ning Dios, at liwal nang Nabucodonosor ibat king templo a atiu king Jerusalem, at midala king Babilonia, misubli la, at milub lang pasibayu king templo a atiu king Jerusalem, balang metung king keang karinan; at ibili mula king bale na ning Dios.
Ngeni pin, Tatenai, a gobernador king nangan na karin ning Ilug, i Setarbozenai, at ding kekong kayabe a Afarsaquitas, a atiu king nangan na karin ning Ilug, pasidayu kayung manibat karin:
Pabustan dili na ing pamangan kaniting bale na ning Dios; pabustan a ing gobernador da ding Judios at ding makatua ra ding Judios italakad de ing bale a iti ning Dios king keang karinan.

Makabukud kaniti gagawa kung metung a utus nung nanu ing kekong daptan karing makatua rang deti ding Judios dikil king pamitalakad king bale nang iti ning Dios: karing pibandian na ning ari, king buis pin king nangan na karin ning Ilug, ing gugul ibie king lubus a kasipagan karing lalaking deti, balang e mayayambangan.

At ing karelang kakailanganan, anti mo ding biserung vaca, at tupa, at cordero, dikil karing ain a durulukan patungkul king Dios ning banua; anti naman trigu, asin, alak, at laru, agpang king amanu ra ding sacerdotes a atiu king Jerusalem, pabustan ibie karela aldo-aldo a e sasalanan;
Balang main karing daun a mabanglung bau king Dios ning banua, at manalangin dikil king bie na ning ari, at karing keang anak.

Makanian mu naman guinawa kung metung a utus, a ing ninumang mibayu king amanung iti, pabustan yang bagutan ing metung a sikang king keang bale, at pabustan yang mitas at mibitin ya karin: at ing keang bale pabustan yang magawang metung a pididinatan king uli na niti:

At ing Dios a pepanuknanganan na ing laguiu na karin lasakan nala ding anggang ari at ding balayan a miatyat king karelang gamat barang ibayu iti mu rin, bang lasakan de ing bale nang iti ning Dios a atiu king Jerusalem. Aku i Dario guinawa kung metung a utus: pabustan yang marapat iti king lubus a kasipagan.
Kanita i Tatenai, a gobernador king nangan na karin ning Ilug, i Setar-bo-zenai, at ding karelang kayabe, uli na ning pepabal ning aring Dario, depatan da a makayagpang king lubus a kasipagan.

At ding makatua ra ding Judios menalakad la at mipala, king uli ning pamanula nang Haggeo a manula at i Zacarias a anak nang Iddo. At telakad de at inari re, agpang king utus na ning Dios ning Israel, at agpang king utus nang Ciro, at i Dario, at i Artajerjes a ari ning Persia.
At ing bale a iti meari ya king katlu nang aldo ning bulan ning Adar, king kanam a banua ning pamagari na ning aring Dario.
At ding anak na ning Israel, ding sacerdotes at ding Levitas, at ding mitagan karing anak king pangabijag, migkasusi la king pamitalaga king bale nang iti ning Dios a kagum ning tula.

At minain la king pamitalaga king bale nang iti ning Dios dinalan a vaca, aduang dalan a lalaking tupa, apat a dalan a cordero; at dikil king metung a ain king kasalanan dikil king mabilug a Israel, labi lang aduang lalaking kambing, agpang king bilang da ding dai ning Israel.

At binili rala ding sacerdotes karing karelang panga dake-dake, at ding Levitas king karelang pamialialili, dikil king pamaniuyu king Dios, a atiu king Jerusalem; anti mo ing makasulat king libru nang Moises.
At ding anak ning pangabijag pigmasusian da ing pascua king kalabi nang apat a aldo ning mumunang bulan.

Uling ding sacerdotes at ding Levitas migpakalinis lang miabeabe; ila ngan melinis la; at pete re ing cordero ning pascua dikil karing anggang anak ning pangabijag, at dikil karing karelang kapatad a sacerdotes, at dikil king karelang sarili.

At ding anak na ning Israel a mibalik pasibayu a menibatan king pangabijag, at detang anggang kewani ra ing sarili ra karela a manibatan king karinatan da ding bansa na ning labuad, bareng panintunan Ing GUINU, a Dios ning Israel, pesipangan la,

At pigmasusian da ing pista na ning tinape alang levadura pitung aldo a kagum ning tula: uling pepasayan nong GUINU, at binalik ne ing pusu na ning ari ning Asiria karela, banong pasiknangan ding karelang gamat king dapat king bale na ning Dios, a Dios ning Israel.
Ngeni kaibat da ding bague a deti, king pamagari nang Artajerjes a ari ning Persia, i Esdras, anak nang Seraya, a anak nang Azarias, a anak nang Seraya, a anak nang Azarias, a anak nang Hilcias,
A anak nang Sallum, a anak nang Zadoc, a anak nang Ahitub,
A anak nang Amarias, a anak nang Azarias, a anak nang Merayot,
A anak nang Zeraya, a anak nang Uzzi, a anak nang Buki,
A anak nang Abisua, a anak nang Fineas, a anak nang Eleazar, a anak nang Aaron a pun a sacerdote--

I Esdras a iti, sinampa yang menibatan Babilonia. At metung yang pantas a escriba king kautusan nang Moises, a Ing GUINU, a Dios ning Israel, binie na; at ing ari binie na kea ing sabla nang inawad, agpang king gamat ning GUINU a keang Dios a atiu kea.

At ating sinampa a mapilan karing anak na ning Israel, at karing sacerdotes, at karing Levitas, at ding taladalit, at ding bante pasbul, at ding Netineos, karin Jerusalem, king kapitu nang banua ning aring Artajerjes.
At miras ya king Jerusalem king kalimang bulan, a ya ing king kapitu nang banua ning ari.

Uling king mumunang aldo ning mumunang bulan migmula yang sinampa manibat Babilonia; at king mumunang aldo ning kalimang bulan dinatang ya Jerusalem, agpang king mayap nang gamat ning keang Dios a atiu kea.
Uling i Esdras binili ne ing keang pusu king pamanintun king kautusan ning GUINU, at banang daptan iti, at bayang turu king Israel karing tuntunan at utus.
Ngeni oiti ing likas na ning sulat a binie na ning aring Artajerjes kang Esdras a sacerdote, a escriba, ing escriba pin karing amanu ra ding utus ning GUINU, at karing keang tuntunan king Israel:
I Artajerjes, a ari ra ding ari, kang Esdras a sacerdote, a escriba ning kautusan na ning Dios ning banua, sakdal, at aliwa pa.

Gawa kung metung a utus, bang ila ngan a king balayan na ning Israel, at ding karelang sacerdotes at ding Levitas, king kanakung sakup, a migmunikala king karelang sariling kusa a ume karin Jerusalem, tuki la keka.
Uling anti ning ika tinubud naka ning ari at ding keang pitung talausuk, bang pakibaluan mu ing makatungkul king Juda at Jerusalem, agpang king kautusan na ning kekang Dios a atiu king kekang gamat,
At bang dalan ing pilak at guintu, a inain dang kusa ning ari at keang talausuk king Dios ning Israel, a ing panuknanganan na atiu Jerusalem,

At ing anggang pilak at guintu a akit yu king mabilug a lalawigan na ning Babilonia, pati na ing kusa nang ain ning balayan, at ding sacerdotes, a mamain kusa dikil king bale na ning karelang Dios a atiu king Jerusalem;

Inya sali ka king lubus a kasipagan king pamamilatan ding salaping deti karing vaca, karing tupang lalaki, karing cordero, pati na ding ain dang pamangan at ding karelang ain a inuman, at yain la king babo ning altar ning bale na ning kekang Dios a atiu king Jerusalem.
At ing nanumang babalakan mung mayap at ding kekang kapatad a daptan yu karing labis a pilak at guintu, ita daptan yu agpang king kaburian na ning kekong Dios.
At ding kasangkapan a miabie keka dikil king kasuyuwan king bale ning kekang Dios, ibie mula king arapan na ning Dios ning Jerusalem.
At nanumang kakailanganan pa dikil king bale na ning kekang Dios, a apanaunan mung ibie, ibie mu iti a manibatan king bale pibandian ning ari.

At aku, aku pin ing aring Artajerjes, guinawa kung metung a utus karing anggang talaingat pibandian a atiu king nangan na karin ning Ilug, king bang ing nanumang aduan na kekayung Esdras a sacerdote, a escriba king kautusan na ning Dios ning banua, marapat king lubus a kasi a kasipagan,
Angga king dinalan a talentong pilak, at angga king dinalan a takal a trigu, at angga king dinalan a batong alak, at angga king dinalan a batong laru, at asin a alang tasa nung nu anti.
Nanumang miutus king pamamilatan na ning Dios banua, pabustan marapat tapat king bale na ning Dios ning banua; uling baket mika ating mua salang king sasakupan na ning ari at karing keang anak?

Anti naman patutuan mi keka, king tungkul king ninuman karing sacerdotes at Levitas, ding taladalit, ding bante pasbul, ding Netineos, o ding talasuyu king bale nang iti ning Dios, e katuliran ing singil buis, bayad king adunaa, o bayad king pamanialakit, karela.

At ika, Esdras, agpang king kabiasnan na ning kekang Dios a atiu king kekang gamat, tuldu kang magistrados at ukum, a makayatul king mabilug a balayan a atiu king nangan na karin ning Ilug, detang anggang maki balu karing kautusan na ning kekang Dios; at ituru yula detang e makibalu.

At ninumang e tupad king kautusan na ning kekang Dios, at king kautusan na ning ari, pabustan marapat kea ing kayatulan king lubus a kasipagan, maguing king kamatayan man, o king pangaugse, o king pangayakua ning kayatinan, o king pangasukul.
Nuan ya Ing GUINU, ing Dios da ding kekatang mangatua, a mibili king anti kaniting bague iti king pusu na ning ari, bayang pasantingan ing bale ning GUINU a atiu king Jerusalem;

At peparas na kaku ing pakalulu king arapan na ning ari, at ding keang talausuk, at king arapan da ding anggang masikanan a principes na ning ari. At aku, mipasiknangan ku agpang king gamat ning GUINU a kanakung Dios kanaku, at tinipun kong makapamisan ibat king Israel ding lalaking pekapun bang sampang kayabe ku.
Ngeni deti ilang pekabuntuk karing bale ra ding karelang mangatua, at iti ing pisulatan karing dai ra ding sinampang kayabe ku a menibatan Babilonia, king pamaniakup na ning aring Artajerjes:
Karing anak nang Fineas, i Gersom. Karing anak nang Itamar, i Daniel, Karing anak nang David, i Hatus.
Karing anak nang Secanias, karing anak nang Paros, i Zacarias; at kayabe nalang mebilang agpang king pisulatan da ding dai ra ding lalaking dinalan at limangpulu.
Karing anak nang Pahat-moab, i Elieoenai a anak nang Zerahias; at ding kayabe na adua lang dalan a lalaki.
Karing anak nang Secanias, a anak nang Jahaziel; at ding kayabe na atlu lang dalan a lalaki.
At karing anak nang Adin, i Ebed a anak nang Jonatan; at ding kayabe na lima lang pulung lalaki.
At karing anak nang Elam, i Jesaias a anak nang Atalia; at ding kayabe na pitu lang pulung lalaki.
At karing anak nang Sefatias, i Zebadias a anak nang Micael; at ding kayabe na walu lang pulung lalaki.
Karing anak nang Joab, i Obadias a anak nang Jehiel; at ding kayabe na adua lang dalan at labingwalung lalaki.
At karing anak nang Selomit a anak nang Josifias; at ding kayabe na dinalan la at anamapulung lalaki.
At karing anak nang Bebai, i Zacarias a anak nang Bebai; at ding kayabe na adua lang pulu at walung lalaki.
At karing anak nang Azgad, i Joanan a anak nang Hakatan; at ding kayabe na dinalan la at apulung lalaki.
At karing anak nang Adonicam, ding tauli; at oreti ding karelang laguiu: i Elifelet, i Jeuel, at i Semaias; at ding kayabe ra anam lang pulung lalaki.
At karing anak nang Bigvai, i Utai at i Zabud; at ding kayabe ra pitu lang pulung lalaki.
At tinipun kong makapamisan king ilug a mamagus a mame king Ahava; at karin ke pepainawang atlung aldo: at pegumasdan ku ing balayan, at ding sacerdotes, at ala kung ikit karin karing anak nang Levi.

Kanita mitubud ku dikil kang Eliezer, dikil kang Ariel, dikil kang Semaya, at dikil kang Elnatan, at dikil kang Jarib, at dikil kang Elnatan at dikil kang Natan, at dikil kang Zacarias, at dikil kang Mesullam lalaki lang pekapun; anti naman dikil kang Joiarib, at dikil kang Elnatan, deti talaturu la.

At tinubud kula kang Iddo a pekapun king karinan na ning Casifia; at selese ku karela nung nanu ing karelang karampatan sabian kang Iddo, at karing keang kapatad a Netineo, king karinan na ning Casifia, king bang magdala la kekatamu talapanibala dikil king bale na ning kekatang Dios.

At agpang king mayap nang gamat ning kekatang Dios migdala la kekatamung metung a lalaking pantas, karing anak nang Mali, a anak nang Levi, a anak nang Israel; at i Serebias, pati na ding keang anak a lalaki at ding keang kapatad, labi lang walu; '
At i Hasabias, at kayabe ne i i Jesaias karing anak nang Merari, ding keang kapatad at ding anak dang lalaki, adua lang pulu;
At karing Netineos, a binie nang David at ding principes dikil king kasuyuwan da ding Levitas, adua lang dalan at aduangpulung Netineos; deti ngan masasalese la king laguiu.

Kanita mibulalag kung metung a ayunu karin, king ilug na ning Ahava, batang magpakumbaba king arapan na ning kekatang Dios, bang manintun kea king matulid a dalan dikil kekatamu, at dikil karing kekatang anak a mangalati, at dikil king sabla tang kayatinan.

Uling merine kung miniawad king ari metung a tapuk da ding kawal at karing sasake kabayu barakatang saupan salang king kasalang king dalan, uling sinabi mi king ari, ngami, Ing gamat na ning kekatang Dios atiu karetang sablang manintun kea, dikil king mayap; dapot ing keang kayupayan at ing keang mua atiu salang karing anggang paimburis kea.
Inya migayunu tamu at migamuamu king kekatang Dios makatungkul kaniti: at meamuyut ya kekatamu.
Kanita kewani kula ding labingadua karing pekapun a sacerdotes, ila pin di Serebias i Hasabias, at kayabe rala ding apulu karing karelang kapatad.

At tinimbang da karela ing pilak, at ing guintu, at ding kasangkapan, ing ain pin dikil king bale na ning kekatang Dios, a ning ari, at ding keang talausuk, at ding keang principes, at ing mabilug a Israel a makarap karin, inain da:
Tinimbang ko king karelang gamat ding anam a dalan at limangpulung talentong pilak, at ding pilak a kasangkapan dinalan lang talento; ding guintu dinalan lang talento;
At aduangpulung mangkuk a guintu, a libung darico; at aduang lulanan a tangsung mebuling makintab, a kayalagang guintu.
At sinabi ku karela, Banal kayu king GUINU, at ding kasangkapan banal la; at ing pilak at ing guintu ain lang kusa king GUINU, a Dios da ding kekong mangatua.

Magbante kayu, at ingatan yula angga king atimbang yula, king arapan da ding pekapun da ding sacerdotes at ding Levitas, at ding principes karing bale ra ding mangatua ning Israel, king Jerusalem, karing silid na ning bale ning GUINU.
Inya ding sacerdotes at ding Levitas tinggap da ing timbang ning pilak at ning guintu, at ding kasangkapan, barong dalan karin Jerusalem king bale na ning kekatang Dios.

Kanita meko tamu manibat king ilug ning Ahava king kalabi nang aduang aldo ning mumunang bulan, bang ume karin Jerusalem: at ing gamat na ning kekatang Dios atiu kekatamu, at linigtas nakatamu manibat king gamat na ning kasalang at ing magbante a makayabat king dalan.
At miras tamu Jerusalem, at pepainawa tamu karin atlung aldo.

At king kapat a aldo ing pilak at ing guintu at ding kasangkapan metimbang la king bale na ning kekatang Dios king gamat nang Meremot a anak nang Urias a sacerdote (at kayabe ne i Eleazar a anak nang Fineas: at kayabe re i Josabad a anak nang Jesua, at i Noadias a anak nang Binui, a Levitas) -
Ing kabilugan king pamamilatan ning karelang bilang at king pamamilatan ning karelang timbang: at ing anggang timbang misulat king panaun a ita.

Ding anak na ning pangabijag, a menibatan king pangaugse, minain lang ain a durulukan king Dios ning Israel, labi lang aduang vaca dikil king mabilug a Israel, siamapulu at anam a lalaking tupa, pitungpulu at pitung cordero, labingaduang kambing a lalaki dikil king metung a ain king kasalanan: ing sablang iti metung a ain a durulukan king GUINU.
At binie ro ding utus na ning ari karing satrapas na ning ari, at karing gobernador king nangan na karin ning Ilug: at pepasulungan da ing balayan at ing bale na ning Dios.

Ngeni inyang ding bague a deti merapat la, ding principes linapit la kanaku, sinabi ra, Ing balayan ning Israel, at ding sacerdotes at ding Levitas, e la pesikawani karing balayan da ding labuad, darapat lang agpang karing karelang makasumami, ila pin ding karing Cananeos, karing Heteos, karing Perezeos, karing Jebuseos, karing Ammonitas, karing Moabitas, karing Egipcios, at karing Amoreos.

Uling kinanua la karing karelang anak a babai dikil karing karelang sarili at dikil karing karelang anak a lalaki, nanupata ing banal a bini sinalat da karing balayan da ding labuad: wa, ing gamat da ding principes at ding talasakup meguing pekabuntuk ya king pamanalangsang a iti.
At inyang damdaman ku ing bague a iti, guinabak ku ing kakung susulud at ing kakung balabal, at guinut ku ing buak na ning kanakung buntuk at ing kanakung balbas, at linukluk kung metilijan.

Kanita mitipun la kanaku ding anggang gagalgal karing amanu na ning Dios ning Israel, king uli na ning pamanalangsang da ding king pangabijag; at linukluk kung makatilijan angga king pamagpakawasa king gatpanapun.

At king pamagkawasa king gatpanapun tinalakad ku manibat king kanakung pamagpakumbaba, a gabak pin ing kanakung susulud at ing kanakung balabal; at siniklaud ku karing kanakung tud, at tinas kulang makaladlad ding kanakung gamat king GUINU a kanakung Dios;

At sinabi ku, Oh Dios ko, marine ku at mitmu ku king kagutgutan a yatna ke ing kanakung lupa keka, Dios ko; uling ding kekaming dewakan merakal la king babo na ning kekaming buntuk, at ing kekaming kasalanan tinubung mitas angga banua.

Manibat karing kayaldawan da ding kekeng mangatua meguing bina kaming makasalanan angga king aldo ngeni; at king uli ning kekaming dewakan, ikami, ding kekaming ari, at ding kekaming sacerdotes, miabie kami king gamat da ding ari karing labuad, king talibung, king pangabijag, at king pangasamsam, at king kaguluan king lupa, anti ing king aldo ngeni.

At ngeni king saguling penandit ing kalam mipakit a menibatan king GUINU a kekaming Dios, baneng lakuan kekami ing metung a matagan a mitakas, at banakeng dinan metung a paku king keang banal a karinan, banong pasalan ning kekaming Dios ding kekaming mata, at dinan nakami king ditak a pangabawi king kekaming pangayalipan.

Uling alipan kami; makanianman e nake pepaimburisan ning kekaming Dios king kekaming pangayalipan, nung e peparas na ing pakalulu kekami king panimanman da ding ari ning Persia, barakeng dinan metung a pangabawi, bamiyang italakad ing bale na ning kekaming Dios, at bang larinan mi ing kasiran na niti, at bang dinan nakaming metung a kuta king Juda at king Jerusalem.
At ngeni, Oh kekaming Dios nanu ing kekaming sabian kaibat na niti? uling pepaimburisan mila ding kekang utus,

A inutus mu king pamamilatan da ding kekang talasuyung manula, a sinabi ra, Ing labuad, a kekong ayan bang bandian, metung a marinat a labuad king uli na ning karinatan da ding balayan da ding labuad, king uli ding karelang makasumami, a mengatmu kaniti manibat king metung a sepu angga kasumangid king karelang karinatan:

Ngeni pin e yo babie ding kekong anak a babai karing anak dang lalaki, ni e yo kakuanan ding karelang anak a babai a dikil karing anak yung lalaki, ni e yu panintunan ing karelang kapayapan o ing karelang kanawan king kapilan pa man; bakong sikan, at mangan king mayap na ning labuad, at lakuan yung pekamana karing kekong anak king kapilan pa man.

At kaibat na ning anggang dinatang kekami king uli ra ding kekaming marawak a dapat, at king uli ning kekaming maragul a pamikasala, anti na ning ika kekaming Dios peparusan mukaming kulang pa king karampatan king kekeng dewakan, at dininan mukaming mitagan a anti kaniti,

Siran mila pa waring pasibayu ding kekang utos, at makisanlub kami karing balayan a darapat karing makasumaming dete? e ka wari mimua kekami angga king alipul mukame, bang keta ala nang mitagan, ni ala nang mitakas ninuman?

Oh GUINU, a Dios ning Israel, matulid ka; uling melakuan kaming metung a mitagan a mitakas, a anti mo king aldo ngeni: oini, ati kami king kekang arapan king kekeng kasalanan; uling alang mitalakad king arapan mu king uli na niti.

Ngeni kabang i Esdras manalangin ya at manalese ya, kikiak at magsakab king arapan ning bale ning Dios, ating mitipun makapamisan kea manibat king Israel a metung a maragul a kapulungan da ding lalaki at babai at anak; uling ing balayan kiniak king maragul a kiak.

At i Secanias a anak nang Jeiel, a metung karing anak nang Elam, mekibat ya at sinabi na kang Esdras, Sinalangsang kami salang king kekatang Dios, at mekiasawa kami karing babaing tau king aliwang labuad a balayan na ning labuad: makanianman ngeni ating kapanayan dikil king Israel makatungkul kaniting bague.

Ngeni pin tara gawa tang tipan king kekatang Dios a ilako la ding anggang asawa, at ding penganak da, agpang king usuk na ning kanakung guinu, at detang gagalgal king utus na ning kekatang Dios; at pabustan marapat iti agpang king kautusan.
Talakad ka; uling ing bague makatungkul keka, at ikami makayabe ke keka: magpakatatag kang mayap, at daptan mu iti.
Kanita tinalakad ya i Esdras, at pepasumpan nala ding pekapun da ding sacerdotes, ding Levitas, at ing mabilug a Israel, a daptan da agpang king amanung iti, Inya sinumpa la.

Kanita tinalakad ya i Esdras ibat king arapan na ning bale na ning Dios, at linub ya king silid nang Jeohanan a anak nang Eliasib: at inyang dinatang ya karin, e ya mengan tinape, ni minum mang danum; uling migpaldas ya king uli ning pamanalangsang da ding king pangabijag.
At guinawa lang kapasiagan king mabilug a Juda at Jerusalem karing anggang anak a king pangabijag, king mitipun lang makapamisan king Jerusalem;
At itang e dinatang king lub na ning atlung aldo, agpang king usuk da ding principes at ding makatua, ing anggang pibandian na mayakua, at ya mikawani ya king kapulungan da ding king pangabijag.

Kanita ding anggang lalaki ning Juda at Benjamin mitipun lang makapamisan king Jerusalem king lub na ning atlung aldo (ya ing kasiam a bulan, king kadua nang pulung aldo ning bulan); at ing mabilug a balayan pesilukluk king maliwalas a karinan king arapan na ning bale na ning Dios, gagalgal la king uli nang bague a iti, at king uli ning masikan a uran.
At i Esdras a sacerdote tinalakad ya, at sinabi na karela, Sinalangsang kayu, at mekiasawa kayu karing babaing tau king aliwang labuad, bang lalung miragdag ing kasalanan na ning Israel.

Ngeni pin dapat kong pamipasiag kasalanan king GUINU, a Dios da ding kekong mangatua, at daptan yu ing keang kaburian; at kawani kayu karing balayan na ning labuad, at karing babai a tau king aliwang labuad.
Kanita ing mabilug a kapulungan mekibat at sinabi ra king masikan a siwala, Nung makananu ing sinabi mu tungkul kekami, makanian ing sukat daptan mi.
Dapot ing balayan dakal, at panaun na ning mauran, at e kami malyaring mitalakad king lual: ni iti e mu daraptan king misan a aldo o king adua man; uling sinalangsang keng maragul king bague a iti.

Pabustan lang mitulduan ngeni ding kekeng principes dikil king mabilug a kapulungan, at pabustan la detang atiu karing kekatang ciudad a datang la karing makatuldung panaun detang mekiasawa karing babai king aliwang labuad, at kayabe ra ila ding makatua king balang ciudad, at ding ukum da deti, angga king mikawani kekatamu ing mabagsik nang mua ning kekatang Dios, angga king ing bague a iti milabas.
I Jonatan mu a anak nang Asael at i Jazeias a anak nang Ticva ilang tinalakad salang king bague a iti: at i Mesullam at i Sabetai a Levita ila ding sinaup karela.

At depatan dang makanian ding anak ning pangabijag. At i Esdras a sacerdote, a kayabe ra ding mapilan a pekabuntuk karing bale ra ding mangatua, agpang karing bale ra ding karelang mangatua, at ila ngan king pamamilatan ding karelang laguiu, mikawani la; at linukluk la king mumunang aldo ning kapulung bulan bang siasatan da ing bague.
At inari ra ing makatungkul karing anggang lalaki a memakiasawa karing babai king aliwang labuad king mumunang aldo ning mumunang bulan.

At karing anak dang lalaki ding sacerdotes a meakit mekiasawa karing babaing tau king aliwang labuad: la pin, karing anak nang Jesua, a anak nang Jozadac, at ding keang kapatad, i Maaseias, at i Eliezer, at i Jarib, at i Gedalias.
At binie re ing karelang gamat king ilako ro ding karelang asawa; at anti na ning makasalanan la, minain lang metung a lalaking tupa king kawan king uli ning karelang kasalanan.
At karing anak nang Imer: i Hanani at i Zebadias.
At karing anak nang Harim: i Maaseias, at i Elias, at i Semaya, at i Jeiel, at i Uzias.
At karing anak nang Pasur: i Elioenai, i Maaseias, i Ismael, i Netanel, i Josabad, at i Elasa.
At karing Levitas: i Josabad, at i Simei, at i Kelaya (a ya mu rin i Kelita), i Petahias, i Juda, at i Eliezer.
At karing taladalit: i Eliasib. At karing bante pasbul: i Sallum, at i Telem. at i Uri.
At kang Israel: Karing anak nang Paros: i Ramia, at i Izias, at i Malquias, at i Mijamin, at i Eleazar, at i Malquias, at i Benaya.
At karing anak nang Elam: i Matanias, i Zacarias, at i Jeiel, at i Abdi, at i Jeremot, at i Elias.
At karing anak nang Zatu: i Elioenai, i Eliasib, i Matanias, at i Jeremot, at i Zabad, at i Asisa.
At karing anak nang Bebai: i Jehoanan, i Hananias, i Zabai, at i Atlai.
At karing anak nang Bani: i Mesullam, i Malluc, at i Adaya, i Jasub, at i Seal, i Jeremot.
At karing anak nang Pahat-moab: i Adna, at i Quelal, i Benaya, i Maaseia, i Matanias, i Bezalel, at i Binui, at i Manases.
At karing anak nang Harim: i Eliezer, i Issias, i Malquias, i Semaya, i Simeon,
I Benjamin, i Malluc, i Semarias.
Karing anak nang Hasum: i Matenai, i Matata, i Zabad, i Elifelet, i Jeremai, i Manases, i Simei.
Karing anak nang Bani: i Maadai, i amram, at i Uel,
I Benaya, i Bedeias, i Queluhi,
I Vanias, i Meremot, i Eliasib,
I Matanias, i Matenai, at i Jaasu,
At i Bani, at i Binui, i Simei,
At i Selemias, at i Natan, at i Adaya,
I Macnadebai, i Sasai, i Sarai,
I Azarel, at i Selemias, at i Semarias,
I Sallum, i Amarias, i Jose.
Karing anak nang Nebo: i Jeiel i Matitias, i Zabad, i Zebina, i Iddo, at i Joel, i Benaya.
Deti ngan mekiasawa la karing babaing tau king aliwang labuad; at ding mapilan karela atin lang asawang mikayanak karela.
Ding amanu nang Nehemias a anak nang Hacalias. Ngeni mepalyari king bulan na ning Quislev, king kaduang pulung banua, kabang ati ku king palacio Susan.

King i Hanani, a metung karing kakung kapatad, dinatang ya, at ding mapilan a lalaking menibatan king Juda; at kitnan kula a makatungkul karing Judios a tinakas, a melakuan karing king pangabijag, at tungkul king Jerusalem.

At sinabi ra kanaku, Ding mitagan a melakuan ketang king pangabijag karin king lalawigan atilu king maragul a kasakitan at kalibakan: ing kuta na man ning Jerusalem melasak ya, at ding keang pasbulan dalan meduluk la king api.
At milyari, inyang dimdam ko ding amanung deti, king linukluk ku at kiniak, at migpaldas kung mapilan aldo; at migayuno ku at menalangin king arapan na ning Dios ning banua,
At sinabi ku, Pagamuamu ku keka, Oh GUINU, a Dios ning banua, maragul at makapangilabut a Dios, a mimingat tipan at pakalulu karing lulugud kea at mimingat karing keang utus:

Pabustan mu ngeni a ing kekang balugbug tumingid ya, at ding kekang mata mibuklat la, bamung pakiramdaman ing panalangin ning kekang talasuyu, a pananlangin ku king arapan mu king oras a iti, king aldo at bengi, king uli ra ding anak na ning Israel a kekang talasuyu, kabang papasiag ku ing kasalanan da ding anak na ning Israel, a pikasalanan mi salang keka. Wa, aku at ing bale nang ibpa ku mikasala kami:
Dinapat keng binang marawak salang keka, at e mila iningat ding utus, ni ding tuntunan man, ni ding kautusan man, a kekang inutus king talasuyu mung i Moises.
Ganakan mu, pagamuamu ku keka, ing amanu a kekang inutus king talasuyu mung i Moises, sinabi mu, Nung salangsang kayu, aku ikalat dakayu karing anggang balayan:

Dapot nung mibalik ko kanaku, at ingatan yo ding kanakung utus at kekayu lang daptan, king bistat ding makaugse kekayu atilu man king kasesepuan dang dake ding banua, makanianman tipunan kula manibat karin, at dalan kula king karinan a kanakung pinili, bakung papanuknanganan ing kanakung laguiu karin.
Ngeni deti pin ila ding kekang talasuyu at kekang balayan, a inatbus mu king pamamilatan na ning kekang maragul a kayupayan, at king pamamilatan na ning kekang masikanan a gamat.

Oh Guinu, pagamuamu ku keka, pabustan mu ngeni a ing kekang balugbug tumingid ya king panalangin na ning kekang talasuyu, at king panalangin da ding kekang talasuyu, a matulang tumakut king kekang laguiu; at panawan me, pagamuamu ku keka, ing kekang talasuyu king aldo ngeni, at pagkaluban meng pakalulu king panimanman na ning lalaking iti. Ngeni talapagdala nakung copa ning ari.

At milayari king bulan na ning Nisan, king kadua nang pulung banua ning aring Artajerjes, kanitang ing alak atiu king arapan na, king tinas ku ing alak, at binie ku king ari. Ngeni e ku pa melungkut king minuna king durungutan na.
At sinabi na ning ari kanaku, Baket malungkut ing kekang aske, bagkus e na ka man masakit? iti alang aliwa nung e sindak na ning pusu. Kanita mitakutan kung bina.

At sinabi kung king ari, Luid ya sa bie ing ari king kapilan pa man: baket ing kanakung aske e ya lungkut, ngening ing ciudad, ing karinan da ding kutkutan da ding kakung mangatua, lasak ya, at ding pasbulan nang dalan metampus la king api?
Kanita sinabi na ning ari kanaku, Nanu ing kekang yaduan? Inya menalangin ku king Dios ning banua.

At sinabi ku king ari, Nung ikatula na ning ari, at nung ing kekang talasuyu menakit yang kalam king kekang panlalawe, a itubud muku king Juda, king cuidad da ding kutkutan ding kakung mangatua, bakeng italakad iti.

At ing ari miniabi ya kanaku (ing reina makalukluk ya naman king siping na), Maguing nu anti luat ing kekang pamaglakbe? at kapilan ka mibalik? Nanupata ketula na ning ari ing tinubud naku; at tinuldu kung metung a panaun kea.
Bukud kaniti sinabi ku king ari, Nung makatula king ari, mirinan ku sang sulat karing gobernador king nangan na karin ning Ilug, barakung paralanan, angga king miras ku king Juda;

At metung a sulat kang Asaf a talaingat king kakewan na ning ari, banakung dinan dutung a agawang sikang dikil karing pasbulan dalan ning castillo a makatungkul king bale, at dikil king kuta na ning ciudad, at dikil king bale a kanakung luban. At pigkaluban naku ning ari, agpang king mayap nang gamat ning kakung Dios kanaku.
Kanita miras ku karing gobernador king nangan na karin ning Ilug, at binie ko karela ding sulat na ning ari. Ngeni ing ari mitubud yang kayabe ku karing capitan ning ejercito at ding sasake kabayu.

At inyang iti dimdam nang Sanbalat a Horonita, at i Tobias a ipus, a Ammonita, melungkut lang bina, uling dinatang ya karin ing metung a lalaki banang panintunan ing kanawan da ding anak na ning Israel.
Inya dinatang ku king Jerusalem, at karin ku atlung aldo.

At mibangun ku king bengi, aku at mapilan a lalaki a kayabe ku; ni e ku sinabi kenu man ing binili na ning Dios king kanakung pusu bang daptan kung dikil king Jerusalem; ni ala namang animal a kayabe ku, subali mu ing animal a kanakung sasakayan.

At linual ku king bengi king pasbulan dalan ning libis, king nangan na pin ning talaga na ning dragon, at king pasbulan dalan ning piugsianan dinat, at pegumasdan kula ding kuta na ning Jerusalem, a mengalasak, at ding pasbulan nang dalan mengatampus la king api.
Kanita melaus ku king pasbulan dalan ning bukal at king talaga na ning ari: dapot alang karinan dikil king animal a sasaken ku bang dalanan na.
Kanita sinampa ku king kabengian king lele ning batis, at pegumasdan ke ing kuta; at mibalik ku, at linub ku king pasbulan dalan ning libis, at makanian kung mibalik.

At e ra abalu ding pekapun nung nu ku mine, o nung nanu ing depatan ku; ni e ku mu naman sinabi karing Judios, ni karing sacerdotes, ni karing makamal man, ni karing pekapun man, ni karing mitagan a dinapat king dapat.

Kanita sinabi ku karela, Akakit yu ing marawak a malilyari a nung nu ta karin, nung makananung ing Jerusalem lubus yang melasak, at ding pasbulan dalan na niti mesilab la king api: ume ko keni, at italakad taya ing kuta na ning Jerusalem, bang e ta na maguing metung a kalibakan.

At sinabi ke karela ing gamat na ning kanakung Dios a meguing mayap kanaku, anti naman ding amanu na ning ari a sinabi na kanaku. At sinabi ra, Mibangun tamu at manalakad. Kanita pepasiknangan do ding gamat da dikil king mayap a dapat.

Dapot inyang dimdam nang Sanbalat a Horonita, at i Tobias a ipus, a Ammonita, at i Gesem a tau Arabia, keilian dakeng leukanan sunu, at mirajan dakami, at sinabi ra, Nanu ing bague iting daraptan yu? lumaban kong salang king are?

Kanita mekibat ku karela, at sinabi ku karela, Ing Dios ning banua, ipala nakami; inya pin ikaming talasuyu na mibangun kami a manalakad: dapot ala kong dake, ni matulid man, ni kapigaganakan, king Jerusalem.

Kanita i Eliasib a matas a sacerdote tinalakad ya a kayabe no ding keang kapatad a sacerdotes, at telakad de ing pasbulan dalan da ding tupa; pepagbanalan de, at linapat dala ding pasbul na niti; angga king batiawan na pin ning Hamea pepagbanalan de, angga king batiawan na ning Hananel.
At tinuki la kea a menalakad ding lalaki ning Jerico. At tinuki ya karela a menalakad i Zacur a anak nang Imri.
At ing pasbulan dalan asan telakad de ding anak nang Hasenaa; linapat dala ding sikang na, at binili rala ding pasbul na, ding trangka na, at ding pasabat na.

At tinuki karela miglarin ya i Meremot a anak nang Urias, a anak nang Hakoz. At tinuki karela miglarin ya i Mesullam a anak nang Berequias, a anak nang Mesezabel. At tinuki karela miglarin ya i Zadoc a anak nang Baana.
At tinuki karela miglarin la ding Tecoitas; dapot, ding makamal da e ro binili ding karelang tundun king dapat na ning karelang guinu.

At ing matuang pasbulan dalan linarin neng Joiada a anak nang Pasea at i Mesullam a anak nang Besodeias; linapat dala ding keang sikang; at kena rala ding keang pasbul, at ding trangka na, at ding pasabat na.
At tinuki karela miglarin ya i Melatias a Gibeonita, at i Jadon a Meronotita, a lalaking tau Gibeon, at ning Mizpa, a makatungkul king luklukan na ning gobernador king nangan na karin ning Ilug.

Tinuki kea miglarin ya i Uzziel a anak nang Harhaya, a pande guintu. At tinuki kea miglarin ya i Hananias a metung ya karing mangawang pabanglu, at pepagtibayan da ing Jerusalem angga pin king maliwalas a kuta.
At tinuki karela miglarin ya i Refaias a anak nang Hur, a pekapun king kapitna nang puruk ning Jerusalem.
At tinuki karela miglarin ya i Jedaya a anak nang Harumaf, king tulid ning keang bale. At ing tinuki kea miglarin ya i Hatus a anak nang Hasabneias.
I Malquias a anak nang Harim, at i Hasub a anak nang Pahat-moab, miglarin la king aliwang dake, at ing batiawan karing horno.
At tinuki kea miglarin ya i Sallum a anak nang Hallohes, a pekapun king kapitna nang puruk ning Jerusalem, ya at ding keang anak a babai.

Ing pasbulan dalan ning libis lerinan nang Hanun, at ding manuknangan king Zanoa; karela yang telakad, at kena ro ding pasbul na, ding trangka na, at ding pasabat na, at ing libung siku king kuta angga king pasbulan dalan ning piugsianan dinat.
Ing pasbulan dalan ning dinat linarin neng Malquias a anak nang Recab, a pekapun king puruk ning Bethaquerim; telakad ne, at kena nala ding pasbul na, ding trangka na, at ding pasabat na.

At ing pasbulan dalan ning bukal linarin neng Sallum a anak nang Colhoze, a pekapun king puruk ning Mizpa; telakad ne, at tikpan ne, at kena nala ding pasbul na, ding trangka na, at ding pasabat na, at ing bakud nang batu ning talaga ning Sela king siping ning mulajan na ning ari, angga pin karing balitang a kukuldas manibat king ciudad nang David.

Tinuki kea miglarin ya i Nehemias a anak nang Azbuk, a pekapun king kapitna nang puruk ning Bet-zur, angga king karinan a tulid na ning kutkutan nang David, at angga king talaga a megawa, at angga king bale ra ding masikanan a lalaki.
Tinuki kea miglarin la ding Levitas, i Rehum a anak nang Bani. Tinuki kea miglarin ya i Hasabias, ing pekapun king kapitna nang puruk ning Keila, dikil king keang puruk.
Tinuki kea miglarin la ding karelang kapatad, i Bavai a anak nang Henadad, a pekapun king kapitna na ning puruk ning Keila.
At tinuki kea miglarin ya i Ezer a anak nang Jesua, a pekapun ning Mizpa, aliwang dake, king tulid ning ukiatan king pibibilianan karing sandata king pamagliku ning kuta.
Tinuki kea i Baruk a anak nang Zabai tapat neng lerinan ing aliwang dake, manibat king pamagliku ning kuta angga king pasbul ning bale nang Eliasib a matas a sacerdote.
Tinuki kea miglarin ya i Meremot a anak nang Urias a anak nang Hakoz king aliwang dake, manibat king pasbul nang bale Eliasib angga pin king wakas ning bale nang Eliasib.
At tinuki kea miglarin la ding sacerdotes, a lalaki ning Kapatagan.
Tinuki karela miglarin la i Benjamin at i Hasub king tulid ning karelang bale. Tinuki karela miglarin ya i Azarias a anak nang Maaseias a anak nang Ananias king siping ning sarili nang bale.
Tinuki kea miglarin ya i Binui a anak nang Henadad king aliwang dake, manibat king bale nang Azarias angga king pamagliku ning kuta at angga king suluk.

I Palal a anak nang Uzai miglarin ya king tulid ning pamagliku ning kuta, at ning batiawan a mayalto matas manibat king lalung matas a bale ning ari, a atiu king siping ning patio ning bante. Tinuki kea i Pedaya a anak nang Paros miglarin ya.
(Ngeni ding Netineos manuknangan la king Ofel, angga king karinan a tulid ning pasbulan dalan ning danum king nangan aslagan, at king batiawan a mayalto matas).
Tinuki kea ding Tecoitas miglarin la king aliwang dake, king tulid na ning maragul a batiawan a mayalto matas, at angga king kuta ning Ofel.
King babo na ning pasbulan dalan da ding kabayu miglarin la ding sacerdotes, balang metung king tulid na ning keang sariling bale.
Tinuki karela miglarin ya i Zadoc a anak nang Imer king tulid na ning keang sariling bale. At tinuki kea miglarin ya i Semaya a anak nang Secanias, a bante king pasbulan dalan king aslagan.
Tinuki kea miglarin ya i Hananias a anak nang Selemias, at i Hanun a kanam nang anak Zalaf, king aliwang dake. Tinuki kea miglarin ya i Mesullam a anak nang Berequias king tulid ning keang silid.
Tinuki kea miglarin ya i Malquias a metung karing pande guintu king bale ra ding Netineos, at karing mangalakal, king tulid ning pasbulan dalan ning Hamifcad, at king piukiatan king suluk.
At king pilatan ning piukiatan king suluk at ning pasbulan dalan da ding tupa miglarin la ding pande guintu at ding mangalakal.
Dapot milyari king, inyang dimdam nang Sanbalat king tatalakad miya ing kuta, mikapali ya, at mimua yang bina, at sinunu nala ding Judios.

At miniabi ya king arapan da ding keang kapatad at king ejercito ning Samaria, at sinabi na, Nanu ing daraptan da deting mangainang Judios? magpakatibe la ware? dumaun la ware? yarian de wari king misan mung aldo? ibawi ro wari ding batu manibat king buntun ning dinat, anti ning mayayakit king meruluk la?
Ngeni i Tobias a Ammonita atiu king siping na, at sinabi na, Aguiang ita pa ping tatalakad da, nung ing metung a zora sampa ya, lasakan ne ing karelang kutang batu.
Pakiramdaman mu, Oh kekaming Dios; uling melibak kami: at ibalik mu ing karelang pamanlibak babo ning sarili rang buntuk, at ibie mong pekasamsam king metung a labuad ning pangabijag;
At e mu tatakpan ing karelang dewakan, at e mu pabustan makakalis ing kasalanan da king arapan mu; uling pemungkasian daka king mua king arapan da ding manalakad.
Nanupata telakad miya ing kuta; at ing mabilug a kuta misanib ya angga king kapitna na ning keang katas: uling ing balayan ating pusu bang dapat.

Dapot milyari king, inyang i Sanbalat, at i Tobias, at ding Arabes, at ding Ammonitas, at ding Asdoditas, dimdam da king ing pamaglarin karing kuta na ning Jerusalem sinulung, at king ding busbus kuta migmula lang misara, kanita mikapali lang bina;
At minala la ila ngan miabeabe balang ume at makipamuk salang king Jerusalem, at bang makarapat kaguluan karin.
Dapot depatan mi ing kekeng pamanalangin king kekaming Dios, at minili keng bante salang karela king aldo at bengi, king uli ra.
At ing Juda sinabi na, Ing sikanan da ding magdalang pusan mimin, at ating dakal a dinat; nanupata e miya malyaring atalakad ing kuta.
At sinabi ra ding kekeng kasalang, E ra abalu, ni akit man, angga king miras kami king libutad da, at patayan la, at ipatuknang ing daraptan.
At milyari king, inyang dinatang la ding Judios a menuknangan king siping da, sinabi ra kekami makatapulung ukdu manibat karing sablang karinan, Ikayu sukat kong mibalik kekami.

Inya migbili ku karing mababa nang diling karinan ning pilatan king gugulutan ning kuta, karing makabuklat a karinan, binili ku karin ing balayan agpang karing karelang sapni pati na ding talibung da, ding karelang tandus, at ding karelang bai.

At linawe ku, at tinalakad, at sinabi ku karing makamal, at karing pekapun, at king mitagan ning balayan, E ko mitatakutan karela: ganakan ye ing Guinu, a maragul at makapangilabut, at makipamuk kayu dikil karing kekong kapatad, karing kekong anak a lalaki, at karing kekong anak a babai, karing kekong asawa, at karing kekong bale.
At milyari, inyang dimdam da ding kekeng kasalang king abalu mi, at ing Dios inuli na king ala ing karelang usuk, king mibalik kami ike ngan king kuta, balang metung king keang dapat.

At milyari manibat king panaun a ita, king ding kapitna karing kanakung talasuyu dinapat la king dapat, at ding kapitna karela tatalnan do ding tandus, ding kalasag, at ding bai, at ing imalan a maki kaliskis; at ding pekapun atilu king gugulutan na ning mabilug a bale ning Juda.
Ding mitalakad king kuta at ding mamusan king pusan pesipamusan la; balang metung ing metung nang gamat darapat ya king dapat, at king metung tatalanan ne ing sandata na;
At ding manalakad, balang metung atiu ing keang talibung a makatakas king keang katalindikingan, at makanian lang menalakad. At ing pakatni king pakakak atiu king siping ku.
At sinabi ku karing makamal, at karing pekapun at king mitagan king balayan, ing dapat maragul at dakal, at kawakawani tamu king kuta, ing metung marayu ya king metung:
Nu man karing karinan a damdaman yu ing katni na ning pakakak, makitipun ko kekami karin; ing kekatang Dios makipamuk ya dikil kekatamu.
Makanian keng dinapat king dapat: at ding kapitna karela tatalan lang tandus manibat king sasala angga king lunto la ding batuin.

Makanian mu rin king kabud panaun a iti sinabi ku king balayan, Magsantung ya sa ing balang metung a kayabe ne ing keang talasuyu king Jerusalem, bang king bengi maguing metung lang bante kekatamu, at dapat no man king aldo.

Inya ni aku, ni ding kapatad ku man, ni ding kakung talasuyu, ni ding lalaki mang bante a tutuki kanaku, ninuman kekami alang miglukas king kekeng imalan, balang metung mine yang daralan ne ing keang sandata, king danum.
Kanita tinalakad ing metung a maragul a kulisak ning balayan at ding karelang asawa salang karing karelang kapatad a Judios.
Uling ating sinabi, Ikami, ding kekaming anak a lalaki at ding anak ming babai, dakal la: tara kuma tang binutil, batang mangan at mie.
Ating mapilan mu naman karela a sinabi, Isasangla mi ing kekeng marangle, at ding kekeng uvasan, at ding kekeng bale: pabustan yukeng kumang binutil, king uli ning kayalan.
Atin mu namang sinabi, Menutang kaming salapi dikil king buis king ari karing kekeng marangle at uvasan.

Makanianman ing kekeng laman ngeni anti mo ing laman da ding kekeng kapatad, ding kekeng anak anti la mo ding karelang anak: at, oini, dadala mila king pangayalipan ding kekeng anak a lalaki at ding kekeng anak a babai, balang maguing talasuyu, at ding mapilan karing anak ming babai midala na la king pangayalipan: ni ala king kekeng kayupayan a akarapat mi iti; uling karing aliwang tau atilu ding kekeng marangle at ding kekeng uvasan.
At mimua kung bina inyang dimdam ku ing karelang kulisak at ding amanung deti.

Kanita kinanua kung sangguni king kakung sarili, at mekitua ku karing makamal at karing pekapun, at sinabi ku karela, Sisingil kong patubu, balang metung king keang kapatad. At mitatag kung metung a maragul a katipunan salang karela.

At sinabi ku karela, Ikami agpang king kaguiuwan mi inatbus mila ding kapatad ming Judios, a mipisali karing bansa; at ikayu pin buri yong pisali ding kekong kapatad, at ipisali la kekame? Kanita migtajimik la, at e la menakit metung mang amanu.
Sinabi ku naman, E mayap ing bague a kekong daraptan: e ko wari lumakad king takut king kekatang Dios, king uli na ning pamanlibak da ding bansa a kekatang kasalang?
At aku anti naman, ding kakung kapatad at ding kakung talasuyu, paparam ke karela salapi at binutil. Pagamuamu ku kekayu, tara lakuan tamu ing pamipatubung iti.

Isubli yo, pagamuamu ku kekayu, karela, ngeni mu rin ping aldo iti, ding karelang marangle, ding karelang uvasan, ding karelang olivajan, at ding karelang bale, makanian mu naman ing kadinalan nang dake ning salapi, at ning binutil, king alak a bayu, at king laru, a sisingil yu karela.

Kanita sinabi ra, Isubli mi, at ala keng yaduan nanuman karela; daptan ming makanian, nung makananu ing sasabian mu. Kanita inaus kula ding sacerdotes, at pepasumpan kula, king daptan da ing agpang king pangakung iti.

Pigpag ku mu naman ing lele na ning kanakung imalan, at sinabi ku, Makanian neng ipagpag ning Dios ing balang tau manibat king keang bale, at manibat king keang daraptan, ing e tutupad king pangakung iti; makanian yang mipagpag, at ilako laman. At sinabi na ning mabilug a kapulungan, Yanasa, at pinuri re Ing GUINU. At ing balayan dinapat makayagpang king pangakung iti.

Bukud kaniti manibat king panaun a mitulduan kung gobernador king labuad na ning Juda, manibat king kaduang pulung banua angga pin king katlu nang pulu at aduang banua ning aring Artajerjes, a ya pin labingaduang banua, aku at ding kakung kapatad e ke mengan king tinape ning gobernador.

Dapot ding minunang gobernador a minuna kanaku pepapusan la king balayan, at kinanua lang karela tinape at alak, makabukud pa karing apat a siclong pilak; wa, pati na pin ding karelang talasuyu magpun la king balayan: dapot ing anti kaniti e ku depatan, king uli ning takut king Dios.
Wa, makanian mu naman belaus ku ing dapat kaniting kuta, ni e ke sinali king nanumang labuad: at ding anggang kakung talasuyu mititipun la karin king dapat.
Bukud kaniti mika atin karing Judios at karing pekapun, king kanakung dulang, dinalan la at limampulung lalaki, bukud karing dinatang kekami manibatan karing bansa a makapatulug kekami.

Ngeni ing misadia dikil king metung a aldo metung yang vaca at anam a piling tupa; anti naman ding ayup misadia la dikil kanaku, at misan king apulung aldo ing anggang sarisaring alak: makanianman dikil king sablang iti e ku miniawad king tinape ning gobernador, uling ing pangayalipan mabayat king balayan a iti.
Ganakan mu kaku, Oh kanakung Dios, king ikakayap, ing sablang depatan ku tungkul king balayan a iti.

Ngeni milyari pin, inyang mibalita kang Sanbalat at kang Tobias, at kang Gesem a tau Arabia, at karing mitagan karing kekaming kasalang king telakad ke ing kuta, at king ala nang mitagan a kasiran kilub (king bistat angga king panaun a ita e ko pa kena ding pasbul karing pasbulan dalan),
King a Sanbalat at i Gesem mitubud la kanaku, sinabi ra, Datang ka, tara mikit tamu king metung karing nayun na ning kapatagan na ning Ono. Dapot inisipan dang daptananan dakung marawak.
At mipabal kung tubud karela, ngaku, Darapat kung metung a maragul a dapat, uli nita e ku malyaring mikuldas: baket mituknang ing daraptan, nung warit lakuan ku, at kuldasan dakayu?
At mitubud la kanakung makatapat a ukdu agpang king kaparalanan a iti; at pekibatan kula agpang mu naman king anti kanitang kaparalanan.
Kanita tinubud neng Sanbalat kanaku ing keang talasuyu king makanian mu namang kaparalanan king kalimang ukdu a atin yang metung a makabuklat a sulat king keang gamat,

Nung nu makasulat, Mibalita karing bansa, at sasabian nang Gasmu iti, king ika at ding Judios mimisip kong lumaban; a ya ing kasangkanan king pamanalakad yung kuta: at ika ing maguing ari ra, agpang karing amanung deti.

At ika tinuldu ka namang manula bang manaral a makatungkul keka king Jerusalem, ngana, Ating metung a ari king Juda: at ngeni dapat ibalita king ari ing agpang karing amanung deti. Ume ka keni pin ngeni, at misangguni tamung makapamisan.
Kanita mitubud ku kea, sinabi ku, Alang mararapat a nanumang bague karing anti mo ding kekang sasabian, nung e keka la mung gagawan king sarili mung pusu.
Uling ila ngan buri ra king apatakutan dakami, ngara, Ding karelang gamat mina la king dapat, bang e na mayari. Dapot ngeni, Oh Dios, pasiknangan mula ding kanakung gamat.

At mine ku king bale nang Semaya a anak nang Delaya a anak nang Mehetabel, a iti mekulung ya; at ya sinabi na, Tara mitipun tang makapamisan king bale na ning Dios, king kilub na ning templo, at tara ikabat tala ding pasbul na ning templo: uling datang la bang patayan daka; wa, king bengi datang la bang patayan daka.
At sinabi ku, Karampatan ya waring tumakas ing metung a lalaking anti ako? at ninu ing anti aku, a ume ya king templo banang iligtas ing keang bie? e ku lungub.
At siniasat ku, at, oini, e ne tinubud ning Dios, nung e pisiag na ing ulang iti a salang kanaku: at i Tobias at i Sanbalat inupajan de.
King uli ning kasangkanan a iti inupajan de, bakung mitakutan, at daptan ku ing makanian, at mikasala ku, at balang mika ating kabagayan dikil king metung a marawak a balita, barakung alibak.
Ganakan mu, Oh kanakung Dios, i Tobias at i Sinbalat agpang karing dapat dang deti, at makanian mu naman i Noadias a babaing manula at ding aliwang manula, buri rakung ibili king takut.
Nanupata meari ya ing kuta king kadua nang pulu at limang aldo ning bulan na ning Elul, king limangpulu at aduang aldo.

At milyari, inyang dimdam da iti ding anggang kasalang mi, king ding anggang bansa a atiu king makapatulug kekami mitakutan la, at bina lang mengaslak a mata; uling akilala ra king ing dapat a iti depat na ning kekeng Dios.
Bukud kaniti karing aldo a deta ding makamal ning Juda peparala lang dakal a sulat kang Tobias, at ding sulat nang Tobias dinatang la karela.

Uling dakal la king Juda ding sinumpa kea, uling manuyang neng Secanias a anak nang Ara; at ing keang anak a i Jeohanan kinua ne ing anak nang babaing Mesullam a anak nang Berequias bang maguing asawa na.
Anti naman miniabi la karing mangayap nang dapat king arapan ku, at belita ro ding kanakung amanu kea, at i Tobias pepadala yang sulat banakung apatakutan.
Ngeni milyari, inyang mitalakad ya ing kuta, at akana ku no ding pasbul, at metuldu no ding bante pasbul at ding taladalit at ding Levitas.
King binie kung king kapatad kung i Hanani, at kang Hananias a gobernador ning castillo, ing pamanibala king Jerusalem; uling metung yang tapat a lalaki, at tatakut ya king Dios maiguit karing dakal.

At sinabi ku karela, E la sa bubuklatan ding pasbul ning Jerusalem anggang e ya mapali ing aldo; at kabang makatalakad la king pamagbante, pabustan lang ikabat do ding pasbul, at itrangka yula; at tuldu kong bante karing manuknangan king Jerusalem, balang metung atiu king keang pamagbante, at balang metung atiu king tulid na ning keang bale.
Ngeni ing cuidad maliwalas ya at maragul; dapot ing balayan ditak mu king libutad na, at ding bale e la pa mitalakad.

At ing kanakung Dios binili na king kanakung pusu a tipunan kong makapamisan ding makamal, at ding pekapun, at ing balayan, balang mibilang agpang king pisulatan karing dai. At ikit ke ing libru ning pisulatan karing dai ra ding sinampang minuna, at ikit kung makasulat karin:

Deti ilang anak na ning lalawigan, a sinampa a menibat king pangabijag karing midala, a dela nang Nabucodonosor a ari ning Babilonia, at mibalik la king Jerusalem at king Juda, balang metung king keang cuidad;
Deti ilang dinatang a kayabe ra di Zerubabel, Jesua, Nehemias, Azarias, Raamias, Nahamani, Mardoqueo, Bilsan, Misperet, Bigvai, Nehum, Baana. Ing kabilangan da ding lalaki ning balayan ning Israel:
Ding anak nang Paros, adua lang libu dinalan pitungpulu at adua.
Ding anak nang Sefatias, atlu lang dalan pitungpulu at adua.
Ding anak nang Ara, anam lang dalan limangpulu at adua.
Ding anak nang Pahat-moab, karing anak nang Jesua at kang Joab, adua lang libu at walung dalan at labingwalu.
Ding anak nang Elam, libu la aduang dalan limangpulu at apat.
Ding anak nang Zatu, walu lang dalan apatapulu at lima.
Ding anak nang Zacai, pitu lang dalan at anamapulu.
Ding anak nang Binui, anam lang dalan aduangpulu at walu.
Ding anak nang Bebai, anam lang dalan aduangpulu at walu.
Ding anak nang Azgad, adua lang libu atlung dalan aduangpulu at adua.
Ding anak nang Adonicam, anam lang dalan anamapulu at pitu.
Ding anak nang Bigvai, adua lang libu anamapulu at pitu.
Ding anak nang Adin, anam lang dalan limangpu at lima.
Ding anak nang Ater, nang Hezequias, siam lang pulu at walu.
Ding anak nang Hasum, atlu lang dalan aduangpulu at walu.
Ding anak nang Bezai, atlu lang dalan aduangpulu at apat.
Ding anak nang Harif, dinalan la at labingadua.
Ding anak nang Gibeon, siam lang pulu at lima.
Ding lalaki ning Beth-lehem at Netofa, dinalan la walungpulu at walu.
Ding lalaki ning Anatot, dinalan la aduangpulu at walu.
Ding lalaki ning Bet-azmavet, apat lang pulu at adua.
Ding lalaki ning Kiriat-jearim, ning Quefira, at ning Beerot, pitu lang dalan apatapulu at atlu.
Ding lalaki ning Rama at ning Geba, anam lang dalan aduangpulu at metung.
Ding lalaki ning Micmas, dinalan la at aduangpulu at adua.
Ding lalaki ning Bet-el at ning Ai, dinalan la aduangpulu at atlu.
Ding lalaki ning aliwang Nebo, lima lang pulu at adua.
Ding anak na ning aliwang Elam, libu la aduang dalan limangpulu at apat.
Ding anak nang Harim, atlu lang dalan at aduangpulu.
Ding anak nang Jerico, atlu lang dalan apatapulu at lima.
Ding anak da ri Lod, Hadid, at Ono, pitu lang dalan aduangpulu at metung.
Ding anak nang Senaa, atlu lang libu siam a dalan atlungpulu.
Ding sacerdotes: Ding anak nang Jedaya, king bale nang Jesua, siam lang dalan pitungpulu at atlu.
Ding anak nang Imer, libu la limangpulu at adua.
Ding anak nang Pasur, libu la aduang dalan apatapulu at pitu.
Ding anak nang Harim, libu la at labingpitu.
Ding Levitas: ding anak nang Jesua, nang Cadmiel, karing anak nang Hodeva, pitu lang pulu at apat.
Ding taladalit: ding anak nang Asaf, dinalan la apatapulu at walu.
Ding bante pasbul: ding anak nang Sallum, ding anak nang Ater, ding anak nang Talmon, ding anak nang Akub, ding anak nang Hatita, ding anak nang Sobai, dinalan la atlungpulu at walu.
Ding Netineos: ding anak nang Ziha, ding anak nang Hasufa, ding anak nang Tabaot,
Ding anak nang Keros, ding anak nang Sia, ding anak nang Padon,
Ding anak nang Lebana, ding anak nang Hagaba, ding anak nang Salmai,
Ding anak nang Hanan, ding anak nang Gidel, ding anak nang Gahar,
Ding anak nang Reaya, ding anak nang Rezin, ding anak nang Necoda,
Ding anak nang Gazam, ding anak nang Uza, ding anak nang Pasea,
Ding anak nang Besai, ding anak nang Meunim, ding anak nang Hefusesim,
Ding anak nang Bacbuc, ding anak nang Hacufa, ding anak nang Harhur,
Ding anak nang Bazlit, ding anak nang Megida, ding anak nang Harsa,
Ding anak nang Barcos, ding anak nang Sisera, ding anak nang Tema,
Ding anak nang Nezia, ding anak nang Hatifa,
Ding anak da ding talasuyu nang Solomon: ding anak nang Sotai, ding anak nang Soferet, ding anak ng Perida,
Ding anak nang Jaala, ding anak nang Darcon, ding anak nang Gidel,
Ding anak nang Sefatias, ding anak nang Hatil, ding anak nang Poqueret-hazebaim, ding anak nang Amon.
Ding anggang Niteneos, at ding anak da ding talasuyu nang Solomon, atlu lang dalan siamapulu at adua.
At deti ila ding sinampa a menibatan king Tel-mela, Tel-harsa, Querub, Adon, at Imer; dapot e ro apakilala ding bale ra ding karelang mangatua, ni ing karelang bini, nung king Israel la:
Ding anak nang Delaya, ding anak nang Tobias, ding anak nang Necoda, anam lang dalan apatapulu at adua.
At karing sacerdotes: ding anak nang Hobaya, ding anak nang Hakoz, ding anak nang Barzillai, a mekiasawa karing anak nang babaing Barzillai a Gileadita, at meaus la agpang king karelang laguiu.
Deti penintun de ing karelang pisusulatan dai karetang mebilang king pamamilatan na ning pisulatan dai, dapot e meakit: inya mibilang lang marinat at milako la king pangasacerdote.
At sinabi na karela ning gobernador, king ela mamangan karing kabanalbanalan a bague, angga king tinalakad ya ing metung a sacerdote a maki Urim at Tumim.
Ing mabilug a kapulungan a miabe apat lang pulu at aduang libu atlung dalan at anamapulu.

Subali karing karelang ipus a lalaki at ipus dang babai, a atin lang pitung libu atlung dalan atlungpulu at pitu: at atin no mang aduang dalan apatapulu at limang lalaking taladalit at babaing taladalit.
Ding karelang kabayu pitu lang dalan atlungpulu at anam; ding karelang mula, adua lang dalan apatapulu at lima;
Ding karelang camello, apat lang dalan atlungpulu at lima; ding karelang asno, anam lang libu pitung dalan at aduangpulu.

At ding mapilan a menibat karing pekabuntuk karing bale ra ding mangatua minie la king dapat. Ing gobernador minie ya king simpanan pibandian libung daricong guintu, limangpulung palanggana, limang dalan atlungpulung imalan da ding sacerdotes.
At ding mapilan karing pekabuntuk karing bale ra ding mangatua minie la king simpanan pibandian ning daraptan aduangpulung libong daricong guintu, at aduang libu at aduang dalan a librang pilak.
At ing mitagan king balayan minie aduangpulung libung daricong guintu, at aduang libung librang pilak, at anamapulu at pitung piblasan ding sacerdotes.

Nanupata ding sacerdotes, at ding Levitas, at ding bante pasbul, at ding taladalit, at ding mapilan king balayan, at ding Netineos, at ing mabilug a Israel, tinuknang la karing karelang ciudad. At inyang miras na ing kapitung bulan, ding anak na ning Israel atilu karing karelang ciudad.

At ing mabilug a balayan mitipun lang makapamisan anti mong metung a lalaki king maliwalas a karinan a atiu king arapan na ning pasbulan dalan ning danum; at sinabi ra kang Esdras a escriba king idala ne ing libru ning kautusan nang Moises, a inutus ning GUINU king Israel.

At i Esdras a sacerdote dela ne ing kautusan king arapan na ning kapulungan, ding lalaki at makanian mu naman ding babai, at ding anggang makaramdam a maki pamanalastas, king mumunang aldo ning kapitung bulan.

At minasa ya karin king arapan na ning maliwalas a karinan a atiu king arapan na ning pasbulan dalan ning danum ibat king abak a maranun angga king ugtung-aldo tapat, king durungutan da ding lalaki at ding babai, at detang malyaring makatalastas; at ding balugbug ning mabilug a balayan matingid la king libru na ning kautusan.

At i Esdras a escriba tinalakad ya king pulpitung dutung, a guewa ra dikil king bague a iti; at king siping na makatalakad ya i Matitias, at i Sema, at i Anaya, at i Urias, at i Hilcias, at i Maaseias, king keang dane wanan; at king keang dane kaili, i Pedaya, at i Misael, at i Malquias, at i Hasum, at i Hasbadana, i Zacarias, at i Mesullam.
At i Esdras biklat ne ing libru king lalawan na ning mabilug a balayan (uling makabili yang matas king mabilug a balayan); at inyang biklat ne iti, tinalakad ing mabilug a balayan.

At i Esdras pepanuanan ne Ing GUINU, ing maragul a Dios; at ing mabilug a balayan mekibat, Yanasa, Yanasa, kagum ding makatas dang gamat; at diku ro ding karelang buntuk, at sinamba la king GUINU a makarungdung la ding karelang lupa king gabun.

Anti naman i Jesua, at i Bani, at i Serebias, i Jamin, i Akub, i Sabetai, i Hodias, i Maaseias, i Kelita, i Azarias, i Josabad, i Hanan, i Pelaya, at ding Levitas, pepatalastas da ing kautusan king balayan: at ing balayan menatili king karelang pangabili.
At minasa la king libru, king kautusan na ning Dios, masala; at binie ra ing kalasan, nanupata atalastas da ing mebasa.

At i Nehemias, a ya ing gobernador, at i Esdras a sacerdote a escriba, at ding Levitas a tinuru king balayan, sinabi ra king mabilug a balayan, Ing aldo a iti banal ya king GUINU a kekong Dios; e ko magpaldas, ni kikiak man. Uling ing mabilug a balayan kiniak, inyang damdaman do ding amanu na ning kautusan.

Kanita sinabi na karela, Ume kayu king lakad yu, kanan yu ing taba, at inuman yu ing mayumu, at padala kong dake kanitang alang asadia; uling ing aldo a iti banal ya king kekatang Guinu: ni e ko pin magkalungkut; uling ing tula ning GUINU ya ing kekong sikanan.
Nanupata ding Levitas pepapagtajimikan da ing mabilug a balayan, ngara, Magpayapa kayu, uling ing aldo banal ya; ni e ko magkalungkut.
