At ing mabilug a balayan mine la king lakad da bang mangan, at bang minum, at bang padala lang dake, at bang gawa lang maragul a saya, uling atalastas dala ding amanu a mabulalag karela.

At king kaduang aldo mitipun lang makapamisan ding pekabuntuk da ding bale ra ding mangatua ning mabilug a balayan, ding sacerdotes, at ding Levitas, kang Esdras a escriba, balang tumingid pin karing amanu na ning kautusan.

At ikit dang makasulat king kautusan, a nung makananung inutus ning GUINU king pamamilatan nang Moises, king ding anak na ning Israel manuknangan la karing dalungdung king pista na ning kapitung bulan;

At bang ibulalag da at ipasiag karing anggang ciudad da, at king Jerusalem, a sabian da, Lual kayu a ume king bunduk, at kuma kayu karing sangang olivos, at sangang olivang gubat, at karing sanga ra ding mirto, at sanga ra ding palma, at sanga ra ding mangalabung a dutung, bang gawan dalungdung, anti mo ing makasulat.

Kanita linual ing balayan, at dela ro deti, at guinawa lang karelang dalungdung, balang metung king babo bubungan na ning keang bale, at karing karelang patio, at karing patiu na ning bale na ning Dios, at king maliwalas a karinan ning pasbulan dalan ning danum, at king maliwalas a karinan king pasbulan dalan ning Efraim.

At ing mabilug a kapulungan da ding dinatang pepasibayu a menibatan king pangabijag guinawa lang dalungdung, at menuknangan la karing dalungdung: uling manibat karing aldo nang Jesua a anak nang Nun angga king aldo a ita ding anak na ning Israel e la pa dinapat makanian. At mika ating binang maragul a saya.

Anti naman aldo-aldo, manibat king mumunang aldo angga king aldo a tauli, minasa ya king libru na ning kautusan na ning Dios. At pigmasusian da ing pista king pitung aldo; at king kawalung aldo metung yang masusing kapulungan agpang king tuntunan.
Ngeni king kadua nang pulu at apat a aldo ning bulan a iti mitipun la ding anak na ning Israel king pamagayunu, at misusulud lang suput, at gabun ing king buntuk da.
At ing bini na ning Israel kinawani na karing anggang anak na ding aliwang labuad, at tinalakad la at pisiag da ing karelang kasalanan, at ing dewakan da ding karelang mangatua.

At pesitalakad la king karelang pagkabilian, at minasa la king libru na ning kautusan ning GUINUNG Dios da king metung nang kapat a dake ning aldo; at king metung a kapat a dake memasiag la, at sinamba la king GUINU a karelang Dios.

Kanita tinalakad la karing balitang ding Levitas, di Jesua, at i Bani, i Cadmiel, i Sebanias, i Buni, i Serebias, i Bani, at i Quenani, at dinalung la king masikan a siwala king GUINU a karelang Dios.

Kanita ding Levitas, a di Jesua, at i Cadmiel, i Bani, i Hasabneias, i Serebias, i Hodias, i Sebanias, at i Petahias, sinabi ra, Talakad kayu at panuanan ye Ing GUINU a kekong Dios manibat king alang angga angga king alang angga; at nuan ya ing kekang maligayang laguiu, a mitas ya babo ning sablang kanuanan at kapurian.

Ika Ing GUINU, ika mung bukud; ika ing linalang king banua, ing banua ra ding banua, pati na ding karelang sablang ejercito, ing labuad at ding sablang bague a atiu kaniti, ding dayatmalat at ding sablang atiu karela, at ika ing papanatili, karela ngan; at ing ejercito na ning banua sasamba keka.
Ika Ing GUINU a Dios, a memili kang Abram, at migdala kea manibat king Ur da ding Caldeos, at minie kea king laguiung Abraham,

At ikit me ing keang pusu a tapat ya king arapan mu, at guinawa kang tipan kea bamung ibie ing labuad na ning Cananeo, ning Heteo, ning Amoreo, at ning Perezeo, at ning Jebuseo, at ning Gergeseo, bang ibie mu king keang bini, at tiparan mo ding kekang amanu; uling matulid ka.
At akit mu ing kasakitan da ding kekeng mangatua karin king Egipto, at pekiramdaman mu ing karelang dalung king lele na ning Dayatmalat a Malutu,

At pepakit kang tanda at makapagmulala kang Faraon, at karing sabla nang talasuyu, at king mabilug a balayan ning keang labuad; uling balu mu king dinapat lang kapalaluan salang karela, at kinanua kang keka metung a laguiu, anti mo king aldo ngeni.

At sinangi me ing dayatmalat king arapan da, nanupata dinalan la king libutad na ning dayatmalat king malanging gabun; at ding tatagal karela inugse mula king kalalaman, a anti mong metung a batu king masikanan a danum.
Bukud kaniti king metung a asias a biga pitnubayan mula ngening aldo; at king metung a asias ning api king bengi, bamong dinan sulu king dalan a karelang lalakaran.
Kinuldas ka namang mine king bunduk ning Sinai, at mekisabi ka karela manibat banua, at dininan mong matulid a tuntunan at tune kautusan, mangayap a landas at utus.
At pepabalu me karela ing kekang banal a sabbath, at minutus ka karela karing utus, at tuntunan, at metung a kautusan, king pamamilatan na ning talasuyu mung i Moises.

At minie ka karelang tinape a menibat banua dikil king karelang danup, at pigdala mong danum a menibat king batu dikil king karelang kau, at inutus mu karela king lungub la bang bandian da ing labuad a simpa mung ibie karela.
Dapot ila at ding kekaming mangatua dinapat dinapat lang kapalaluan, at pepasias de ing karelang tundun, at e ro pekiramdaman ding kekang utus,

At tinanggui lang mamintu, ni e ro gueneka man ding kekang makapagmulala a depatan mu karela, nung e pepasias de ing karelang tundun, at king kapanlabanan da minalal lang metung a capitan balang mibalik king karelang pangabijag. Dapot ika metung kang Dios a makasadiang mamatawad, malam at mapamakalulu, banayad king pamimua, at labislabis king kapakaluluan, at e mo pepaimburisan.
Wa, inyang guinawa lang karela metung a biserung vacang bibu, at sinabi ra, Iti ing kekang Dios a misampa keka a menibatan Egipto, at dinapat lang maragul a pamamungkasi;

Makanianman ika king kekang labislabis a pakalulu e mo pepaimburisan king ilang: ing asias a biga e kinawani tulid da ngening aldo, banong patnubayan king dalan; ni ing asias a api king bengi, banong pakitanan sala, at ing dalan karelang sukat lakaran.
Binie muya naman ing kekang mayap a Espiritu bamong ituru, at e mu kinawat ing kekang mana king karelang asbuk, at dininan mong danum dikil king karelang kau.
Wa, apatapulung banua inalale mula king ilang, at e la migkulang king nanuman; ing karelang imalan e mearan, at ding karelang bitis e la mengalbag.

Bukud kaniti dininan mung kayarian at balayan, a binie mung agpang karing karelang dake: inya sa bindian da ing labuad na ning Sihon, a ya pin ing labuad na ning ari ning Hesbon, at ing labuad nang Og a ari ning Basan.
Ding karela mang anak peparakal mula a anti mo ding batuin king banua, at linub mula king labuad a makatungkul king sinabi mu karing karelang mangatua, king kailangan lang lungub barang bandian iti.

Inya ding anak linub la at bindian da ing labuad, at pepasuku mula king arapan da ding manuknangan king labuad, ding Cananeos, at binie mo karing karelang gamat, pati na ding karelang ari, at ding balayan na ning labuad, barang daptan karela ing kaburian da.

At kinanua la karing ciudad a makakuta, at metung a matabang labuad, at bindian dala ding bale a mitmu karing sablang mangayap a bague, ding talagang betuan a inaun, ding uvasan, at mula ding olivos, at ding mamungang dutung a binang dakal: nanupata mengan la, at kinabsi la, at metaba la, at migpakasaya la king maragul mung kayapan.

Makanian man meguing mapanalangsang la, at memaglaban la salang keka, at inugse ra ing kautusan mu king gugulutan da, at pete rala ding kekang manula a pepatutu salang karela barong malyaring abalik pasibayu keka, at dinapat lang mangaragul a pamamungkasi.

Inya pin binie mula king gamat da ding karelang kasalang, a guinutgut karela: at king panaun na ning karelang kaligaligan, inyang dinalung la keka, pekiramdaman mu manibat banua; at agpang karing binang dakal mung pakalulu dininan mulang talapagligtas a migligtas karela king gamat da ding karelang kasalang.

Dapot kaibat dang mika kapainawan, dinapat no namang pasibayung marawak king arapan mu; inya pin likuan mula king gamat da ding karelang kasalang, inya mika pamaniakup la karela: makanianman inyang mibalik la at dinalung la keka, pekiramdam mu manibat banua; at madalas linigtas mula agpang karing kekang pakalulu,

At pepatutu ka salang karela, bamong ibalik pasibayu king kekang kautusan. Makanianman dinapat lang kapalaluan, at e ro pekiramdam ding kekang utus, nung e mikasala la salang karing kekang tuntunan (a nung ing metung a tau daptan nala, mie ya karela), at inurung de ing pago ra, at pepasias de ing karelang tundun, at e la mebisang mekiramdam.

Makanianman mibabata kang dakal a banuang kayantabe ra, at pepatutu ka salang karela king pamamilatan na ning kekang Espiritu karing kekang manula: makanianman e la mekiramdam: inya pin binie mula king gamat da ding balayan da ding labuad.
Makanian man karing binang dakal mung pakalulu e mu depatan ing lubus dang pangayangganan, ni e mo pepaimburisan; uling metung kang malam at mapamakalulung Dios.

Ngeni inya pin, kekeng Dios, a maragul, at masikanan, at makapangilabut a Dios, mimingat tipan at kapakaluluan, e mu sa bibilang anting malati king arapan mu ing sablang kaligaligan, a dimpa kekami, karing kekaming ari, karing kekaming principes, at karing kekaming sacerdotes, at karing kekaming manula, at karing kekaming mangatua, at king kekang mabilug a balayan, manibat king kapanaunan da ding ari ning Asiria angga king aldo iti.
Makanianman matulid ka king sablang dimpa kekami; uling dinapat kang katutuan, dapot ikami dinapat keng dewakan;

Ni ding kekaming ari, ding kekaming principes, ding kekaming sacerdotes, ni ding kekaming mangatua, e ra iningat ing kekang kautusan, ni mekiramdam karing kekang utus at karing kekang pamipatutu a pepatutu mu salang karela.

Uling e la sinuyu keka king karelang kayarian, at king kekang maragul a kayapan a binie mu karela, at king labuad a maragul at mataba a binie mu king arapan da, ni e la kinawani karing karelang marawak a dapat.
Oini, ipus kami king aldo a iti, at makatungkul king labuad a binie mu karing kekaming mangatua baming kanan ing bunga na at ing kayapan na, oini, ipus kami kaniti.

At iti mamungang dakal karing ari a binili mu kekami bang mamajala king uli ra ding kekaming kasalanan: anti naman atin lang kayupayan karing kekeng katawan, at mamajala karing kekeng animal, agpang king tula ra, at ikami ati kami king maragul a kagutgutan.
At makanianman king uli na ning sablang iti gagawa kaming metung a tipan a tapat, at isulat iti; at ding kekaming principes, ding kekaming Levitas, at ding kekaming sacerdotes, tatakan da iti.
Ngeni detang miniling tatak ila pin: i Nehemias a gobernador, a anak nang Hacalias, at i Zedequias.
I Seraya, i Azarias, i Jeremias,
I Pashur, i Amarias, i Malquias,
I Hatus, i Sebanias, i Malluk,
I Harim, i Meremot, i Obadias,
I Daniel, i Gineton, i Baruk,
I Mesullam, i Abias, i Miamin,
I Maazias, i Bilgai, i Semaya; deti ila ding sacerdotes.
At ding Levitas: a milaguiuwan, i Jesua a anak nang Azanias, i Binui karing anak nang Henadad, i Cadmiel;
At ding karelang kapatad, i Sebanias, i Hodias, i Kelita, i Pelaya, i Hanan,
I Mica, i Rehob, i Hasabias,
I Zacur, i Serebias, i Sebanias,
I Hodias, i Bani, i Beninu.
Ding pekapun ning balayan: i Paros, i Pahat-moab, i Elam, i Zatu, i Bani,
I Buni, i Azgad, i Bebai,
I Adonias, i Bigvai, i Adin,
I Aater, i Hezequias, i Azur,
I Hodias, i Hasum, i Bezai,
I Harif, i Anatot, i Nobai,
I Magpias, i Mesullam, i Hezir,
I Mesezabel, i Zadoc, i Jadua,
I Pelatias, i Hanan, i Anaya,
I Hoseas, i Hananias, i Hasub,
I Hallohes, i Pilha, i Sobec,
I Rehum, i Hasabna, i Maaseya,
At i Ahias, i Hanan, i Anan,
I Malluc, i Harim, i Baana,

At ing makatagan king balayan, ding sacerdotes, ding Levitas, ding bante pasbul, ding taladalit, ding Netineos, at ding anggang kewani ra ing sarili ra karing balayan da ding labuad a mine la king kautusan na ning Dios, ding karelang asawa, ding karelang anak a lalaki, at ding karelang anak a babai, ing balang ating beluan at pamangilala;

Mekianib la karing karelang kapatad, ding makamal da, at linub la king metung a sumpa, at king metung a masusing pangaku, a lumakad la king kautusan na ning Dios, a miabie king pamamilatan nang Moises a talasuyu na ning Dios, at bang tuparan at daptan do ding anggang utus ning GUINUNG kekaming Guinu, at ding keang kautusan at ding keang tuntunan;
At bang e mila ibie ding kekaming anak a babai karing balayan na ning labuad, ni kuanan man ding karelang anak a babai dikil karing kekaming anak a lalaki;

At nung ding balayan na ning labuad magdala lang kalakal o nanu mang binutil king aldo na ning sabbath barang pisali, king e ke sali karela king sabbath, o king metung a banal a aldo; at king ipainawa miya ing kapitung banua, at ing pamanyingil king balang utang.
Makanian mu naman guinawa keng tuntunan a dikil kekami, a kuananan mi ing sarili mi banua-banua king katlung dake na ning metung a siclo dikil king pamanyuyu king bale na ning kekaming Dios;

Dikil king tinape a ain, at dikil king makaparating ain a pamangan, at dikil king makaparating ain a durulukan, dikil karing sabbath, dikil karing bayung bulan, dikil karing pistang makatuldu, at dikil karing banal a bague, at dikil karing ain king kasalanan bang dapat pamisut dikil king Israel, at dikil king anggang daraptan king bale na ning kekaming Dios.

At guinawa keng pamipaningalma, ding sacerdotes, ding Levitas, at ing balayan, dikil king ain a dutung, bayang ilub king bale na ning kekaming Dios, agpang karing bale ra ding kekeng mangatua, karing panaun a mituldu, banua-banua, bang dukulan king babo na ning altar ning GUINU a kekaming Dios, anti mo ing makasulat king kautusan;
At bang dalan ing mumuna nang bunga ning kekaming gabun, at ding mumuna rang bunga ding anggang bunga ra ding sarisaring dutung, banua-banua, king bale ning GUINU;

Makanian mu naman ding pangane karing kekaming anak a lalaki, at karing kekeng animal, anti mo ing makasulat king kautusan, at ding pangane karing kekeng kawan a vaca at karing kekeng kawan a tupa, bang dalan la king bale na ning kekaming Dios, karing sacerdotes a manibala king bale na ning Dios;

At king dalan mi ing mumunang bunga na ning kekeng masang arina, at ding kekeng ain a tatas, at ing bunga ra ding sarisaring dutung, ing bayung alak at ing laru, karing sacerdotes, karing silid na ning bale ning kekaming Dios; at ding sikapulu na ning kekaming gabun karing Levitas; uling ila, ding Levitas, kakuanan da ing sikapulu karing anggang ciudad ning kekaming asikan.

At ing sacerdote a anak nang Aaron mabe ya karing Levitas, ngening ding Levitas, ngening ding Levitas kakua lang sikapulu: at isampa ra ding Levitas ing sikapulu ra ding sikapulu king bale na ning kekaming Dios, karing silid, king kilub ning bale ning pibandian.

Uling ding anak na ning Israel at ding anak nang Levi dalan da ing ain nang tatas ning binutil, ning bayung alak, at ning laru, karing silid, a nung nu la karin ding kasangkapan na ning santuario, at ding sacerdotes a manibala, at ding bante pasbul, at ding taladalit: at e miya paimburisan ing bale na ning kekaming Dios.

At ding principes na ning balayan menuknangan la king Jerusalem: ding mitagan king balayan guinawa la mu namang pamipaningalma, bang karing balang apulu ing metung midala ya a manuknangan king Jerusalem a banal a ciudad, at ding siam a dake karing aliwang ciudad.
At penanuanan no ning balayan ding anggang lalaki a pesiain kusa king sarili ra bang manuknangan king Jerusalem.

Ngeni deti pin ilang pekapun king lalawigan a menuknangan king Jerusalem: dapot karing ciudad ning Juda menuknangan ya ing balang metung king keang pibandian karing karelang ciudad, king matulid a sabi, ing Israel, ding sacerdotes, at ding Levitas, at ding Netineos, at ding anak da ding talasuyu nang Solomon.

At king Jerusalem tinuknang la ding mapilan karing anak nang Juda, at karing anak nang Benjamin. Karing anak nang Juda: I Ataya a anak nang Uzias, a anak nang Zacarias, a anak nang Amarias, a anak nang Sefatias, a anak nang Mahalalel, karing anak nang Perez;
At i Maaseias a anak nang Baruc, a anak nang Colose, a anak nang Hazaya, a anak nang Adaya, a anak nang Joiarib, a anak nang Zacarias, a anak ning Siloneo.
Ding anggang anak nang Perez a menuknangan king Jerusalem apat lang dalan anamapulu at walung mangatapang a lalaki.
At deti ila ding anak nang Benjamin: i Sallu a anak nang Mesullam, a anak nang Joed, a anak nang Pedaya, a anak nang Kolaias, a anak nang Maaseias, a anak nang Itiel, a anak nang Jesaias.
At tinuki kea ila pin i Gabai, i Sallai, siam lang dalan aduangpulu at walu.
At i Joel a anak nang Zicri ya ing karelang talasiasat; at i Juda a anak nang Hasenua kadua yang mamajala king ciudad.
Karing sacerdotes: i Jedaya a anak nang Joiarib, i Jaquin,
I Seraya a anak nang Hilcias, a anak nang Mesullam, a anak nang Zadoc, a anak nang Meraiot, a anak nang Ahitub, a pekapun king bale na ning Dios,

At ding karelang kapatad a dinapat king daraptan king bale, walu lang dalan aduangpulu at adua: at i Adaya a anak nang Jeroham, a anak nang Pelalias, a anak nang Amzi, a anak nang Zacarias, a anak nang Pashur, a anak nang Malquias,
At ding keang kapatad, a pekapun karing bale ra ding mangatua, adua lang dalan apatapulu at adua; at i Amasai a anak nang Azarel, a anak nang Asai, a anak nang Mesillemot, a anak nang Imer,
At ding karelang kapatad, masikanan lang lalaki ning tapang, dinalan la aduangpulu at walu. At ing karelang talasiasat ya i Zabdiel, a anak nang Hagedolim.
At karing Levitas: I Semaya a anak nang Hasub, a anak nang Azricam, a anak nang Hasabias, a anak nang Buni;
At i Sabetai at i Josabad, karing pekapun da ding Levitas, a ilang talasiasat king daraptan king lual ning bale na ning Dios;

At i Matanias a anak nang Mica, a anak nang Sabdi, a anak nang Asaf, a ya ing pekapun a manimula king pamipasalamat king pamanalangin, at i Bacbuquias, a kadua karing keang kapatad; at i Abda a anak nang Samua, a anak nang Galal, a anak nang Jedutun.
Ding anggang Levitas king banal a ciudad adua lang dalan walungpulu at apat.
Bukud kaniti ding bante pasbul, i Akub, i Talmon, at ding karelang kapatad, a migbante karing pasbulan dalan, dinalan la pitungpulu at adua.
At ing mitagan king Israel, karing sacerdotes, ding Levitas, atilu karing anggang ciudad na ning Juda, balang metung king keang mana.
Dapot ding Netineos a menuknangan king Ofel: at i Ziha at i Gispa atilu mamajala karing Netineos.

Ding talasiasat da naman ding Levitas king Jerusalem ya i Uzzi a anak nang Bani, a anak nang Hasabias, a anak nang Matanias, a anak nang Mica, karing anak nang Asaf, a taladalit, a mamajala king dapat king bale na ning Dios.
Uling ating metung a utus a menibatan king ari tungkul karela, at pamangan a makatalaga dikil karing taladalit, agpang king aduan na ning balang aldo.
At i Petahias a anak nang Mesezabel, karing anak nang Zera a anak nang Juda, atiu king gamat na ning ari king anggang bague a makatungkul king balayan.

At makatungkul karing nayun, pati na ding karelang marangle, ding mapilan karing anak ning Juda menuknangan la king karing Kiriat-arba at karing balen na niti, at king Dibon at karing balen na niti, at king Jecabzeel at karing nayun na niti.
At king Jesua, at king Molada, at king Bet-pelet,
At king Hazar-sual, at king Beerseba at karing balen na aniti.
At king Siclag, at king Mecona at karing balen na niti,
At king En-rimon, at king Zora, at king Jarmut,

At king Zanoa, Adullam, at karing karelang nayun, king Laquis at karing marangle na niti, king Azeca at karing balen na niti. Makanian lang menalakad manibat king Beer-seba angga king libis na ning Hinom.
Ding anak nang Benjamin menuknangan la namang manibat king Geba, king Micmas at king Aya, at king Bet-el at karing balen da deti,
At king Anatot, king Nob, king Ananias.
King Hazor, king Rama, king Gitaim,
King Hadid, king Zeboim, king Neballat,
King Lod, at king Ono, ing libis da ding taladapat.
At karing Levitas, ding aliwang panga dake-dake king Juda mekipamisan la king Benjamin.
Ngeni deti ila ding sacerdotes at ding Levitas a sinampa a kayabe nang Zorobabel a anak nang Sealtiel, at i Jesua: i Seraia, i Jeremias, i Esdras,
I Amarias, i Malluc, i Hatus,
I Secanias, i Rehum, i Meremot,
I Iddo, i Ginetoi, i Abias,
I Mijamin, i Maadias, i Bilga,
I Semaya, at i Joiarib, i Jedaya,
I Sallu, i Amoc, i Hilcias, i Jedaya. Deti ilang pekapun da ding sacerdotes at ding karelang kapatad karing kayaldawan nang Jesua.
Bukud kaniti ding Levitas: i Jesua, i Binui, i Cadmiel, i Serebias, i Juda, at i Matanias, a mamajala king pamipasalamat, ya at ding keang kapatad.
Anti naman i Bacbukias at i Uno, ding karelang kapatad, atilu king tulid da agpang karing karelang katungkulan.
At i Jesua ayanak ne i Joiakim, at i Joiakim ayanak ne i Eliasib, at i Eliasib ayanak ne i Joiada,
At i Joiada ayanak ne i Jonatan, at i Jonatan ayanak ne i Jadua.
At karing kayaldawan nang Joiakim ating sacerdotes, a pekabuntuk la karing bale ra ding mangatua: kang Seraya, i Meraya; kang Jeremias, i Hananias;
Kang Esdras, i Mesullam; kang Amarias, i Jeohanan;
Kang Malluqui, i Jonatan; kang Sebanias, i Jose;
Kang Harim, i Adna; kang Merayot, i Helcai;
Kang Iddo, i Zacarias; kang Gineton, i Mesullam;
Kang Abias, i Zicri; kang Miniamin, kang Moadias, i Piltai;
Kang Bilga, i Samua; kang Semaya, i Jeonatan;
At kang Joiarib, i Matenai; kang Jedaya, i Uzzi;
Kang Sallai, i Callai; kang Amoc, i Eber;
Kang Hilcias, i Hasabias; kang Jedaya, i Netanel.

Tungkul karing Levitas, karing kayaldawan di Eliasib, Joiada, at Johanan, at Jadua, ating misulat karing pekabuntuk karing bale ra ding mangatua; anti naman ding sacerdotes, king pamagari nang Dario a tau Persia.
Ding anak nang Levi, a pekabuntuk karing bale ra ding mangatua, makasulat la king libru ra ding cronica, angga man pin karing aldo nang Johanan a anak nang Eliasib.

At ding pekapun da ding Levitas: i Hasabias, i Serebias, at i Jesua a anak nang Cadmiel, pati na ding karelang kapatad king tulid da, balang muri at munie pasalamat, agpang king utus nang David a lalaki na ning Dios, a bante a katuki, ning bante.
I Matanias, at i Bacbukias, i Obadias, i Mesullam, i Talmon, i Akub, deti bante lang pasbul a masbante karing kamalig karing pasbulan dalan.
Deti atilu karing kayaldawan nang Joiakim a anak nang Jesua, a anak nang Josadac, at karing kayaldawan nang Nehemias a gobernador, at nang Esdras a sacerdote a escriba.

At king pamitalaga king kuta na ning Jerusalem penintun dala ding Levitas manibat karing sabla rang karinan, barong dalang king Jerusalem, bang pagmasusian da ing pamitalaga kagum ning saya, a ating pamipasalamat, at anti naman pamanialat, kambe ding cimbalo, salterio, at kambe ding alpa.
At ding anak da ding taladalit mitipun lang makapamisan, manibat king kapatagan king makapatulug king Jerusalem, at anti naman manibat karing nayun da ding Netofatitas;
Anti naman manibat king Betgilgal, at manibat karing marangle na ning Geba at ning Azmavet: uling ding taladalit telakad dong karela ding nayun a makapatulug king Jerusalem.
At ding sacerdotes at ding Levitas migpakalinis la; at lininis da ing balayan, at ding pasbulan dalan, at ing kuta.

Kanita penik kula ding principes ning Juda king babo na ning kuta, at tinuldu kung aduang mangaragul a tapuk a minie pasalamat at mine lang mitukituki; a ing metung mine ya king dane wanan king babo na ning kuta king nangan na ning pasbulan dalan ning piugsianan dinat:
At tinuki ya king gugulutan da i Hosaya, at ding kapitna karing principes ning Juda.
At i Azarias, i Esdras, at i Mesullam,
I Juda, at i Benjamin, at i Semaya, at i Jeremias,

At ding aliwa karing anak dang lalaki ding sacerdotes a ating pakakak: i Zacarias a anak nang Jonatan, a anak nang Semaya, a anak nang Matanias, a anak nang Micaya, a anak nang Zacur, a anak nang Azaf;

At ding keang kapatad a i Semaya, at i Azarel, i Milalai, i Gilalai, i Maai, i Netanel, at i Juda, i Hanani, a atin lang instrumentos ning musica nang David a lalaki na ning Dios; at i Esdras a escriba atiu king mumuna ra.

At king siping ning pasbulan dalan na ning bukal, at matulid king arapan da, sinampa la king pamamilatan da ding balitang na ning ciudad nang David, king ukiatan king kuta, king babo na ning bale nang David, angga pin king pasbulan dalan ning danum king dane aslagan.

At ing aliwang tapuk karela a minie pasalamat mine la bang saganan dala, at aku kaibat da, a kayabe ku ing kapitna na ning balayan, king babo na ning kuta, king babo na ning batiawan da ding hornu, angga pin king maliwalas a kuta,

At king babo na ning pasbulan dalan ning Efraim, at king siping ning matuang pasbulan dalan, at king siping ning pasbulan dalan ning asan, at king batiawan na ning Hananel, at king batiawan na ning Hamea, angga pin king pasbulan dalan da ding tupa: at tinalakad lang maratun king pasbulan dalan da ding bante.
Makanian lang tinalakad ding adua rang tapuk ding minie pasalamat king bale na ning Dios at aku, at ing kapitna karing pekapun a kayabe ku;
At ding sacerdotes, i Eliakim, i Maaseya, i Miniamin, i Micaya, i Elioenai, i Zacarias, at i Hananias, kagum ding pakakak;
At i Maaseya, at i Semaya, at i Eleazar, at i Uzzi, at i Jeohanan, at i Malquias, at i Elam, at i Ezer. At ding taladalit dinalit lang masikan, a kayabe re i Jezrahias a talapanibala karela.

At minain lang mangaragul a daun king aldo a ita, at migsaya la; uling ing Dios pepasaya nala king maragul a tula; at ding babai man at ding anak metula la: nanupata ing tula king Jerusalem meramdam angga king marayu.

At king aldo a ita mitulduan la ding lalaking mamajala karing silid dikil karing pibandian, dikil karing ain a tatas, dikil karing mumunang bunga, at dikil karing sikapulu, bang tipunan lang ilub karela, agpang karing marangle ra ding ciudad, ding dake a tutulduan na ning kautusan dikil karing sacerdotes at Levitas: uling metula ing Juda king uli ra ding sacerdotes at king uli ra ding Levitas a makapanaya.
At iningat da ing bilin ning karelang Dios, at ing bilin king pamaglinis, at makanian dang depatan ding taladalit at ding bante pasbul, agpang king utus nang David, at nang Solomon a keang anak.
Uling karing kayaldawan nang David at i Asaf king panaun a minuna ating metung a pekapun da ding taladalit, at ding dalit a kapurian at kapasalamatan king Dios.

At ing mabilug a Israel karing kayaldawan nang Zerubabel, at karing kayaldawan nang Nehemias, binie ra ing dake ra ding taladalit at ding bante pasbul, agpang king aduan na ning balang aldo: at karelang kewani itang dikil karing Levitas; at ding Levitas kewani ra ing dikil karing anak nang Aaron.

King aldo at ita binasa ra king libru nang Moises king daramdaman na ning balayan; at karin da ikit makasulat, king ing metung a Ammonita at ing metung Moabita e la sukat lulub king kapulungan na ning Dios king kapilan pa man,
Uling e ro selubungan ding anak na ning Israel king tinape at king danum, nung e inupajan de i Balaam salang karela, banong isumpa: makanian man ing kekaming Dios pepalyarian nang kanuanan ing sumpa.
At milyari, inyang dimdam da ing kautusan, king kewani ra king Israel ing mabilug a keraklan a samutsamut.
Ngeni bayu iti, i Eliasib a sacerdote, a mitulduan mamajala karing silid ning bale na ning kekeng Dios, anti ning atin yang pamakikasundu kang Tobias,

Misadia yang dikil kea metung a maragul a silid, a king minuna pibibilian da karing ain a pamangan, king labun, at karing kasangkapan, at karing sikapulu na ning binutil, ning bayung alak, at ning laru, a miabie king pamamilatan na ning utus karing Levitas, at karing taladalit, at karing bante pasbul; at karing ain a tatas dikil karing sacerdotes.

Dapot king anggang panaun a iti ala ku king Jerusalem; uling king katlu nang pulu at aduang banuang Artajerjes a ari ning Babilonia mine ku king ari: at kaibat da ding mapilan aldo memun kung mako king ari,
At miras ku king Jerusalem, at atalastas ku ing dewakan a depatan nang Eliasib makatungkul kang Tobias, king pamisadia na keang metung a silid karing kilub patio ning bale na ning Dios.
At iti kelungkut kung bina: inya pin inugse kula king lual ning silid ding anggang kasangkapan nang bale Tobias.
Kanita minutus ku, at lininis do ding silid: at dela kong pasibayu karin ding kasangkapan king bale ning Dios, pati na ding ain a pamangan at ing labun.
At akilala ku king ding dake ra ding Levitas e miabie karela; nanupata ding Levitas at ding taladalit, a dinapat king daraptan, pesitakas la balang metung king keang marangle.
Kanita mekitua ku karing pekapun, at sinabi ku, Baket mipaimburisan ya ing bale ning Dios? At tinipun kong makapamisan, at binili kula king karelang karinan.
Kanita dela ning mabilug a Juda ing sikapulu na ning binutil at ning bayung alak at ning laru karing pisisimpanan pibandian.

At guinawa kung talaingat bandi karing pisisimpanan pibandian, di Selemias a sacerdote, at i Zadoc a escriba, at karing Levitas, i Pedaya: at ing katuki ra ya i Hanan a anak nang Zacur, a anak nang Matanias; uling mibilang lang tapat, at ing katungkulan da ya ing mirake karing karelang kapatad.
Ganakan muku, Oh Dios ko, makatungkul kaniti, at e mu papawian ing kanakung mangayap a dapat a depatan ku dikil king bale na ning kanakung Dios, at dikil king pamanupad kaniti.

Karing aldo a deta ikit kula king Juda ding mapilan a lalaking papasla king uvasan king sabbath, at milulub karing inaptas, at sasakenan do kaniti ding asno; anti mu naman king alak, karing uvas, at karing higos, at king anggang sarisaring pupusanan, a lulub da king Jerusalem king aldo na ning sabbath: at pepatutu kung salang karela king kayaldawan na ning pamamisali ra king pamangan.
Atin mu namang manuknangan a tau king Tiro karin, a milulub asan, at sarisaring kalakal, at misasali la king sabbath karing anak na ning Juda, at king Jerusalem.
Kanita mekitua ku karing makamal ning Juda, at sinabi ku karela, Nanung marawak a bague iting kekong daraptan, at dirinatan ye ing aldo na ning sabbath?

E la wari dinapat makanian ding kekong mangatua, at e na wari pepagpa ning kekatang Dios ing anggang dewakan a iti kekatamo, at king ciudad a ite? makanianman papagpa kong lalu pang makamua king Israel king pamaniapat yung karinatan king sabbath.

At milyari king, kanitang ding pasbulan dalan na ning Jerusalem ume nong dalumdum bayu ya datang ing sabbath, inutus ku king ding pasbul ikabat la, at inutus ku king e la bubuklatan anggang e milabas ing sabbath; at ding mapilan karing kanakung talasuyu binili kula a mamajala karing pasbulan dalan, bang alang alub a pusan king aldo na ning sabbath.
Inya ding mangalakal at magtinda king sarisaring kalakal migsantung la king lual ning Jerusalem misan o makaladua.

Kanita pepatutu ku salang karela, at sinabi ku karela, Baket makasantung kayu king tulid ning kuta? nung dapat kong pasibayung makanian, aku buatanan dakong gamat. Manibat king panaun a ita e no dinatang pa king sabbath.

At inutus ku karing Levitas king magpakalinis la, at king datang la at ingatan dala ding pasbulan dalan, bayang mipabanalan ing aldo sabbath. Ganakan mu kaku, Oh kanakung Dios, iti man, at pakawanan muku agpang king degulan na ning kekang pakalulu.
Karing aldo mu namang deta ikit kula ding Judios a mekiasawa karing babai ning Asdod, ning Ammon, at ning Moab:
At ding karelang anak maniabi lang kapitna king amanung Asdod, at e la makapaniabi king amanu ding Judios, nung e agpang king amanu na ning balang balayan.

At mekitua ku karela, at simpa kula, at sinugat ko ding aliwa karela, at pitput ku ing karelang buak, at pepasumpan kula king pamamilatan na ning Dios, sinabi ku, E yo babie ding anak yung babai karing anak dang lalaki, ni e yo kakuanan ding anak dang babai dikil karing anak yung lalaki, o dikil karing kekong sarili.

E wari mekasala i Solomon a ari ning Israel king pamamilatan da ding bague a dete? makanianman king libutad da ding dakal a bansa alang aring anti mo ya, at meguing kalugudlugud ya king keang Dios, at guewa neng ari ning Dios king mabilug a Israel: makanianman aguiang ya pa pepaguing makasalanan de ding babaing tau king aliwang labuad?
Makiramdam ke pin wari kekayo bang daptan ing anggang mangaragul a dewakan a ite, bang salangsang salang king kekatang Dios king pamakiasawa karing babaing tau king aliwang labuad?
At ing metung karing anak nang Joiada, a anak nang Eliasib a matas a sacerdote, manuyang neng Sanbalat a Horonita: inya pin iti tinabi ke kanaku.
Ganakan mula, Oh kanakung Dios, uling karelang dinatan ing pangasacerdote, at ing tipan king pangasacerdote, at ing karing Levitas.
Makanian kong lininis karing anggang tau king aliwang labuad, at mituldu kung bilin dikil karing sacerdotes at dikil karing Levitas, balang metung king keang daraptan;
At makatungkul king ain a dutung, karing makatuldung panaun, at tungkul karing mumunang bunga. Ganakan muku, Oh kanakung Dios, dikil king ikakayakap.
Ngeni milyari karing kayaldawan nang Asuero (iti ya ing Asuero a migari manibat king India angga pin king Etiopia, karing dinalan aduangpulu at pitung lalawigan),
King karing aldo a deta, inyang ing aring Asuero makalukluk ya king luklukan na ning keang kayarian, a atiu king Susan a palacio.

King katlung banua na ang pamagari, guinawa yang metung a pista karing sabla nang principes at karing talasuyu na; ing upaya ning Persia at ning Media, ding makamal at principes da ding lalawigan; atilu king arapan na;
Inyang ipakit na ing pibandian na ning keang maligayang kayarian at ing kapurian na ning masaplala nang panga ari karing dakal a aldo, dinalan pin at walungpulung aldo.

At inyang mapupus no ding aldo a deti, ing ari guinawa yang metung a pista king mabilug a balayan a atiu king palacio Susan, karing mangaragul at makanian mu naman karing mangalati, pitung aldo, king kilub na ning patio na ning mula ning palacio na ning ari.

Ating gayak a sabitsabit a imalan a maputi, at king kule verde, at king azul, a makatali karing panaling megawa king lienzong masinsin at purpura karing singsing a pilak at asias a marmol: ding sandalan guintu la at pilak, king babo na ning metung a pavimentong malutu, at maputi, at kuliawan, at matuling a marmol.
At minie lang inuman karela karing lulanan a guintu (ding lulanan miayaliwa la ing metung at metung), at ing alak ari labislabis, agpang king kabandi na ning ari.

At ing pamaninum agpang king kautusan; alang malyaring makapilit: uling ing ari makanian nang tituk karing anggang pekapun king keang bale, king daptan da ing agpang king katutula na ning balang katau.
Makanian mu naman ing reina Vasti guinawa yang pista dikil karing babai king bale ari a bandi ning aring Asuero.

King kapitung aldo, inyang ing pusu na ning ari masaya ya king pamamilatan na ning alak, inutus ne i Mehuman, i Bizta, i Harbona, i Bigta, at i Abagta, i Zetar, at i Carcas, a pitung camarero a susuyu king arapan na ning aring Asuero,
Bang dalan de ing reina Vasti king arapan na ning ari a makacorona king panga reina, banang ipakit karing balayan at karing principes ing keang leguan; uling malagu yang lalawan.
Dapot ing reina Vasti tinanggui yang datang king utus ning ari king pamamilatan da ding camarero, uli nita ing ari mikapali yang bina, at milablab ing mua na kea.
Kanita sinabi na ning ari karing lalaking mangabiasa, a ating kabaluan karing panaun (uling makanian ing kaugalian na ning ari karing anggang makibalu king kautusan at king kayatulan;

At ing tutuki kea i Carsena, i Setar, i Admata, i Tarsis, i Meres, i Marsena, at i Memucan, ding pitung principes ning Persia at Media, a manakit king lupa na ning ari at lulukluk lang makauna king kayarian),
Nanu ing daptan tamu king reina Vasti agpang king kautusan, uling e na depatan ing utus na ning aring Asuero king pamamilatan da ding camarero?

At i Memucan mekibat ya king arapan na ning ari at karing principes, ing reina Vasti e ya mu dinapat kamalian bukud king ari, nung e pa naman karing anggang principes, at karing anggang balayan a atiu karing anggang lalawigan na ning aring Asuero.

Uling ing depatan nang iti ning reina mikalat karing anggang babai, barong gawan makamua ding karelang asawa karing karelang mata, nung iti mipaulat, Ing aring Asuero inutus ne ing reina Vasti bang midala king keang arapan, dapot e ya dinatang.

At king aldo a iti ding anggang princesas ning Percia at Media a makaramdam king depatan na ning reina maniabi lang anti kanita karing anggang principes na ning ari. Nanupata mibangun ing dakal a kamua at pamikasbu.

Nung ikatula na ning ari, palimpad yang metung a utus ari a ibat kea, at pabustan yang misulat karing kautusan da ding tau Persia at ding tau Media, king bang e mauman, king i Vasti e ne daratang pa king arapan na ning aring Asuero; at pabustan ibie na ning ari ing keang bili a panga reina king aliwa a maiguit kea.

At nung ing utus na ning ari a keang gawan mibulalag ne king mabilug nang kayarian (uling maragul), ding anggang asawang babai munie lang kapurian karing karelang asawa, karing mangaragul at makanian mu naman karing mangalati.
At ing amanu mekapatula king ari at karing principes; at depatan na ning ari ing makayagpang king amanu nang Memucan:

Uling peparala yang sulat karing anggang lalawigan na ning ari, king balang lalawigan agpang king sulat a ita, at king balang balayan agpang king karelang amanu, bang ing balang lalaki manibala ya king sarili nang bale, at maniabing agpang king amanu ning keang balayan.
Kaibat da ding bague a deti, kanitang ing pamikapali na ning aring Asuero meaplak, aganaka ne i Vasti, at nung nanu ing depatan na, at nung nanu ing mi-utus salang kea.
Kanita sinabi ra ding talasuyu na ning ari a susuyu kea, Ipanintun ya sa ing ari karing dalagang bayung tubu a mangalagung alang bakas:

At pabustan yang tuldu ing ari karing pekapun karing anggang lalawigan na ning keang kayarian, barong atipun ding anggang bayung tubu a mangalagung dalagang alang bakas king Susan a palacio, king bale ra ding babai, king pamanibala nang Hegai a camareru na ning ari, a talaingat karing babai; at pabustan lang miabie karela ding karelang bague tungkul king pamanlinis;
At ing dalaga a makapatula king ari pabustan yang maguing reina a kalili nang Vasti. At ing bague mekapatula king ari; at depatan nang makanian.
Ating metung a Judio king Susan a palacio, a ing laguiu na Mardoqueo, a anak nang Jair, a anak nang Simei, a anak nang Kis, a metung a Benjamita,
A midala manibat Jerusalem a kayabe ra ding bijag a midalang kayabe nang Jeconias a ari ning Juda, a dela nang Nabucodonosor a ari ning Babilonia.

At peparagul ne i Hadasa, ngana wari, i Ester, a anak nang babaing bapa na: uling ala yang ibpa ni indu man, at ing dalaga makawili ya at malagu; at inyang mate no ding keang ibpa at indu, kinua neng pekaanak nang Mardoqueo.

Inya milyari, inyang marandam ing utus ning ari at ing keang kautusan, at inyang ding dakal a dalaga makatipun lang makapamisan king Susan a palacio, king kapanibalan nang Hegai, king i Ester midala ya king bale ning ari, king pamanibala nang Hegai, a talaingat karing babai.

At ing dalaga mekapatula ya kea, at migkamit yang ganaka kea; at binie nong malagawa kea ding bague a makatungkul king keang pamaglinis, pati na ding keang dake, at ding pitung dalaga a karampatan ibie kea a manibat king bale ning ari: at dela ne at ding keang dalaga king pekamayap diling karinan king bale ra ding babai.
I Ester e na pepakilala ing keang balayan ni ing keang kamaganakan; uling penabilin na keang Mardoqueo king e na pakilala.
At i Mardoqueo lalakad ya aldo-aldo king arapan na ning patio ning bale ra ding babai, banang abalu nung nanung daraptan nang Ester, at nung nanu ing malyari kea.

Ngeni inyang ing pamiliwasliwas ning balang dalaga miras bareng luban ing aring Asuero, kaibat merapat kea ing agpang king kautusan karing babai king labingaduang bulan (uling makanian lang matutupad ding aldo ning karelang pangalinis, ngana wari, anam a bulan king larung mirra, at anam a bulan king mabanglung bau at karing bague dikil king pamaglinis da ding babai),
Kanita king anti kaniting kaparalanan linub ya ing dalaga king ari: Nanumang keang pagnasan miyayabie kea bayang ume kayabe na a manibat king bale ra ding babai angga king bale ning ari.

King gatpanapun minta ya, at panga abak mibalik ya king kaduang bale ra ding babai, king pamanibala nang Saasgaz, a camareru na ning ari, a mimingat karing babai na: e ne linub pa king ari, subali nung tumula ya kea ing ari, at meaus ya king pamamilatan na ning laguiu.

Ngeni inyang miras ing pamanlub nang Ester, a anak nang Abihail a bapa nang Mardoqueo, a kinanua kea a pekaanak nang babai, king ari, ala yang inawad a nanuman nung e mu ing tildu nang Hegai a camareru ning ari, a talaingat karing babai. At i Ester migkamit yang kalam king panlalawe ra ding anggang makalawe kea.
Makanian yang midala i Ester king aring Asuero king kilub ning keang bale ari king kapulung bulan, a ya ing bulan na ning Tebet, king kapitu nang banua ning keang pamagari.

At liguran ne ning ari i Ester maiguit karing anggang babai, at migkamit yang kalam at ganaka king panlalawe na a maiguit karing anggang dalagang alang bakas; nanupata pinutung ne king keang buntuk ing coronang panga reina, at guewa neng reina a kalili nang Vasti.

Kanita ing ari guinawa yang metung a maragul a pista karing anggang principes na at karing keang talasuyu, pista na ping Ester; at dinapat yang pamitimawa karing lalawigan, at minie yang pagkalub, agpang king kayarinan na ning ari.
At inyang mitipun lang makapamisan ding dalagang alang bakas king kaduang ukdu, kanita linukluk ya i Mardoqueo king pasbulan dalan na ning ari.

E na pa pepakilalang Ester ing keang kamaganakan ni ing keang balayan man; anti mo ing penabilin na keang Mardoqeo: uling depatan nang Ester ing utus nang Mardoqueo, anti mo inyang kayabe ne a paragulan ne.

Karing aldo a deta, kabang makalukluk ya i Mardoqueo king pasbulan dalan na ning ari, ding adua karing camareru na ning ari, i Bigtan at i Teres, karing bante pasbul mikapali la king mua, at panikuanan dang buatanan deng gamat ing aring Asuero.
At ing bague abalu nang Mardoqueo, a pepabalu kaniti king reina Ester; at i Ester sinabi na king ari iti king laguiu nang Mardoqueo.
At inyang marapat ing kasiasatan king bague, at meakit king tutu pin, binite rong mikakametung king metung a dutung: at misulat iti king libru ra ding cronica king arapan ning ari.
Kaibat na ning bague a iti tinas ne ning arig Asuero i Haman a anak nang Hamedata a Agageo, at siplala ne, at binili ne ing keang luklukan a matas dili karing anggang principes a kayabe na.

At ding anggang talasuyu na ning ari, a atiu king pasbulan dalan na ning ari, dinuku la, at guinalang la kang Haman; uling makanian ing utus na ning ari makatungkul kea. Dapot i Mardoqueo e ya dinuku, ni e man guinalang kea.
Kanita ding talasuyu na ning ari, a atiu king pasbulan dalan na ning ari, sinabi ra kang Mardoqueo, Baket sasalangsangan mu ing utus na ning ari?
Ngeni milyari, inyang sasabian da kea aldo-aldo, at e no pakiramdaman, king sinabi ra kang Haman, barang akit nung iting bague nang Mardoqueo manatili: uling sinabi na karela king metung yang Judio.
At inyang ikit nang Haman king i Mardoqueo e ya duruku, ni gagalang man kea, kinatmu yang mua kanita i Haman.

Dapot inisip nang alang kabaldugan a buatanan neng gamat i Mardoqueo a sarili na mu; uling pepakilala ra kea ing balayan nang Mardoqueo: inya pin inisip nang Haman a lipulan no ding anggang Judios a atiu king mabilug nang kayarian Asuero, a ya pin ing balayan nang Mardoqueo.

King mumunang bulan, a ya ing bulan na ning Nisan, king kalabi nang aduang banua ning aring Asuero, initsa re ing Pur, ngana wari, ing pamipaningalma, king arapan nang Haman king aldo-aldo, at king bulan-bulan, angga king kalabing aduang bulan, a ya ing bulan ning Adar.

At sinabi nang Haman king aring Asuero, Ating metung a balayan a makakalat at makasalbag king libutad da ding balayan karing sablang lalawigan na ning kekang kayarian; at ding karelang kautusan makayaliwa la karing king balang balayan; ni e ro tutuparan ding utus ning ari: inya pin ala king pakinabang ning ari ing pibatan nala.

Nung pitutulan na ning ari, misulat sana king malipul la: at aku mamayad kung apulung talentong pilak karing gamat da detang mipanabilinan king dapat ning ari, barong dalan karing pisisimpanan nang pibandian ning ari.
At kinua ne ning ari ing singsing na manibat king keang gamat, at binie ne kang Haman a anak nang Hamedata a Agageo, a kasalang da ding Judios.
At sinabi na ning ari kang Haman, Ing pilak miabie keka, ing balayan man, bamung daptan karela nung nanu ing babalakan mung mayap keka.

Kanita meaus la ding kalijim na ning ari king mumunang bulan, king kalabi nang atlung aldo niti; at ating misulat agpang king anggang inutus nang Haman karing satrapa na ning ari, at karing gobernador a mamajala king balang lalawigan, at karing principes ning balang balayan, king balang lalawigan agpang king pamanyulat da, at king balang balayan agpang king karelang amanu; misulat king laguiu na ning aring Asuero, at mitatakan king singsing ning ari.

At ding sulat miparala la king pamamilatan da ding correo karing anggang lalawigan na ning ari, bang manlasak, bang makamate, at bang manlipul, karing sablang Judios, kayanakan at matua, ding anak a mangalati at ding babai, king misan a aldo, king kalabing atlung aldo na pin ning kalabing aduang bulan, a ya ing bulan na ning Adar, at kuanan ing masamsam karela anting metung a dakap.
Ing metung a likas ning sulat, a miabie king balang lalawigan anting metung a kautusan, mibulalag ya karing anggang balayan, bang magsadia la salang king aldo a ita.

Ding tubud meko lang malagawa king pamamilatan ning utus ning ari, at ing kautusan miabie ya king Susan a palacio. At ing ari at i Haman makalukluk la balang minum; dapot ing ciudad ning Susan makatingangas.

Ngeni inyang abalu nang Mardoqueo ing anggang merapat, guinabak nang Mardoqueo ing keang imalan, at misulud yang suput a maki abu, at linual ya king libutad na ning ciudad, at dinalung yang metung a masikan at metung a mapait a dalung;
At miras ya pin angga na king arapan na ning pasbulan dalan na ning ari: uling alang malyaring milub king kilub ning pasbulan dalan na ning ari a makaimalan suput.

At king balang lalawigan, a nung nu man miras ing utus ning ari at ing keang kautusan, mika ating maragul a pamagpaldas king libutad da ding Judios, at pamagayunu, at pamanangis, at pamaniambitan; at dakal la ding migkera king suput at abu.

At ding dalaga nang Ester at ding keang camarero dinatang la at sinabi ra iti kea; at ing reina melungkut yang bina: at peparala yang imalan bang paimalanan de i Mardoqueo, at banang ilukas ing keang suput kea; dapot e na tinggap.
Kanita inaus neng Ester i Hatac, a metung karing camareru na ning ari, a ya ing tilduan nang sumuyu kea, at penabilinan neng ume ya kang Mardoqueo, banang abalu nung nanu iti, at nung baket makanian.
Nanupata liwalan neng Hatac i Mardoqueo king maliwalas a karinan ning ciudad, a atiu king arapan na ning pasbulan dalan na ning ari.

At selese na keang Mardoqueo ing anggang milyari kea, at ing tapat dang kabilugan ding salapi a pengaku nang Haman a ibayad na karing pisisimpanan nang pibandian ning ari dikil karing Judios, barong lipulan. '

Anti mu rin binie ne kea ing likas ning pangasulat ning kautusan a mibulalag king Susan barong lipulan, bang pakit ne kang Ester, at bang sabian na iti kea, at banang yutus kea king ume ya king ari, bayang magparalampu kea, at banang yaduan kea, tungkul king keang balayan.
At i Hatac dinatang ya at selese no kang Ester ding amanu nang Mardoqueo.
Kanita sinabi nang Ester kang Hatac, at dinanan neng metung a balita kang Mardoqueo, ngana:

Ding anggang talasuyu ning ari, at ing balayan da ding lalawigan, balu ra, king ninuman, maguing lalaki ya o babai, a datang king ari king kakilubkiluban a patio, a e meaus, ating metung a kautusan dikil kea, a patayan ya, subali mu karetang nung kenu ne yatyat ning ari ing cetrong guintu, bayang mie: dapot e ku pa meaus bang lungub king ari kareting atlungpulung aldo.
At sinabi ro kang Mardoqueo ding amanu nang Ester.
Kanita pepabalik nang Mardoqueo karela ing pakibat kang Ester, E mu isipan king kekang sarili a ika mitakas ka king bale na ning ari, a maiguit karing sablang Judios.

Uling nung lubus kang magtajimik king panaun a iti, kanita talakad ing saup at kaligtasan karing Judios manibat king aliwang karinan, dapot ika at ing bale na ning kekang ibpa ma-ala ya: at ninung makibalu nung ika e ka miras keti king kayarian dikil king panaun a anti mo kaniti?
Kanita i Ester pepabalik na ing pakibat kang Mardoqueo,

Ume ka, tipunan mulang makapaminsan ding anggang Judios a atiu king Susan at pagayunu yuku, at e ko mamangan ni miminum man king atlung aldo, king bengi o aldo: aku man ding kakung dalaga magayunu kami namang makanian; at uli nita lungub ku king ari, a iti e makayagpang king kautusan: at nung mate ku, mate ku.
Nanupata mine ya i Mardoqueo king lakad na, at depatan na ing agpang king sablang inutus na keang Ester.

Ngeni milyari king katlung aldo, king i Ester sinulud na ing imalan nang panga reina, at tinalakad ya king pekakilub ning patio ning bale ning ari, king tulid ning bale ning ari: at ing ari makalukluk ya king keang luklukan ari kilub ning bale ari, king tulid ning piluluban ning bale.

At milyari, inyang ikit ne ning ari ing reina Ester a makatalakad ya king patio, king migkamit yang kalam king keang panlalawe; at inatyat ne ning ari kang Ester ing cetrong guintu a atiu king keang gamat. Inya linapit ya i Ester, at tigkilan ne ing sepu ning cetro.
Kanita sinabi na ning ari kea, Nanung buri mu, reina Ester? at nanu ing kekang kayaduanan? miabie keka aguiang ing kapitna na ning kayarian.
At sinabi nang Ester, Nung babalakan nang mayap ning ari, ume la sa king aldo ngeni ing ari at i Haman king maragul a pamangan a sidia ku dikil kea.
Kanita sinabi ning ari, Pamalaguanan ye i Haman, bang marapat ing anti mo ing sinabi nang Ester. Nanupata dinatang ya ing ari at i Haman king maragul a pamangan a sidia nang Ester.
At sinabi na ning ari kang Ester king pamaninum king alak, Nanu ing kayaduanan mu? at mipagkalub keka: at nanu ing kekang awad? aguiang ing kapitna na ning kayarian mapalyari.
Kanita mekibat ya i Ester, at ngana, Ing kanakung kayaduanan at ing kanakung awad ya ini:

Nung menakit kung kalam king panlalawe na ning ari, at nung ikatula na ning ari a ipagkalub na ing kanakung kayaduanan, at tuparan na ing awad ku, ume ya sa ing ari at i Haman king maragul a pamangan a isadia ku dikil karela, at daptan ku bukas ing anti mo ing sinabi na ning ari.

Kanita linual ya i Haman king aldo a ita matula at ating masayang pusu: dapot inyang ikit neng Haman i Mardoqueo king pasbulan dalan na ning ari, a e ya tinalakad ni kinimut man dikil kea, kinatmu yang pamikapali salang kang Mardoqueo.
Makanian man i Haman kinawat na ing keang sarili, at minuli ya bale; at mitubud ya at tinipun no ding kakaluguran na at i Zeres a keang asawa.

At selese nang Haman karela ing ligaya na ning keang pibandian, at ing keraklan da ding keang anak, at ing anggang bague a pisaplala na kea ning ari, at nung makananu neng tinas a maiguit karing principes at karing talasuyu na ning ari.
Sinabi na pang Haman, Wa, ing reina Ester ala yang paluban a ninu man a kayabe na ning ari king maragul a pamangan a keang sidia nung e aku mu; at bukas man agkatan naku a kayabe na ning ari.
Makanianman ing sablang iti alang kabaldugan kanaku, kabang akakit ke i Mardoqueo a Judio a makalukluk king pasbulan dalan na ning ari.

Kanita sinabi nang Zeres a keang asawa at ding sabla nang kaluguran kea, Pagawa ka sang metung a pibitayan a limangpulung siku king katas, at panga abak sabian mu king ari king i Mardoqueo mabite ya karin: kanita ume kang masaya a kayabe na ning ari king maragul a pamangan. At iting bague mekapatula kang Haman; at pepagawa ne ing pibitayan.
King benging ita e ya mipatudtud ing ari; at inutus na a dalan de ing librung talajan karing cronica, at mebasa la king arapan na ning ari.
At meakit makasulat, king i Mardoqueo miniabi ya tungkul kang Bigtana at kang Teres, a adua karing camareru na ning ari, karing bante pasbul, a minisip muat gamat king aring Asuero.
At sinabi na ning ari, Nanu ing dangalan at kamalan a merapat kang Mardoqueo a makatungkul kaniti? Kanita sinabi ra ding talasuyu na ning ari at sinuyu kea, Alang merapat a nanuman dikil kea.

At sinabi na ning ari, Ninu ing atiu king patio? Ngeni i Haman linub ya king dane lual ning patio na ning bale na ning ari, banang sabian king ari king bitayan ya i Mardoqueo king pibitayan a sidia na dikil kea.
At ding talasuyu na ning ari sinabi ra kea, Oini, i Haman makatalakad ya king patio. At sinabi na ning ari, Paluban ye.

Nanupata linub ya i Haman. At sinabi na kea ning ari, Nanu ing sukat daptan king lalaki a pitutulan nang parangalan ning ari? Ngeni sinabi na ping Haman king keang pusu, Ninu ing pitutulan nang parangalan ning ari miguit kanaku?
At sinabi nang Haman king ari, Dikil king lalaki a pitutulan nang parangalan ning ari,
Dalan sa ing imalan ari a susulud na ning ari, at ing kabayu a sasakayan na ning ari, at iputung ya king buntuk na ing corona na ning ari:

At ing imalan at ing kabayu miabie sa king gamat na ning metung karing makamal nang diling principes, bang igayak de kareti ing lalaki a pitutulan nang parangalan ning ari, at pasakayan ne king kabayu a magmain ya king dalan na ning ciudad, at ipasiag king arapan na, Makanian ing marapat king lalaking pitutulan nang parangalan ning ari.

Kanita sinabi na ning ari kang Haman, Magmalagawa ka, at kuanan mu ing piblasan at ing kabayu, anti mo ing kekang sinabi, at daptan mung makanian kang Mardoqueo a Judio, a makalukluk king pasbulan dalan ning ari: e mu pabustan magkulang ing anggang sinabi mu.

Kanita kinua nang Haman ing imalan at ing kabayu, at pibablas ne i Mardoqueo, at minain ne king dalan ning ciudad, at pisiag na king arapan na, Makanian ing marapat king lalaki a pitutulan nang parangalan ning ari.
At i Mardoqueo dinatang yang pasibayu king pasbulan dalan na ning ari. Dapot i Haman migmalagawa yang minuli king keang bale, migpaldas ya, at makatakap ing keang buntuk.

At selese nang Haman kang Zeres a keang asawa at karing sabla nang kakaluguran ing balang bague a mepalyari kea. Kanita sinabi ra kea ding keang mangabiasang lalaki at i Zeres a keang asawa, Nung i Mardoqueo, ya ing kekang migmulang kebaldug, king bistat bini re ding Judios, e ka maniambut salang kea, nung e alang salang mabaldug ka king arapan na.
Kabang pakipagsalitan de pa, dinatang la ding camareru na ning ari, at dela reng malagawa i Haman king maragul a pamangan a sidia nang Ester.
Nanupata ing ari at i Haman dinatang la king maragul a pamangan a kayabe no ning reina Ester.

At sinabi nang pasibayu ning ari kang Ester king kaduang aldo king pamaninum king alak, Nanu ing kayaduanan mu, reina Ester? at mipagkalub keka: at nanu ing kekang awad? aguiang ing kapitna na ning kayarian mapalyari.

Kanita mekibat ya ing reina Ester at ngana, Nung menakit kung kalam king kekang panlalawe, Oh ari, at nung ikatula na ning ari, ipagkalub na sa kanaku ing kanakung bie king kayaduanan ku, at ing kanakung balayan king kanakung awad:

Uling mipisali kami, aku at ing kanakung balayan, bang malipul kami, bang pamatayan dakami, at bang mawala kami. Dapot nung mipisali kami a pekaalipan a lalaki at pekaalipan a babai, magpayapa ku, king bistat e na abayaran ning kasalang ing kasiran king ari.
Kanita miniabi ya ing aring Asuero at sinabi na king reina Ester, Ninu ya, at nu ya karin, ing mangangas king keang pusu a dapat king anti kanian?
At sinabi nang Ester, Ing metung a kalaban at ing metung a kasalang, ya pin iting marawak a Haman. Kanita mitakutan ya i Haman king arapan na ning ari at ning reina.

At ing ari tinalakad ya king kasbu manibat king pamaninum alak at linub ya king mulajan na ning palacio: at i Haman tinalakad ya banang yaduan ing keang bie king reina Ester; uling ikit na king ating marawak a melutas a salang kea king pamamilatan ning ari.

Kanita mibalik ya ing ari a menibatan king mulajan na ning palacio king karinan king pi-inuman king alak; at i Haman makasakab ya king sandalan a luluklukan nang Ester. Kanita sinabi na ning ari, Biglajan ne pa pin wari ing reina king arapan ku kilub ning bale? Pamanlual na ning amanu king asbuk ning ari, tikpan de ing lupa nang Haman.

Kanita sinabi nang Harbona, a metung ya karing camarero a a atiu king arapan na ning ari, Oini naman, ing pibitayan a lima yang pulung siku king katas, a guewa nang Haman dikil kang Mardoqueo, a miniabi king ikakayap na ning ari, makatalakad ya king bale nang Haman. At sinabi na ning ari, Bitayan ye karin.
Nanupata binite re i Haman king pibitayan a sidia na dikil kang Mardoqueo. Kanita ing kasbu ning ari meaplak.
King aldo a ita binie ne ning aring Asuero king reina Ester ing bale nang Haman a kasalang da ding Judios. At i Mardoqueo dinatang ya king arapan na ning ari; uling sinabi nang Ester nung nanu ne.
At begut ne ning ari ing singsing na, a likas na kang Haman, at binie ne kang Mardoqueo. At binili neng Ester i Mardoqueo a mamajala king bale nang Haman.

At i Ester miniabi ya pang pasibayu king arapan ning ari, at migsakab ya karing keang bitis, at pigamuamu na kea a kagum ning lua king ilako na ing dewakan nang Haman a Agageo, at ing keang kalalangan a lelangan na salang karing Judios.
Kanita inatyat ne ning ari kang Ester ing cetrong guintu. Inya tinalakad ya i Ester, at migtalakad ya king arapan na ning ari.

At sinabi na, Nung ikakatula na ning ari, at nung menakit kung kalam king keang panlalawe, at ing bague mababalak matulid king arapan ning ari, at aku makapatula ku karing keang mata, misulat sa a mibalikan la ding sulat a melalang kang Haman, a anak nang Hamedata a Agageo, a sinulat na banong lipulan ding Judios a atiu karing anggang lalawigan na ning ari:
Uling makananu kung apibatang lawan ing dewakan a miras king kanakung balayan? o makananu kung apibatang lawan ing pangasintang da ding kakung kamaganak?

Kanita sinabi na ning aring Asuero king reina Ester at kang Mardoqueo a Judio, Oini, binie ke kang Ester ing bale nang Haman, at ya binite re king pibitayan, uling pepagpa ne ing keang gamat karing Judios.

Sumulat kayu naman karing Judios, agpang king makapatula kekayu, king laguiu na ning ari, at tatakan ye king singsing ning ari; uling ing sulat a misulat king laguiu ning ari, at mitatakan king singsing ning ari, alang taung makabalik.

Kanita meaus la ding escribas na ning ari king panaun a ita, king katlung bulan, a ya ing bulan na ning Sivan, king kadua nang pulu at atlung aldo niti; at misulat ya agpang king anggang inutus nang Mardoqueo karing Judios, at karing satrapa, at karing gobernador at principes da ding lalawigan a manibat king India angga king Etiopia, a dinalan at aduangpulu at pitung lalawigan, king balang lalawigan agpang king karelang sulat, at king balang balayan agpang king amanu ra, at karing Judios agpang king sulat

At sinulat ya king laguiu na ning aring Asuero, at tetakan no king singsing ning ari, at peparala no ding sulat king pamamilatan da ding tubud a sasake kabayu, a makasake karing masalusung kabayu a gagamitan king pamanyuyu king ari, a penganak king dromedario:

At pigkaluban no ning ari ding Judios a atiu king balang ciudad a mitipun lang makapamisan, at talakad la tungkul king karelang bie, bang manyintang, bang makamate, at bang lumipul, king mabilug a kayupayan na ning balayan at lalawigan a manlub karela, karing karelang mangalating anak at babai, at kuanan ing samsam karela anting pekadakap.
King misan a aldo karing anggang lalawigan na ning aring Asuero, a ya pin, king kalabi nang atlung aldo ning kalabing aduang bulan, a ya ing bulan na ning Adar.

Ing metung a likas na ning sulat, bang ing kautusan mipalimpat ya king balang lalawigan, mibulalag ya karing anggang balayan, at bang ding Judios makapagsadia la salang king aldo a ita bang yablas da ing sarili ra salang karing karelang kasalang.

Nanupata ding tubud a sinake karing masalusung kabayu a gagamitan king kasuyuwan king ari linual la, anti ning mipamalaguanan la at mipagmisipitan king uli ning utus ning ari; at ing kautusan mibulalag ya king Susan a palacio.

At i Mardoqueo linual ya a ibat king arapan na ning ari king piblas ari a azul at maputi, at atin yang maragul a coronang guintu, at atin yang balabal a lienzong masinsin at purpura: at ing ciudad ning Susan kinulio at migsaya.
Mika atin lang sulu ding Judios at saya, at tula at kapurian.

At king balang lalawigan, at king balang ciudad, nu man miras ing utus ning ari at ing keang kautusan, mikaka atin lang saya ding Judios at tula, metung a pista at metung a mayap a aldo. At dakal la ding menibatan karing balayan na ning labuad meguing Judios la; uling ing takut karing Judios menabu karela.

Ngeni king kalabing aduang bulan, a ya ing bulan na ning Adar, king kalabing atlung aldo na mu rin, kanitang lalapit na bang mibili na king pangatupad, king aldo a panayan da ding kasalang da ding Judios a magpun la karela (anti na ning mabaligtad, a ding Judios ilang migpun karing mimumua karela),

Ding Judios mitipun lang makapamisan karing karelang ciudad karing anggang lalawigan na ning aring Asuero, bang muat gamat karing anggang manintun king karelang ikapanasakit: at alang taung mitalakad karela; uling ing takut karela mebaldug karing anggang balayan.
At ding anggang principes karing lalawigan, at ding satrapa, at ding gobernador, at ding darapat king daraptan king ari, sinaup la karing Judios; uling ing takut da kang Mardoqueo menabu karela.
Uling i Mardoqueo maragul ya king bale na ning ari, at ing keang kabantugan linual karing anggang lalawigan; uling ing lalaking i Mardoqueo meragul neng maragul.
At sigatan do ding Judios ding anggang karelang kasalang king tabak ning talibung, at king pamakamate at king pamanyintang, at depatan da ing buri ra karing mimumua karela.
At king Susan a palacio mekamate la ding Judios at linipul lang limang dalan a lalaki.
At i Parsandata, at i Dalfon, at i Aspata,
At i Porata, at i Adalia, at i Aridata,
At i Parmasta, at i Arisai, at i Aridai, at i Vaisata,
Ding apulu nang anak a lalaking Haman a anak nang Hamedata, a kasalang da ding Judios, pete rala; dapot king pamanamsam e re biwat ing karelang gamat.
Kanitang aldo a ita ing kabilangan da ding apate king Susan a palacio midala la king arapan ning ari.

At sinabi na ning ari kang reina Ester, Ding Judios mekamate la at linipul lang limang dalan a lalaki king Susan a palacio, at ding apulu nang anak a lalaking Haman; nanu pin ing karelang depatan karing aliwa nang lalawigan ning ari! Ngeni nanu ing kekang kayaduanan? at mipagkalub keka: o nanu pa ing awad mu? at marapat.

Kanita sinabi nang Ester, Nung ikakatula na ning ari, a mipagkalub sa karing Judios a atiu king Susan a daptan da naman bukas ing makaagpang king utus king aldo a iti, at ding apulu nang anak a lalaking Haman mabite la sa king pibitayan.
At inutus nang makanian ning ari a marapat ita: at ing metung a kautusan miabie ya king Susan; at binite ro ding apulung anak nang lalaking Haman.

At ding Judios a atiu king Susan mitipun lang makapamisan king kalabing apat a aldo na ning bulan na naman ning Adar, at mekamate lang atlung dalan a lalaki king Susan; dapot king pamanamsam e re biwat ing gamat da.

At ding aliwang Judios a atiu karing lalawigan na ning ari mitipun lang makapamisan, at tinalakad la tungkul karing karelang bie, at mika atin lang kapainawan karing karelang kasalang, at mekamate la karing mimumua karela pitungpulu at limang libu; dapot king pamanamsam e re biwat ing karelang gamat.
Iti merapat king kalabi nang atlung aldo ning bulan na ning Adar; at king kalabi nang apat a aldo ning bulan mu ring ita pepainawa la, at guewa reng metung a aldo ning pamagpista at kasayan.

Dapot ding Judios a atiu king Susan mitipun lang makapamisan king kalabi nang atlung aldo nita, at king kalabi nang apat nita; at king kalabi nang limang aldo mu rin pepainawa la, at guewa reng metung a aldo ning pamagpista at kasayan.

Inya pin ding Judios karing nayun, a manuknangan karing balen a e makakuta, gagawan de ing kalabing apat a aldo ning bulan na ning Adar a aldo na ning kasayan at pamagpista, at metung a mayap a aldo, at pamiatdanan karing dake king metung at metung.
At sinulat nong Mardoqueo ding bague a deti, at pepadala yang sulat karing anggang Judios a atiu karing anggang lalawigan na ning aring Asuero, ding malapit makanian mu naman ding marayu,
Bang miutus karela king karela yang ipangiling ing kalabing apat a aldo ning bulan ning Adar, at ing kalabi nang limang aldo niti mu rin, banua-banua.

Anti mong aldo la a kareti mika atin lang kapainawan ding Judios manibat karing karelang kasalang, at ing bulan a pangaalilan na ning karelang lungkut king saya, at ibat king pamagpaldas mialilan king metung a aldo mayap; barang gawan aldo na ning pamagpaldas mialilan king metung a aldo mayap; barang gawan aldo na ning pamagpista at kasayan, at king pamiatdanan karing dake ning metung at metung, at karing pagkalub karing maluka.
At ding Judios linutas dang daptan da ing anti mo ing karelang pigmulan, at anti mo ing sinulat nang Mardoqueo karela;

Uling i Haman a anak nang Hamedata, a Agageo, a kasalang da ding anggang Judios, dinapat yang bala salang karing Judios banong lipulan, at initsa re ing Pur, a ya pin, ing pipaningalman, banong lipulan, at banong sintangan;

Dapot inyang ing kabagayan miras king arapan ning ari, inutus na king pamamilatan da ding sulat a ing keang marawak a kalalangan, a lelangan na salang karing Judios, mibalik king sarili nang buntuk, at bang ya at ding keang anak a lalaki mabite la king pibitayan.

Inya pin inaus do ding aldo a deti Purim, agpang king laguiu nang Pur. Inya pin king uli ra ding anggang amanu na ning sulat a iti, at nitang karelang ikit tungkul king bague a iti, at nitang miras karela,

Ding Judios tinatag da, at kinua ra karela, at karing karelang bini, at karing anggang ninayun a makitipun karela, bang e sumala, king ipangiling do ding aduang aldo a deti agpang king sulat na niti, at agpang king metuldung panaun niti, balang banua;

At king ding aldo a deti sukat lang ganakan at ipangiling ning balang dai, ning balang sapni, ning balang lalawigan, at ning balang ciudad; at king ding aldo nang deti ning Purim e la lumipas karing Judios, ni ing kapigaganakan man kareti e lumipas king karelang bini.
Kanita ing reina Ester, a anak nang Abihail, at i Mardoqueo a Judio, sinulat la king mabilug a kayupayan bareng patunayan iting kadua nang sulat ning Purim.
At peparala yang sulat karing anggang Judios, karing dinalan aduangpulu at pitung lalawigan ning kayarian nang Asuero, a kagum ding amanung kapayapan at katutuan,

Banong patunayan ding aldo nang deti ning Purim king karelang makatuldung panaun, agpang king inutus na karelang Mardoqueo a Judio at ning reina Ester, at agpang king tinatag da dikil king karelang sarili at dikil king karelang bini, king kabagayan da ding pamagayunu at ning karelang dalung.
At ing utus nang Ester pepatune karing kabagayan na ning Purim; at misulat king libru.
At ing aring Asuero mibili yang buis king labuad, at karing kapuluan ning dayatmalat.

At ding anggang dapat na ning keang kayupayan at ning keang sikanan, at ing ganap a kasalesayan ning dangalan nang Mardoqueo, a nung kaisanu ne sinulung ning ari, e la wari makasulat king libru ra ding cronica ra ding ari ning Media at Persia?

Uling i Mardoqueo a Judio katuki ne ning aring Asuero, at marangal ya karing Judios, at matatanggap ya karing keraklan karing keang kapatad, pagdulapan na ing ikakayap na ning keang balayan, at maniabi yang kapayapan king keang mabilug a bini.
Ating metung a lalaki king labuad na ning Uz, a ing laguiu na Job; at ing lalaking ita sakdal ya at matulid, at tatakut ya king Dios, at makakawani ya king dewakan.
At ating penganak kea a pitung lalaki at atlung babai.

Ing keang pibandian naman pitu lang libung tupa, at atlung libung camello, at limang dalan a mipapaud a vaca, at limang dalan a asna, at metung a binang maragul a katubale; nanupata ing lalaking iti ya ing maragul dili karing anggang anak na ning aslagan.

At ding keang anak a lalaki mine la at mitatag lang metung a pista king bale na ning balang metung king keang kayaldawan; at mitubud la at pepayaus dala ding atlu rang kapatad a babai balang mangan at minum a kayabe ra.

At milyari, inyang ding aldo ra ding karelang pamagpista milabas na la, king i Job mitubud ya at pepagbanalan nala, at mibangun yang maranun panga abak, at milain yang ain a durulukan agpang king bilang da ila ngan: uling sinabi nang Job, Mekad ding kanakung anak a lalaki mikasala la, at pisawili re ing Dios karing karelang pusu. Makanian ing makaparating depatan nang Job.
Ngeni milyari king aldo nung kapilan ding anak na ng Dios dinatang la bang marap la king arapan ning GUINU, king i satanas dinatang ya naman king libutad da.

At sinabi ning GUINU kang satanas, Nu ka ibat? Kanita mekibat ya I satanas king GUINU, at sinabi na, Manibat king kakung pamunta karin at keni king labuad, at manibat king pamamanik ku at pamanipa kaniti.

At sinabi ning GUINU kang satanas, Guenaka me ing kakung talasuyung i Job? uling alang ninumang anti kea king labuad, metung yang sakdal at matulid a lalaki, metung yang tatakut king Dios, at kakawani king dewakan.
Kanita i satanas mekibat mekibat ya king GUINU, at sinabi na, Tatakut ya wari dikil king alang kabaldugan i Job king Dios?

E ka wari guinawang metung a bakud a makapatulug kea, at makapatulug king keang bale, at makapatulug king anggang atiu kea, king balang dane? pepanuanan mu ing dapat da ding keang gamat, at ing keang pibandian merakal king labuad.
Dapot yatyat me ing kekang gamat ngeni, at tagkilan mu ing anggang atiu kea, at pisawili naka king kekang lupa.

At sinabi ning GUINU kang satanas, Oini, ing anggang atiu kea atiu king kekang kayupayan; bukud mung kea a e me yatyat ing kekang gamat. Nanupata linual ya i satanas a menibatan king arapan ning GUINU.
At dinatang king misan a aldo kanitang ding anak nang lalaki at ding anak nang babai mamangan la at miminum lang alak king bale na ning karelang kapatad a lalaking pangane,
King dinatang ya ing metung a tubud kang Job, at sinabi na, Ding vaca atilu king pamanyarul, at ding asno mamangan la king siping da;
At delusungan dala ding Sabeos, at dela rala: wa, pete rala ding ipus king taram na ning talibung; at aku na mung mitakas a magdilidili bang mamalita keka.

Kabang maniabi ya mu, dinatang ya naman ing metung, at sinabi na, Ing api na ning Dios mebaldug manibat banua, at dilukan no ding tupa at ding ipus, at timpus nala; at aku na mung mitakas a magdilidili bang mamalita keka.

Kabang maniabi ya mu, dinatang ya naman ing metung, at sinabi na, Ding Caldeos guinawa lang atlung tapuk, at delusungan do ding camello, at dela rala, wa, at pete rala ding ipus king taram na ning talibung; at aku na mung mitakas a magdilidili bang mamalita keka.

Kabang maniabi ya mu, dinatang ya naman ing metung, at sinabi na, Ding kekang anak a lalaki at ding kekang anak a babai mamangan la at miminum alak ing bale na ning karelang kapatad a lalaking pangane;

At, oini, dinatang ing metung a masikan a angin a menibatan king ilang, at sepulan nong pisakit ding apat nang suluk ning bale, at misaldak ya karing kayanakan, at mengamate la; at aku na mung mitakas a magdilidili bang mamalita keka.
Kanita tinalakad ya i Job, at guinabak ne ing keang balabal, at sitsat ne ing keang buntuk, at migsakab ya king gabun, at sinamba ya;
At sinabi na, Lubas kung linual king bale nang pungul indu ku, at lubas kung mibalik karin: Ing GUINU ya ing minie, at Ing GUINU ya ing milako; nuan ya ing laguiu ning GUINU.
King sablang iti e ya mikasala i Job, ni e ya miniabing kamangmangan king Dios.
Pasibayu milyari king aldo a nung kapilan ding anak na ning Dios dinatang la bang marap king GUINU, king dinatang ya naman i satanas a kayabe ra bayang marap king GUINU.
At Ing GUINU sinabi na kang satanas, Nu ka menibat? At i satanas mekibat ya king GUINU, at sinabi na, Manibat king pamunta ku karin at keni king labuad, at king pamamanik ku at pamanipa kaniti.

At sinabi ning GUINU kang satanas, Guenaka me ing talasuyu kung i Job? uling alang ninuman a anti kea king labuad, metung yang sakdal at matulid a lalaki, metung yang tatakut king Dios, at kakawani king dewakan: at manatili ya pa king keang katapatan, king bistat kimutan muku salang kea, bameng sintangan king alang kasangkapan.
At i satanas mekibat ya king GUINU, at sinabi na, Balat king balat, wa, ing anggang atiu king metung a tau ibie na dikil king keang bie.
Dapot yatyat me ing kekang gamat, ngeni, at tagkilan me ing butul na at ing keang laman, at pisawili naka king kekang lupa.
At Ing GUINU sinabi na kang satanas, Oini, atiu king kekang gamat; itagan mu mu ing keang bie.
Nanupata linual ya i satanas a menibatan king arapan ning GUINU, at sigatan ne i Job karing mangarawak a baya manibatan king talampakan na ning keang bitis angga king keang bunbunan.
At kinanua yang metung a kapsa ning kuran baneng ipangayud king langib; at linukluk ya king libutad na ning abu.
Kanita sinabi na kea ning keang asawa, Manatili ka pa wari king kekang katapatan? pisawili me ing Dios, at mate ka.

Dapot sinabi na kea, Ika maniabi ka a anti mo ing pamaniabi na ning metung karing mangmang a babai. Nanu? tanggapan tamu ing mayap king gamat na ning Dios, at e tamu tanggap king dewakan? King sablang iti e ya mikasala i Job karing keang labi.

Ngeni inyang damdaman da ding atlu nang kakaluguran Job ing anggang dewakan a iti a miras kea, dinatang la balang metung a menibatan king keang sariling karinan: i Elifaz a Temanita, at i Bildad a Suhita, at i Zofar a Naamatita; at guinawa lang pamikayari ila ngan a datang la bang damayan de at bang patulan de.

At inyang inatna ro ding karelang mata king marayu, at e re akilala, sikan da ing karelang siwala, at kiniak la; at guinabak ne ning balang metung karela ing keang balabal, at migsabug lang alikabuk king babo rang buntuk nangan banua.
Nanupata linukluk lang kayabe na king babo na ning gabun pitung aldo at pitung bengi, at alang miniabi kea kataya mang amanu: uling ikit da ing keang kalungkutan binang maragul.
Kaibat na niti biklat neng Job ing keang asbuk, at simpa na ing keang aldo.
At i Job mekibat ya at sinabi na:
Mawala ya sa ing aldo a nung kapilan ku mibait, at ing bengi a miniabi, Ating anak a lalaking mipangagli.
Maguing dalumdum ya sa ing aldo a ita; E ne sa panintunan iti ning Dios manibatan babo, Ni e ne sa aslagan iti ning sala.
Ing sanang dalumdum at ing lilung ning kamatayan kuanan deng maguing karela; Magsantung ya sa babo na ing metung a lulam; Ding anggang padalumdum sana king aldo papangilabutan de.
Makatungkul king benging ita, ing makapal a dalumdum sana dumpa kea: E ya pabustan magsaya karing aldo na ning pabanua; E ya pabustan miyayabe king bilang da ding bulan.
Oini, pabustan yang maguing baug ing benging ita; E pabustan lulub kea ing masayang siwala.
Ipasumpa ya karing misusumpa king aldo, Ding makasadiang gumising king dapu.
Dalumdum la sa ding batuin king keang silim: Pabustan yang lumawe sala, dapot e ya mika atin; Ni e ya pabustan lumawe man karing talukab nang mata ning abak:
Uling e no kebat ding pasbul na ning bale nang pungul ning kanakung indu, Ni pinpan man ing lingasngas karing kakung mata.
Baket e ku pa mete manibat king bale pungul? Baket e ku pa tikusan ing inawa inyang ibait nakung indu ku?
Baket tinggap daku ding tud? O baket kaya ding susu, bakung sumusu?
Uling ngeni mikera na ku sa at metajimik; Matudtud na ku sa; kanita mibili na ku king kapainawan,
Kambe ra ding ari at ding talausuk ning labuad, A menalakad karing karinan a ilang dikil karela;
O kambe ding principes a ating guintu, At kitmuan do ding karelang bale king pilak:
O anti mong metung a makasalikut a pangabait e panaun e na ku sana, Anti ding bingut a kapilan man e menakit sala.
Karin ding mangarawak patugut la king pamanlingasngas, At karin ding mapagal atilu king kapainawan,
Karin ding dakap makapasno lang miabeabe; E ra na daramdaman ing siwala na ning panginuan king pamaniapat.
Ding mangalati at ding mangaragul atilu karin: At ing ipus timawa ya king keang guinu.
Baket ing sala miyayabie ya king atiu king kapajamakan, At ing bie king ating mapait a kaladua;
A magnasa king kamatayan, dapot e daratang, At kukulkul dikil kaniti a maiguit karing pibandian a makasalikut;
A matutulung bina, At masasaya la, ngening akit de ing kutkutan?
Baket ing sala miyayabie king metung a tau a ing keang lakad makasalikut, At nung ninu ing bekuran ning Dios?
Uling ing kanakung saingsing daratang bayu ku mangan, At ding kakung ngulangul mibubulus lang anti mong danum.
Uling ing bague a katatakutan ku dimpa kanaku, At ing pikakanlapan ku dimpa kanaku.
Ala ku king kapasnawan, ni e ku tajimik, ni ala kung kapainawan; Dapot ing kalingasngasan daratang.
Kanita mekibat ya i Elifaz a Temanita, at sinabi na,
Nung ing metung subukan nang makipagsalita keka, lungkut ka kaya? Dapot ninung malyaring makapangawat king sarili na king pamangamanu?
Oini, tinuru ka karing dakal, At pepasiknangan mula ding mainang gamat.
Ding kekang amanu minalale la king miraragsa, At pepagtatagan mula ding mainang tud.
Dapot ngeni dinatang keka, at mangalambut ka; Tatagkilan naka, at malilingasngas ka.
Aliwa wari ing kekang takut king Dios ya ing kekang katiwalan, At ing pamagtapat karing kekang lakad ya ing kekang kapanayan?
Ganakan mu, pagamuamu ku keka, ninu na ing mete, a alang malit kasalanan? O nu la mapapatpat ding matulid?
Agpang king kanakung ikit, detang sasarul king dewakan, At tatanam kaligaligan, makanian mu naman ing pupulan da.
King uli ning pangisnawa na ning Dios mawawala la, At king uli ning tiup na ning keang mua maguiguisan la.
Ing pamamius na ning leon, at ing siwala na ning mabagsik a leon, At ding ipan ding leon a anak, mebalbal la.
Ing matuang leon mamamate ya king uli ning kakulangan nang dakap, At ding anak na ning leona mikakalat lang mikakandayu.
Ngeni midalang lijim kanaku ing metung a bague, At ing kakung balugbug tinggap na ing metung a sisitsit na niti.
Karing kaisipan manibat karing malikmata king bengi, Ngening ing malalam a tudtud mababaldug karing tau,
Ing takut dinatang kanaku, at ing galgal, A pakimut karing sablang kakung butul.
Kanita dinalan ya ing metung a espiritu king arapan ning kanakung lupa; Ing bulbul na ning laman ku menalakad.
Tinalakad yang maratun, dapot e ku akikilala ing aske na; Metung yang anyu ing atiu king arapan da ding kakung mata: Ating katajimikan, at dimdam ke ing metung a siwala, a ngana,
Maguing banal ya pa wari ing taung ating kamatayan a maiguit king Dios? Maguing malinis ya pa kaya ing metung a tau a maiguit king Mengawa kea?
Oini, e na bibili ing kapanaligan karing keang talasuyu; At ding keang angeles sasangkanan nala king pangasala:
Nu pa kaya anti ding manuknangan karing bale a pila, A ing keang pitatalakaran atiu king alikabuk, A malalagpak yang mumuna pa king pulilia!
King pilatan ning abak at ning gatpanapun sira na la: Mawala la king kapilan pa man a alang ninumang migaganaka kaniti.
E ya wari mepatlud ing tali na ning karelang kubu a atiu kilub da? Mamamate la, at ita alang kabiasnan.
Maus ka ngeni; atin waring ninumang makibat keka? At kaninu ka malikid karing banal?
Uling ing sukal a lub papatian ne ing taung mangmang, At ing pangalalu papatian ne ing mamulang.
Ikit keng magyamut ing mangmang: Dapot kabud-abud simpa ke ing keang tuknangan.
Ding anak na marayu la king pangaligtas, At mayalipit la kilub ning pasbulan dalan, Ni alang ninumang miligtas karela:
A ing keang pupul kakanan na ning danupan, At kakuanan na aguiang manibatan pa karing suksuk; At ing silu makabuklat ya dikil king karelang pibandian.
Uling ing pamipasakit e lulual manibat king alikabuk, Ni e sumibul man king gabun ing kalingasngasan;
Dapot ing tau panganak ya king kalingasngasan, Anti mo ding lipatu a susulapo nangan babo.
Dapot tungkul kanaku, panintunan ke ing Dios, At king Dios karin ku ipanabilin ing kakung pisasabian;
A ya ing darapat karing mangaragul a bague at e ataruk, Makapagmulalang bague a e pabilang:
